  function clockText(ts) {
    const d = new Date(Number(ts) || Date.now());
    const pad = (n) => (n < 10 ? '0' + n : String(n));
    return pad(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad(d.getMinutes());
  }

  function pad2(n) { return n < 10 ? '0' + n : String(n); }

  /** 消息时间：今天只给时分，昨天加「昨天」，更早给日期 */
  function fmtTime(ts) {
    const d = new Date(Number(ts) || Date.now());
    const now = new Date();
    const hm = pad2(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad2(d.getMinutes());
    const same = (a, b) => a.getFullYear() === b.getFullYear() && a.getMonth() === b.getMonth() && a.getDate() === b.getDate();
    if (same(d, now)) return hm;
    const y = new Date(now.getTime() - 86400000);
    if (same(d, y)) return '昨天 ' + hm;
    if (d.getFullYear() === now.getFullYear()) return (d.getMonth() + 1) + '月' + d.getDate() + '日 ' + hm;
    return d.getFullYear() + '年' + (d.getMonth() + 1) + '月' + d.getDate() + '日';
  }

  /** 主题解析：配置强制优先，auto 时读宿主 body 的明暗 */
  function resolvedTheme() {
    if (config.theme === 'light' || config.theme === 'dark') return config.theme;
    try {
      const cls = String((HD.body && HD.body.className) || '');
      if (/dark/i.test(cls)) return 'dark';
      if (/light/i.test(cls)) return 'light';
      const bg = HW.getComputedStyle(HD.body).backgroundColor || '';
      const m = /rgba?\(\s*(\d+)[,\s]+(\d+)[,\s]+(\d+)/.exec(bg);
      if (m) {
        const lum = Number(m[1]) * 0.299 + Number(m[2]) * 0.587 + Number(m[3]) * 0.114;
        return lum < 128 ? 'dark' : 'light';
      }
    } catch (_e) { /* 拿不到宿主样式就用默认 */ }
    return 'dark';
  }

  function applyTheme() {
    if (session.root) {
      session.root.dataset.theme = resolvedTheme();
      session.root.dataset.skin = currentSkin();
    }
    session.inlineMounts.forEach((m) => {
      if (m.el) { m.el.dataset.theme = resolvedTheme(); m.el.dataset.skin = currentSkin(); }
    });
  }

  /** 当前皮肤 id（normalizeConfig 已保证只可能是合法值） */
  function currentSkin() {
    return config.skin || 'default';

  // —— 位置与尺寸 ——

  function viewportRect() {
    try {
      const vv = HW.visualViewport;
      if (vv) return { x: vv.offsetLeft, y: vv.offsetTop, w: vv.width, h: vv.height };
    } catch (_e) { /* 老浏览器没有 visualViewport */ }
    try { return { x: 0, y: 0, w: HW.innerWidth, h: HW.innerHeight }; }
    catch (_e) { return { x: 0, y: 0, w: 1280, h: 800 }; }
  }

  function clampRect(input, vp) {
    // 手机端（视口 < 600）：浮窗占满全屏，不夹最小宽高
    if (vp.w < 600) return { x: 0, y: 0, w: vp.w, h: vp.h };
    const availW = Math.max(1, vp.w - EDGE_GAP * 2);
    const availH = Math.max(1, vp.h - EDGE_GAP * 2);
    const minW = Math.min(MIN_W, availW);
    const minH = Math.min(MIN_H, availH);
    const w = Math.min(Math.max(input.w, minW), availW);
    const h = Math.min(Math.max(input.h, minH), availH);
    const minX = vp.x + EDGE_GAP;
    const minY = vp.y + EDGE_GAP;
    const maxX = vp.x + vp.w - w - EDGE_GAP;
    const maxY = vp.y + vp.h - h - EDGE_GAP;
    return {
      x: Math.min(Math.max(input.x, minX), Math.max(minX, maxX)),
      y: Math.min(Math.max(input.y, minY), Math.max(minY, maxY)),
      w: w,
      h: h,
    };
  }

  function loadRect() {
    const r = readJSON(K_RECT, null);
    const vp = viewportRect();
    if (!r || typeof r !== 'object') {
      return clampRect({ x: vp.x + vp.w - DEFAULT_RECT.w - 24, y: vp.y + 60, w: DEFAULT_RECT.w, h: DEFAULT_RECT.h }, vp);
    }
    return clampRect({
      x: clampNum(r.x, -9999, 99999, DEFAULT_RECT.x),
      y: clampNum(r.y, -9999, 99999, DEFAULT_RECT.y),
      w: clampNum(r.w, MIN_W, 4000, DEFAULT_RECT.w),
      h: clampNum(r.h, MIN_H, 4000, DEFAULT_RECT.h),
    }, vp);
  }

  function saveRect() {
    if (session.rect) writeJSON(K_RECT, Object.assign({ version: 1 }, session.rect));
  }

  function applyRect() {
    if (!session.root || !session.rect) return;
    const r = session.rect;
    session.root.style.left = r.x + 'px';
    session.root.style.top = r.y + 'px';
    session.root.style.width = r.w + 'px';
    session.root.style.height = r.h + 'px';
  }

  /** 事件绑定 + disposer 追踪（脚本销毁时统一解绑） */
  function on(elm, type, fn, opts) {
    if (!elm) return;
    elm.addEventListener(type, fn, opts);
    session.disposers.push(() => { try { elm.removeEventListener(type, fn, opts); } catch (_e) { /* 已移除 */ } });
  }

  /**
   * 手机内的键盘事件不再冒泡到酒馆文档（否则回车之类会触发酒馆或扩展的全局快捷键）。
   *
   * 必须挂在**冒泡阶段**：捕获阶段调 stopPropagation 会把事件拦在祖先节点上，
   * 连输入框自己的 keydown 都收不到（打字直接失灵）。
   * 冒泡阶段拦则相反 —— 手机内部的输入先正常工作，再阻止继续往上冒。
   */
  function isolateKeys(el) {
    ['keydown', 'keypress', 'keyup'].forEach((t) => {
      on(el, t, (ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    // 滚轮隔离：阻止 wheel 冒泡到宿主文档 —— 手机 UI 挂在宿主页面上，
    // 若酒馆扩展/脚本在 document/window 上有 preventDefault 的 wheel 拦截，
    // 手机内的滚轮滚动会被吃掉。passive=true 只拦传播不拦默认动作，
    // 浏览器的原生滚动照常发生（与键盘隔离同理，挂冒泡阶段）。
    on(el, 'wheel', (ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); }, { passive: true });
  }

  // ========================= 悬浮球 =========================

  function buildOrb() {
    if (session.orbEl && HD.body.contains(session.orbEl)) return;
    // 悬浮球是唯一的入口：不加 role/tabindex 的话，键盘用户根本打不开手机
    const orb = h('div', {
      class: 'tph-orb', title: '小手机 · 单击开关 / 拖动移动',
      role: 'button', tabindex: '0', 'aria-label': '打开或收起小手机',
    });
    orb.appendChild(iconSvg('device', 22));
    session.orbEl = orb;

    let drag = null;
    let moved = false;
    let suppressClick = false;

    on(orb, 'pointerdown', (ev) => {
      if (ev.button !== 0) return;
      try { orb.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId); } catch (_e) { /* 不支持捕获 */ }
      const r = orb.getBoundingClientRect();
      drag = { id: ev.pointerId, sx: ev.clientX, sy: ev.clientY, ox: r.left, oy: r.top };
      moved = false;
      orb.dataset.busy = '1';
    });

    on(orb, 'pointermove', (ev) => {
      if (!drag || ev.pointerId !== drag.id) return;
      const dx = ev.clientX - drag.sx;
      const dy = ev.clientY - drag.sy;
      if (!moved && Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy) > 5) moved = true;
      if (!moved) return;
      const size = orb.offsetWidth || 44;
      const vp = viewportRect();
      const nx = clampNum(drag.ox + dx, vp.x + 2, vp.x + vp.w - size - 2, 0);
      const ny = clampNum(drag.oy + dy, vp.y + 2, vp.y + vp.h - size - 2, 0);
      orb.style.left = nx + 'px';
      orb.style.top = ny + 'px';
      orb.style.right = 'auto';
      orb.style.bottom = 'auto';
    });

    on(orb, 'pointerup', (ev) => {
      if (!drag || ev.pointerId !== drag.id) return;
      drag = null;
      orb.dataset.busy = '0';
      if (moved) {
        suppressClick = true;
        writeJSON(K_RECT + ':orb', { x: orb.offsetLeft, y: orb.offsetTop });
        setTimeout(() => { suppressClick = false; }, 60);
      }
    });

    on(orb, 'pointercancel', () => { drag = null; orb.dataset.busy = '0'; });

    on(orb, 'click', () => {
      if (suppressClick) return;
      togglePhone();
    });

    // 键盘等同单击（div 不像 button 那样自带 Enter/Space 行为）
    on(orb, 'keydown', (ev) => {
      if (ev.key !== 'Enter' && ev.key !== ' ' && ev.key !== 'Spacebar') return;
      ev.preventDefault();
      togglePhone();
    });

    on(orb, 'dblclick', (ev) => {
      ev.preventDefault();
      if (HW.confirm('彻底退出「酒馆小手机」？\n（浮窗、悬浮球与全部监听将被清除，已保存的数据不受影响）')) destroyPhone();
    });

    // 恢复上次的球位置
    const pos = readJSON(K_RECT + ':orb', null);
    if (pos && typeof pos === 'object') {
      const vp = viewportRect();
      const size = 44;
      orb.style.left = clampNum(pos.x, vp.x + 2, vp.x + vp.w - size - 2, 0) + 'px';
      orb.style.top = clampNum(pos.y, vp.y + 2, vp.y + vp.h - size - 2, 0) + 'px';
      orb.style.right = 'auto';
      orb.style.bottom = 'auto';
    }

    HD.body.appendChild(orb);
  }

  // ========================= 状态栏 / 壁纸 =========================

  /**
   * 电量。Battery Status API 在多数现代浏览器已被移除，所以不能假设它存在 ——
   * 拿得到就报真实电量并跟随变化，拿不到就回落到一个稳定值（96%）。
   */
  const _bat = { pct: 96, probed: false };
  function batteryState() {
    if (_bat.probed) return _bat;
    _bat.probed = true;
    try {
      const nav = HW.navigator;
      if (nav && typeof nav.getBattery === 'function') {
        nav.getBattery().then((b) => {
          const upd = () => {
            const v = Math.round(Number(b.level) * 100);
            if (!isFinite(v)) return;
            _bat.pct = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, v));
            refreshBatteryUi();
          };
          upd();
          try { b.addEventListener('levelchange', upd); session.disposers.push(() => { try { b.removeEventListener('levelchange', upd); } catch (_e) { /* */ } }); } catch (_e) { /* 没有事件就只读一次 */ }
        }).catch(() => { /* 拒绝授权就保持兜底值 */ });
      }
    } catch (_e) { /* 同上 */ }
    return _bat;
  }

  /** 状态栏右侧：信号 + Wi-Fi + 电量百分比 + 电池。浮窗与楼层内嵌共用 */
  function buildStatusRight() {
    const right = h('span', { class: 'tph-sb-right' });
    const sig = h('span', { class: 'tph-sb-sig' });
    [4, 6, 8, 10].forEach((hh) => sig.appendChild(h('i', { style: 'height:' + hh + 'px' })));
    right.appendChild(sig);
    right.appendChild(iconSvg('wifi', 14));

    const bat = batteryState();
    const pct = h('span', { class: 'tph-sb-pct', text: bat.pct + '%' });
    right.appendChild(pct);
    const body = h('span', { class: 'tph-sb-bat-body' });
    const fill = h('i', { style: 'width:' + bat.pct + '%' });
    body.appendChild(fill);
    const box = h('span', { class: 'tph-sb-bat' });
    box.appendChild(body);
    box.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-sb-bat-nub' }));
    right.appendChild(box);

    return { right: right, pct: pct, fill: fill };
  }

  /** 状态栏整条。withClose=true 时右侧多一个「收起手机」按钮（浮窗才有，楼层里不需要） */
  function buildStatusBar(withClose) {
    const bar = h('div', { class: 'tph-statusbar' });
    const time = h('span', { class: 'tph-sb-time', text: clockText() });
    bar.appendChild(time);

    // 灵动岛：纯装饰，但它是「一眼认出是手机」的关键
    const island = h('span', { class: 'tph-sb-island' });
    if (!config.island) island.setAttribute('data-off', '1');

    // 灵动岛里塞通知角标（有未读时显示红点数字）
    const notifN = unreadNotifCount();
    if (notifN > 0) {
      const dot = h('span', {
        class: 'tph-sb-notif', text: notifN > 99 ? '99+' : String(notifN),
        role: 'button', tabindex: '0',
      });
      dot.title = notifN + ' 条未读通知（点击查看）';
      dot.setAttribute('aria-label', notifN + ' 条未读通知，点击查看');
      const openNotif = (ev) => {
        ev.stopPropagation();
        session.notifPanelOpen = !session.notifPanelOpen;
        renderScreen();
      };
      dot.addEventListener('click', openNotif);
      dot.addEventListener('keydown', (ev) => {
        if (ev.key !== 'Enter' && ev.key !== ' ' && ev.key !== 'Spacebar') return;
        openNotif(ev);
      });
      island.appendChild(dot);
    }
    bar.appendChild(island);

    const parts = buildStatusRight();
    if (withClose) {
      const closeBtn = h('button', {
        class: 'tph-sb-close', type: 'button', title: '收起手机',
        'aria-label': '收起手机', onclick: () => closePhone(),
      });
      closeBtn.appendChild(iconSvg('close', 13));
      parts.right.appendChild(closeBtn);
    }
    bar.appendChild(parts.right);
    return { bar: bar, time: time, pct: parts.pct, fill: parts.fill };
  }

  /** 每 20 秒刷一次时间：浮窗 + 楼层里所有内嵌手机一起（只改文本，不重绘） */
  function tickShell() {
    const t = clockText();
    if (session.status && session.status.time) session.status.time.textContent = t;
    (session.inlineMounts || []).forEach((m) => {
      if (m.status && m.status.time) m.status.time.textContent = t;
    });
  }

  function refreshBatteryUi() {
    const pct = batteryState().pct;
    if (session.status) {
      if (session.status.pct) session.status.pct.textContent = pct + '%';
      if (session.status.fill) session.status.fill.style.width = pct + '%';
    }
    (session.inlineMounts || []).forEach((m) => {
      if (!m.status) return;
      if (m.status.pct) m.status.pct.textContent = pct + '%';
      if (m.status.fill) m.status.fill.style.width = pct + '%';
    });
  }

  /**
   * 桌面壁纸。只有主页才铺 —— data-wall 存在即「桌面态」，
   * 状态栏转白字、屏幕透明、小白条变亮都挂在这个属性上（见 13-css）。
   */
  function applyWall() {
    const wallId = config.wall || 'deep';
    const custom = isCustomWall(wallId);
    const setWall = (el) => {
      if (session.tab === 'home') {
        el.setAttribute('data-wall', wallId);
        // 自定义壁纸用内联 background-image（base64 太长不走 CSS 规则）
        if (custom) el.style.backgroundImage = wallCss(wallId);
        else el.style.backgroundImage = '';
      } else {
        el.removeAttribute('data-wall');
        el.style.backgroundImage = '';
      }
    };
    if (session.shellEl) setWall(session.shellEl);
    (session.inlineMounts || []).forEach((m) => {
      if (!m.frame) return;
      // 楼层内嵌手机：只在 home 页铺壁纸
      if (m.app === 'home') {
        m.frame.setAttribute('data-wall', wallId);
        if (custom) m.frame.style.backgroundImage = wallCss(wallId);
        else m.frame.style.backgroundImage = '';
      } else {
        m.frame.removeAttribute('data-wall');
        m.frame.style.backgroundImage = '';
      }
    });
  }

  /** 灵动岛显隐：改现有元素而不是重建外壳（重建会把浮窗位置和拖动状态一起丢） */
  function applyIsland() {
    const bars = [];
    if (session.status && session.status.bar) bars.push(session.status.bar);
    (session.inlineMounts || []).forEach((m) => { if (m.status && m.status.bar) bars.push(m.status.bar); });
    bars.forEach((bar) => {
      const island = (bar && typeof bar.querySelector === 'function') ? bar.querySelector('.tph-sb-island') : null;
      if (!island) return;
      if (config.island) island.removeAttribute('data-off');
      else island.setAttribute('data-off', '1');
    });
  }

  // ========================= 浮窗 =========================

  function buildRoot() {
    if (session.root && HD.body.contains(session.root)) return;
    const root = h('div', { class: 'tph-root', 'data-tph-root': '1' });
    root.dataset.theme = resolvedTheme();
    root.dataset.skin = currentSkin();
    if (!session.visible) root.setAttribute('data-hidden', '1');

    const shell = h('div', { class: 'tph-shell' });
    session.shellEl = shell;

    // —— 状态栏（同时是拖动把手）——
    session.status = buildStatusBar(true);
    shell.appendChild(session.status.bar);

    // —— 屏幕 ——
    const screen = h('div', { class: 'tph-screen' });
    session.screenEl = screen;
    shell.appendChild(screen);

    // —— 小白条：桌面态是装饰，进了 App 就是「回主页」，保证任何界面都有退路 ——
    const homebar = h('button', {
      class: 'tph-homebar', type: 'button', title: '主页', 'aria-label': '回到主页',
    });
    homebar.appendChild(h('i'));
    homebar.addEventListener('click', () => gotoApp('home'));
    shell.appendChild(homebar);
    session.homebarEl = homebar;

    // —— 缩放手柄 ——
    // 缩放手柄原本是个纯 div —— 加了 tabindex 才能聚焦，方向键调尺寸才有落点
    const grip = h('div', {
      class: 'tph-grip', title: '拖动改变尺寸（或用方向键）',
      role: 'button', tabindex: '0', 'aria-label': '调整手机窗口大小，方向键微调',
    });
    shell.appendChild(grip);

    root.appendChild(shell);
    HD.body.appendChild(root);
    session.root = root;

    isolateKeys(root);
    bindDrag(session.status.bar);
    bindResize(grip);
    bindResizeKeys(grip);
    if (!session.rect) session.rect = loadRect();
    applyRect();
    applyWall();

    session.clockTimer = setInterval(tickShell, 20000);
  }

  let _drag = null;
  function bindDrag(handle) {
    on(handle, 'pointerdown', (ev) => {
      if (ev.button !== 0) return;
      if (ev.target && ev.target.closest && ev.target.closest('button')) return;
      ev.preventDefault();
      try { handle.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId); } catch (_e) { /* 不支持捕获 */ }
      _drag = { id: ev.pointerId, sx: ev.clientX, sy: ev.clientY, start: Object.assign({}, session.rect) };
      if (session.root) session.root.dataset.busy = '1';
    });
    on(handle, 'pointermove', (ev) => {
      if (!_drag || ev.pointerId !== _drag.id) return;
      const vp = viewportRect();
      const next = {
        x: _drag.start.x + (ev.clientX - _drag.sx),
        y: _drag.start.y + (ev.clientY - _drag.sy),
        w: _drag.start.w,
        h: _drag.start.h,
      };
      const c = clampRect(next, vp);
      session.rect.x = c.x;
      session.rect.y = c.y;
      if (session.raf) return;
      session.raf = HW.requestAnimationFrame(() => { session.raf = 0; applyRect(); });
    });
    const end = (ev) => {
      if (!_drag || (ev && ev.pointerId !== _drag.id)) return;
      _drag = null;
      if (session.root) session.root.dataset.busy = '0';
      applyRect();
      saveRect();
    };
    on(handle, 'pointerup', end);
    on(handle, 'pointercancel', end);
  }

  let _resize = null;
  function bindResize(grip) {
    on(grip, 'pointerdown', (ev) => {
      if (ev.button !== 0) return;
      ev.stopPropagation();
      ev.preventDefault();
      try { grip.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId); } catch (_e) { /* 不支持捕获 */ }
      _resize = { id: ev.pointerId, sx: ev.clientX, sy: ev.clientY, start: Object.assign({}, session.rect) };
      if (session.root) session.root.dataset.busy = '1';
    });
    on(grip, 'pointermove', (ev) => {
      if (!_resize || ev.pointerId !== _resize.id) return;
      const vp = viewportRect();
      session.rect.w = Math.max(MIN_W, _resize.start.w + (ev.clientX - _resize.sx));
      session.rect.h = Math.max(MIN_H, _resize.start.h + (ev.clientY - _resize.sy));
      const c = clampRect(session.rect, vp);
      session.rect.w = c.w;
      session.rect.h = c.h;
      if (session.raf) return;
      session.raf = HW.requestAnimationFrame(() => { session.raf = 0; applyRect(); });
    });
    const end = (ev) => {
      if (!_resize || (ev && ev.pointerId !== _resize.id)) return;
      _resize = null;
      if (session.root) session.root.dataset.busy = '0';
      applyRect();
      saveRect();
    };
    on(grip, 'pointerup', end);
    on(grip, 'pointercancel', end);
  }

  /**
   * 键盘调尺寸：聚焦缩放手柄后用方向键改宽高（Shift 加大步长）。
   * 纯鼠标用户用不到，但手柄一旦可聚焦，键盘用户就只能靠这个 —— 否则 tabindex 反而是个陷阱。
   * 每次都过一遍 clampRect，保证不会把窗口拖出视口。
   */
  function bindResizeKeys(grip) {
    on(grip, 'keydown', (ev) => {
      const step = ev.shiftKey ? 40 : 12;
      let dw = 0, dh = 0;
      if (ev.key === 'ArrowLeft') dw = -step;
      else if (ev.key === 'ArrowRight') dw = step;
      else if (ev.key === 'ArrowUp') dh = -step;
      else if (ev.key === 'ArrowDown') dh = step;
      else return;
      ev.preventDefault();
      if (!session.rect) return;
      const vp = viewportRect();
      const c = clampRect({
        x: session.rect.x, y: session.rect.y,
        w: session.rect.w + dw, h: session.rect.h + dh,
      }, vp);
      session.rect.x = c.x;
      session.rect.y = c.y;
      session.rect.w = c.w;
      session.rect.h = c.h;
      applyRect();
      saveRect();
    });
  }

  // ========================= 开关与路由 =========================

  function openPhone() {
    if (!session.root) buildRoot();
    session.visible = true;
    session.root.removeAttribute('data-hidden');
    renderScreen();
  }

  function closePhone() {
    session.visible = false;
    if (session.root) session.root.setAttribute('data-hidden', '1');
  }

  function togglePhone() {
    if (session.visible) closePhone();
    else openPhone();
  }

  /**
   * 切到某个界面。tab = 'home' | App id。
   * 切走时清理该界面的临时状态，回来时是干净的。
   */
  function gotoApp(id) {
    const t = (id === 'home' || APP_IDS.indexOf(id) >= 0) ? id : 'home';
    if (session.tab !== t) {
      session.wxOps = false;
      session.wxMenu = null;
      session.wxNew = null;
      session.moCompose = false;
      session.memAdd = false;
      session.musicNowOpen = false;  // 全屏播放页不跨 App 保留
      session.musicVolOpen = false;  // 音量浮层同理，切走就收
      session.stockDetail = null;    // 股票详情页 / 管理面板不跨 App 保留
      session.stockSettingsOpen = false;
      // 通话里的大语音键是「点了就一直录」的开关，切走必须收掉，
      // 否则麦克风会在别的 App 里继续开着 —— 用户看不见、也关不掉。
      if (t !== 'call' && session.callRec) {
        try { stopSTT(); } catch (_e) { /* 忽略 */ }
        session.callRec = false;
        session.callPartial = '';
      }
      // 流式预览是「这一刻的界面状态」，跟着通话页走，切走就作废
      if (t !== 'call') callStreamClear();
      // 通话中离开电话页：立即停掉 TTS 语音 + 中断朗读回合（callPhase 保留，回来还能继续）
      if (t !== 'call' && (session.callPhase === 'talking' || session.callPhase === 'dialing' || session.callPhase === 'ringing')) {
        if (typeof callInterrupt === 'function') callInterrupt();
      }
      // 拨号多选状态跟着电话页走，切走就清
      if (t !== 'call') session.callPick = [];
    }
    session.tab = t;
    session._appEnter = true;  // 标记：让 uiShell 加 enter class 触发入场动画（只跑一次）
    session.foldOpen = {};
    syncShell();

    // 浮窗没开着时，切 App 就地作用在楼层里那台手机上（用户刚点过的那个）。
    // 设置页除外：参数面板塞进楼层那台小手机里太挤，还是留给浮窗。
    if (!session.visible) {
      const m = (session.inlineMounts || []).find((x) => x.id === session.inlineFocusId);
      if (m && m.app !== t && t !== 'settings') {
        m.app = t;
        try { m.refresh(); return; } catch (e) { softFail('楼层内嵌切 App', e); }
      }
    }

    renderScreen();
  }

  /** 外壳状态同步：桌面壁纸 + 小白条提示。屏幕内容由 renderScreen 负责 */
  function syncShell() {
    applyWall();
    if (session.homebarEl) session.homebarEl.title = session.tab === 'home' ? '主页' : '回到主页';
  }

  /**
   * 给 App 顶部栏补两样东西：左侧「主页」按钮、标题后面的条数统计。
   * 统一在这里注入，各 App 的渲染函数不用各自处理，将来加新 App 也自动带上。
   * 原来主页那块「概览」卡片区就是这么拆到各 App 头部的。
   */
  function decorateNav(el, id) {
    if (id === 'home' || !el || typeof el.querySelector !== 'function') return;

    // 仿真骨架（.tph-ui-head）里「回主页」按钮由 uiShell 自己出，这里只补条数统计。
    const uiHead = el.querySelector('.tph-ui-head');
    if (uiHead) {
      if (config.navStat && !uiHead.querySelector('.tph-nav-stat')) {
        const txt = appNavStat(id);
        if (txt) {
          const badge = h('span', { class: 'tph-badge tph-nav-stat', text: txt });
          const first = uiHead.childNodes.length ? uiHead.childNodes[0] : null;
          if (first) uiHead.insertBefore(badge, first.nextSibling);
          else uiHead.appendChild(badge);
        }
      }
      return;
    }

    const nav = el.querySelector('.tph-nav');
    if (!nav || typeof nav.querySelector !== 'function') return;
    const title = nav.querySelector('.tph-nav-title');

    if (config.navHome && title && !nav.querySelector('.tph-nav-home')) {
      const btn = h('button', { class: 'tph-nav-home', type: 'button', title: '回到主页', onclick: () => gotoApp('home') });
      btn.appendChild(iconSvg('house', 13));
      btn.appendChild(h('span', { text: '主页' }));
      nav.insertBefore(btn, title);
    }
    if (config.navStat && title && !nav.querySelector('.tph-nav-stat')) {
      const txt = appNavStat(id);
      if (txt) nav.insertBefore(h('span', { class: 'tph-badge tph-nav-stat', text: txt }), title.nextSibling);
    }
  }

  /** 屏幕渲染调度：每个 App 的 render 函数只接收容器，方便楼层内嵌复用同一套渲染 */
  function renderScreen() {
    const el = session.screenEl;
    if (el && session.root && HD.body.contains(session.root)) {
      clearChildren(el);
      const t = session.tab;
      if (t === 'wechat') renderWeChat(el);
      else if (t === 'moments') renderMoments(el);
      else if (t === 'call') renderCall(el);
      else if (t === 'tieba') renderTieba(el);
      else if (t === 'rednote') renderRedNote(el);
      else if (t === 'x') renderX(el);
      else if (t === 'memory') renderMemory(el);
      else if (t === 'calendar') renderCalendar(el);
      else if (t === 'profiles') renderProfiles(el);
      else if (t === 'game') renderGame(el);
      else if (t === 'stock') renderStock(el);
      else if (t === 'theater') renderTheater(el);
      else if (t === 'status') renderStatus(el);
      else if (t === 'music') renderMusic(el);
      else if (t === 'assistant') renderAssistant(el);
      else if (t === 'features') renderFeatures(el);
      else if (t === 'settings') renderSettings(el);
      else renderHome(el);
      decorateNav(el, t);

      // 通知面板浮层（点状态栏角标后展开）
      if (session.notifPanelOpen) {
        const overlay = h('div', { class: 'tph-notif-overlay' });
        const panel = h('div', { class: 'tph-notif-panel' });
        const head = h('div', { class: 'tph-notif-head' });
        head.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-notif-title', text: '通知' }));
        const closeBtn = h('button', { class: 'tph-btn xs ghost', type: 'button', onclick: () => { session.notifPanelOpen = false; markNotifRead(); renderScreen(); } }, ['全部已读 & 关闭']);
        head.appendChild(closeBtn);
        panel.appendChild(head);
        const list = h('div', { class: 'tph-notif-list' });
        const items = (session.notifications || []).slice();
        if (!items.length) {
          list.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-empty', text: '没有通知。' }));
        } else {
          items.forEach((n) => {
            const row = h('div', { class: 'tph-notif-row tph-notif-' + (n.level || 'info') });
            row.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-notif-time', text: fmtTime(n.ts) }));
            row.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-notif-msg', text: n.msg }));
            list.appendChild(row);
          });
        }
        panel.appendChild(list);
        overlay.appendChild(panel);
        overlay.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
          if (ev.target === overlay) { session.notifPanelOpen = false; renderScreen(); }
        });
        el.appendChild(overlay);
      }
    }
    // 入场标记只活一次 renderScreen：目标页可能不走 uiShell（聊天页/通话页/主页），
    // 不在这里清掉的话标记会残留，导致之后随便一次 uiShell 渲染都误放 zoom 动画
    session._appEnter = false;
    syncShell();
    // 楼层里那台手机跟着一起刷新（同一份数据，两处渲染）
    (session.inlineMounts || []).slice().forEach((m) => {
      if (m && typeof m.refresh === 'function') {
        try { m.refresh(); } catch (e) { softFail('楼层内嵌刷新', e); }
      }
    });
  }

  /** 局部重绘：不动其他界面状态（生成中刷新、播放状态变化时用） */
  function rerender() {
    renderScreen();
  }

  function destroyPhone() {
    session.destroyed = true;
    // 定时器
    try { if (session.clockTimer) clearInterval(session.clockTimer); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    try { if (session.inlineClockTimer) clearInterval(session.inlineClockTimer); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    try { if (session.inlineScanTimer) clearInterval(session.inlineScanTimer); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    try { if (session.inlineObserver) { session.inlineObserver.disconnect(); session.inlineObserver = null; } } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    try { if (session._heartbeatTimer) { clearInterval(session._heartbeatTimer); session._heartbeatTimer = null; } } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    try { clearCallTimers(); } catch (_e) { /* 通话定时器已清 */ }
    // toast 定时器
    try { if (session.toastTimer) { clearTimeout(session.toastTimer); session.toastTimer = null; } } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    // 摇一摇 devicemotion 监听
    try { if (typeof stopShakeMotion === 'function') stopShakeMotion(); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    // 朋友圈气泡的 document click 监听
    try { if (session._moDocClick) { HD.removeEventListener('click', session._moDocClick, true); session._moDocClick = null; } } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    // 通话联系人浮层的 document click 监听
    try { if (session._callDocCloser) { HD.removeEventListener('click', session._callDocCloser, true); session._callDocCloser = null; } } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    // 楼层挂载（tracked）
    try { unmountInline(); } catch (_e) { /* 楼层挂载已清 */ }
    // 全量孤儿清扫：清掉所有 .tph-inline 残留（持久化恢复的死 DOM）
    // 必须在删 <style> 之前做，否则孤儿失去 CSS 变成裸 HTML 死 UI
    try {
      const orphans = HD.querySelectorAll('.tph-inline');
      for (let i = 0; i < orphans.length; i++) {
        try { if (orphans[i].parentNode) orphans[i].parentNode.removeChild(orphans[i]); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
      }
    } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    // 清掉挂载点的 data-tph-done 标记（防下次脚本起来时被当成已挂载）
    try {
      const mounts = HD.querySelectorAll('[data-tph-done]');
      for (let i = 0; i < mounts.length; i++) {
        try { mounts[i].removeAttribute('data-tph-done'); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
      }
    } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    // 事件监听（经 on() 注册的 + battery levelchange）
    session.disposers.forEach((fn) => { try { fn(); } catch (_e) { /* */ } });
    session.disposers = [];
    // 挂在 HD.body 上的浮层
    try { if (session._wxPopMenu && session._wxPopMenu.parentNode) session._wxPopMenu.parentNode.removeChild(session._wxPopMenu); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    session._wxPopMenu = null;
    try { if (session._wxAtPop && session._wxAtPop.parentNode) session._wxAtPop.parentNode.removeChild(session._wxAtPop); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    session._wxAtPop = null;
    // 通话里 @ 拉人的联想浮层（通话页自己管，这里兜底清理）
    try { if (session._callAtPop && session._callAtPop.parentNode) session._callAtPop.parentNode.removeChild(session._callAtPop); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    session._callAtPop = null;
    try { if (session.toastEl && session.toastEl.parentNode) session.toastEl.parentNode.removeChild(session.toastEl); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    session.toastEl = null;
    // <style> 标签（孤儿已清，删 style 不会留裸 HTML）
    try { if (session.styleEl && session.styleEl.parentNode) session.styleEl.parentNode.removeChild(session.styleEl); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    session.styleEl = null;
    // 浮球 + 浮窗
    try { if (session.orbEl && session.orbEl.parentNode) session.orbEl.parentNode.removeChild(session.orbEl); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    try { if (session.root && session.root.parentNode) session.root.parentNode.removeChild(session.root); } catch (_e) { /* */ }
    session.orbEl = null;
    session.root = null;
    session.shellEl = null;
    session.screenEl = null;
    session.homebarEl = null;
    session.status = null;
    // 全局 API
    try {
      const w = hostWindow();
      if (w && w.TavernPhone) {
        try { w.TavernPhone._destroyed = true; } catch (_e) { /* */ }
        delete w.TavernPhone;
      }
    } catch (_e) { /* 清不掉全局也不影响 */ }
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // 7b. 事件层 + 更新中心（用户自由选择哪些内容被更新，以及触发方式）
  // ===========================================================================

  /** 更新项定义：id → { label, fn(silent) }。fn 返回 true/false 表示成功与否 */
  const UPDATE_TARGETS = [
    { id: 'chars',   label: '角色提取', fn: (s) => extractCharacters(s) },
    { id: 'calendar',label: '日历',     fn: (s) => calendarExtractAuto(s) },
    { id: 'memory',  label: '记忆总结', fn: (s) => memorySummarizeAuto(s) },
    { id: 'moments', label: '朋友圈',   fn: (s) => moAiPost(s) },
    { id: 'tieba',   label: '贴吧',     fn: (s) => tbAiGen(s) },
    { id: 'rednote', label: '小红书',   fn: (s) => rnAiGen(s) },
    { id: 'x',       label: 'X',        fn: (s) => xAiGen(s) },
    { id: 'status',  label: '状态栏',   fn: function(s) { return refreshStatus(s); } },
    { id: 'gacha',   label: '金钱提取', fn: (s) => gachaExtractAuto(s) },
    { id: 'stock',   label: '股市推进', fn: (s) => stockAdvanceDay(s) },   // 本地模拟，零 token，只推进交易日
  ];

  /**
   * 执行一次更新：按 config.update.targets 勾选项顺序调用，单项失败不中断。
   * silent=true 时不弹 toast、不 renderScreen（自动触发用）。
   */
  async function runUpdate(silent) {
    const u = config.update || {};
    const targets = Array.isArray(u.targets) ? u.targets : [];
    if (!targets.length) {
      if (!silent) notify('请先在「更新中心」勾选要更新的内容', 'warning');
      return;
    }
    if (session.updatePhase === 'running') {
      if (!silent) notify('更新进行中，请稍候', 'info');
      return;
    }
    session.updatePhase = 'running';
    if (!silent) renderScreen();

    const done = [];
    const failed = [];
    for (const id of targets) {
      const def = UPDATE_TARGETS.find((t) => t.id === id);
      if (!def) continue;
      try {
        const ok = await def.fn(true);
        if (ok) done.push(def.label);
        else failed.push(def.label);
      } catch (e) {
        softFail('更新·' + def.label, e);
        failed.push(def.label);
      }
    }

    session.updatePhase = 'idle';
    config.update.ranOnce = true;
    flushConfig();
    if (!silent) {
      let msg = '';
      if (done.length) msg += '已更新：' + done.join('、');
      if (failed.length) msg += (msg ? '；' : '') + '失败：' + failed.join('、');
      if (!msg) msg = '没有勾选任何更新项';
      notify(msg, failed.length && !done.length ? 'warning' : 'success');
      renderScreen();
    }
  }

  // —— 各模块的无 UI 副作用包装（统一返回 true/false）——

  async function memorySummarizeAuto(silent) {
    try {
      await memorySummarize(silent);
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      softFail('更新·记忆', e);
      return false;
    }
  }

  async function calendarExtractAuto(silent) {
    try {
      const depth = (config.extract && config.extract.floorRange) || 12;
      const transcript = await readTranscript(depth);
      if (!transcript || !transcript.trim()) { if (!silent) notify('没有可分析的聊天记录', 'warning'); return false; }
      const today = new Date();
      const todayStr = today.getFullYear() + '-' + String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
      const tmpl = promptText('calendarExtract');
      const prompt = tmpl.replace('{{transcript}}', transcript.slice(0, 8000)).replace('{{today}}', todayStr);
      const resp = await llm(prompt, '日历提取');
      if (!resp) { if (!silent) notify('日历提取失败：AI 没有返回', 'warning'); return false; }
      let parsed = extractJSON(resp);
      if (!parsed) { const stripped = resp.replace(/```json\s*/gi, '').replace(/```\s*/g, '').trim(); parsed = extractJSON(stripped); }
      if (!parsed || !Array.isArray(parsed.events)) { if (!silent) notify('日历提取失败：格式不正确', 'warning'); return false; }
      const n = mergeCalendar(parsed.events);
      if (!silent) notify(n ? '提取了 ' + n + ' 个日程' : '没有新日程', n ? 'success' : 'info');
      return n > 0;
    } catch (e) {
      softFail('更新·日历', e);
      return false;
    }
  }

  /** 查找酒馆事件常量（本窗 → 父窗） */
  function tavernEvents() {
    try {
      const w = hostWindow();
      return (window.tavern_events) || (w && w.tavern_events) || {};

  /**
   * 绑定酒馆事件。无 eventOn API 时静默跳过（演示模式不受影响）。
   * 每个监听注册一个 disposer，destroyPhone 时统一清理。
   */
  function bindEvents() {
    const eventOn = API.fn('eventOn');
    if (!eventOn) return;
    const eventRemove = API.fn('eventRemoveListener');

    // 按钮点击：酒馆助手点按钮时 emit button_id 事件（Script.vue:51），
    // 脚本必须通过 eventOn(getButtonEvent('按钮名'), callback) 注册监听才能收到。
    // 不注册的话按钮点击"没反应"。
    const getButtonEvent = API.fn('getButtonEvent');
    if (getButtonEvent) {
      try {
        const btnId = getButtonEvent.call(window, '小手机');
        if (btnId) {
          const handler = () => { try { togglePhone(); } catch (_e) { /* */ } };
          eventOn(btnId, handler);
          session.disposers.push(() => { try { if (eventRemove) eventRemove(btnId, handler); } catch (_e) { /* */ } });
        }
      } catch (_e) { /* 按钮事件注册失败忽略 */ }
    }
    const EV = tavernEvents();

    const on = (name, fn) => {
      try {
        const ret = eventOn(name, fn);
        session.disposers.push(() => {
          try {
            if (ret && typeof ret.stop === 'function') ret.stop();
            else if (typeof ret === 'function') ret();
            else if (eventRemove) eventRemove(name, fn);
          } catch (_e) { /* 解绑失败静默 */ }
        });
      } catch (e) { softFail('事件绑定:' + String(name), e); }
    };

    // 切换聊天：失效 chatKey 缓存 → 重载数据 → 重渲染
    if (EV.CHAT_CHANGED) {
      on(EV.CHAT_CHANGED, () => {
        try {
          invalidateChatKey();
          loadAllData();
          session.updateMsgCount = 0;
          if (session.visible) renderScreen();
          // 楼层挂载点可能因换聊天而变化
          setTimeout(() => { try { scanInlineMounts(); } catch (_e) { /* 扫描失败静默 */ } }, 300);
        } catch (e) { softFail('CHAT_CHANGED', e); }
      });
    }

    // AI 回复到达：失效 transcript 缓存 → 按更新模式触发
    if (EV.MESSAGE_RECEIVED) {
      on(EV.MESSAGE_RECEIVED, () => {
        try {
          session.updateMsgCount = (session.updateMsgCount || 0) + 1;
          const u = config.update || {};
          const mode = u.autoMode || 'manual';
          const targets = Array.isArray(u.targets) ? u.targets : [];

          // 自动模式需先手动跑过一次（防盲烧）
          if (mode !== 'manual' && targets.length && u.ranOnce && session.updatePhase === 'idle') {
            if (mode === 'onReply') {
              // 每次 AI 回复后触发
              setTimeout(() => { try { runUpdate(true); } catch (e) { softFail('autoUpdate', e); } }, 500);
            } else if (mode === 'everyN') {
              const n = Math.max(1, parseInt(u.n, 10) || 3);
              if (session.updateMsgCount % n === 0) {
                setTimeout(() => { try { runUpdate(true); } catch (e) { softFail('autoUpdate', e); } }, 500);
              }
            }
          }

          // memory.auto：AI 回复后自动总结（独立于更新中心，带相位锁防并发）
          // 静默执行，不调 renderScreen，避免打断用户滚动
          const mc = config.memory || {};
          if (mc.enabled && mc.auto && session.memoryPhase !== 'summarizing') {
            session.memoryPhase = 'summarizing';
            setTimeout(() => {
              (async () => {
                try { await memorySummarize(true); }
                catch (e) { softFail('autoMemory', e); }
                finally { session.memoryPhase = 'idle'; }
              })();
            }, 2000);
          }

          // —— 楼层指令：最新一条用户消息含「/麻将」或「🀄」→ 打开麻将牌桌 ——
          // 不阻塞上述逻辑；防重复：同一 message_id 只处理一次（session._mjLastTriggerMsgId）。
          (async () => {
            try {
              let msgs = await API.getMessages('-10--1');
              if (!msgs || !msgs.length) msgs = await API.getMessages('-10');
              if (!msgs || !msgs.length) msgs = readChatArray(10);
              if (!msgs || !msgs.length) return;
              // 从新到旧找到最新一条用户消息
              let lastUser = null;
              for (let i = msgs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                if (msgIsUser(msgs[i])) { lastUser = msgs[i]; break; }
              }
              if (!lastUser) return;
              const mid = msgIdOf(lastUser);
              const key = (mid != null) ? String(mid) : 't:' + String(msgText(lastUser)).slice(0, 60);
              if (!key || session._mjLastTriggerMsgId === key) return;
              session._mjLastTriggerMsgId = key;   // 先记录水位，同一楼层不再重复扫描/触发
              const body = msgText(lastUser) || '';
              if (body.indexOf('/麻将') >= 0 || body.indexOf('🀄') >= 0) {
                session.gameView = 'mahjong';
                gotoApp('game');
                notify('检测到麻将指令，已打开牌桌', 'success');
              }
            } catch (e) { softFail('麻将楼层指令', e); }
          })();
        } catch (e) { softFail('MESSAGE_RECEIVED', e); }
      });
    }
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // 9. 正则与世界书（楼层打通的两条腿）
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 占位符 <TPH/> 由 AI 输出；正则负责两件事：
  //   · promptOnly 条：从发给 AI 的上下文里抹掉占位符（AI 不会看见自己写过的标记）
  //   · markdownOnly 条：把占位符换成挂载点 <div data-tph-mount="…">，脚本再往里塞手机
  //
  // 挂载点只能用 data-* 定位 —— DOMPurify 会给 class 加 custom- 前缀，
  // 且 <script>/```围栏/<body> 在楼层里都不成立（详见 00-head.js 的硬约束）。
  // ===========================================================================

  const MOUNT_ATTR = 'data-tph-mount';

  /**
   * 正则脚本清单。
   * 顺序要紧：带 chan / view 的必须排在只带 app 的前面，裸占位符排最后，
   * 否则 <TPH app="wechat" chan="林知夏"/> 会先被通用规则吃掉，
   * <TPH app="game" view="mahjong"/> 的 view 也会被 app 规则的 [^>]*? 吞掉。
   */
  function tphRegexScripts() {
    const base = {
      trimStrings: [],
      placement: [2],          // 作用于 AI 输出
      disabled: false,
      markdownOnly: false,
      promptOnly: false,
      runOnEdit: true,
      substituteRegex: 0,
      minDepth: null,
      maxDepth: null,
    };
    return [
      Object.assign({}, base, {
        id: 'tph-hide-placeholder',
        scriptName: '[小手机] 01 占位符对 AI 隐藏',
        findRegex: '/<TPH\\b[^>]*\\/?>/gi',
        replaceString: '',
        promptOnly: true,
        markdownOnly: false,
        runOnEdit: false,
      }),
      Object.assign({}, base, {
        id: 'tph-render-chan',
        scriptName: '[小手机] 02 渲染 · 指定会话',
        findRegex: '/<TPH\\b[^>]*?\\bapp="([^"]+)"[^>]*?\\bchan="([^"]+)"[^>]*?\\/?>/gi',
        replaceString: '<div ' + MOUNT_ATTR + '="$1" data-tph-chan="$2"></div>',
        markdownOnly: true,
        promptOnly: false,
      }),
      Object.assign({}, base, {
        id: 'tph-render-view',
        scriptName: '[小手机] 02.5 渲染 · 指定界面视图',
        findRegex: '/<TPH\\b[^>]*?\\bapp="([^"]+)"[^>]*?\\bview="([^"]+)"[^>]*?\\/?>/gi',
        replaceString: '<div ' + MOUNT_ATTR + '="$1" data-tph-view="$2"></div>',
        markdownOnly: true,
        promptOnly: false,
      }),
      Object.assign({}, base, {
        id: 'tph-render-app',
        scriptName: '[小手机] 03 渲染 · 指定界面',
        findRegex: '/<TPH\\b[^>]*?\\bapp="([^"]+)"[^>]*?\\/?>/gi',
        replaceString: '<div ' + MOUNT_ATTR + '="$1"></div>',

  /** 把正则写进酒馆的正则脚本列表。失败则降级为复制 JSON */
  function installRegex() {
    const w = hostWindow();
    let ctx = null;
    try {
      ctx = (w && w.SillyTavern && typeof w.SillyTavern.getContext === 'function') ? w.SillyTavern.getContext() : null;
    } catch (_e) { ctx = null; }
    const settings = (ctx && ctx.extension_settings) || (w && w.extension_settings) || null;
    if (!settings || !Array.isArray(settings.regex)) {
      notify('当前酒馆没有开放正则写入接口（版本或权限限制）。已改为复制正则 JSON，请到「扩展 → 正则」手动导入。', 'warning');
      copyRegexJson();
      return false;
    }
    const want = tphRegexScripts();
    let added = 0;
    let updated = 0;
    want.forEach((sc) => {
      const i = settings.regex.findIndex((x) => x && (x.id === sc.id || x.scriptName === sc.scriptName));
      if (i >= 0) { settings.regex[i] = sc; updated++; } else { settings.regex.push(sc); added++; }
    });
    let saved = false;
    try {
      if (ctx && typeof ctx.saveSettingsDebounced === 'function') { ctx.saveSettingsDebounced(); saved = true; }
      else if (w && typeof w.saveSettingsDebounced === 'function') { w.saveSettingsDebounced(); saved = true; }
    } catch (_e) { /* 保存失败仍算写入，界面会提示 */ }
    notify('已写入正则：新增 ' + added + ' 条、更新 ' + updated + ' 条' + (saved ? '（设置已保存）' : '（未能自动保存，请在正则页手动点保存）') + '。若列表没刷新，切一下正则页即可。', 'success');
    return true;
  }

  /** 直接下载文件（世界书/正则 JSON 都可走这里，比复制更省事） */
  function downloadText(filename, text) {
    try {
      const blob = new HW.Blob([text], { type: 'application/json;charset=utf-8' });
      const url = HW.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = h('a', { href: url, download: filename });
      HD.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      HD.body.removeChild(a);
      setTimeout(() => { try { HW.URL.revokeObjectURL(url); } catch (_e) { /* 已回收 */ } }, 2000);
      notify('已开始下载 ' + filename);
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      notify('下载失败：' + errText(e), 'warning');
      return false;
    }
  }

  /** 正则自检：拿样本文本跑一遍替换链，确认三态标志和顺序都对 */
  function regexSelfTest() {
    const scripts = tphRegexScripts();
    const toRe = (s) => {
      const m = String(s).match(/^\/([\s\S]*)\/([gimsuy]*)$/);
      return m ? new RegExp(m[1], m[2]) : null;
    };
    const sample = [
      '（她把手机扣在桌上。）',
      '林知夏：都搬完了。',
      '',
      '<TPH/>',
      '<TPH app="wechat"/>',
      '<TPH app="wechat" chan="林知夏"/>',
      '<TPH app="game" view="mahjong"/>',
    ].join('\n');

    // 显示链：只跑 markdownOnly
    let shown = sample;
    scripts.filter((s) => s.markdownOnly && !s.promptOnly).forEach((s) => {
      const re = toRe(s.findRegex);
      if (re) shown = shown.replace(re, s.replaceString);
    });
    // 提示词链：只跑 promptOnly
    let prompted = sample;
    scripts.filter((s) => s.promptOnly && !s.markdownOnly).forEach((s) => {
      const re = toRe(s.findRegex);
      if (re) prompted = prompted.replace(re, s.replaceString);
    });

    return {
      mountHome: shown.indexOf('<div ' + MOUNT_ATTR + '="home"></div>') >= 0,
      mountWechat: shown.indexOf('<div ' + MOUNT_ATTR + '="wechat"></div>') >= 0,
      mountChan: shown.indexOf('data-tph-chan="林知夏"') >= 0,
      mountGameView: shown.indexOf('data-tph-view="mahjong"') >= 0 && shown.indexOf('<TPH') < 0,
      storyKept: shown.indexOf('都搬完了') >= 0,
      noRawPlaceholder: shown.indexOf('<TPH') < 0,
      promptClean: prompted.indexOf('TPH') < 0,
      promptKeepsStory: prompted.indexOf('都搬完了') >= 0,
    };
  }

      // 注意 position:relative 不能省 —— 船坞有 backdrop-filter，
      // 它会给绝对定位的子元素当包含块，角标会跑到船坞右上角去
      '.tph-dock-ic { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;',
      '  width: 50px; height: 50px; border-radius: 22.5%; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.3); }',
      '.tph-dock-nm { font-size: 10.5px; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.55); }',

      // 各 App 顶部栏：自动插入的「主页」按钮
      '.tph-nav-home { flex: 0 0 auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; height: 24px;',
      '  padding: 0 8px 0 5px; border: none; border-radius: var(--tph-pill); background: var(--tph-hover);',
      '  color: var(--tph-text); font-family: inherit; font-size: 11.5px; cursor: pointer; }',
      '.tph-nav-home:hover { background: var(--tph-border); }',

      // 缩放手柄
      '.tph-grip { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 16px; height: 16px; cursor: nwse-resize;',
      '  background: linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 45%, var(--tph-border) 45%, var(--tph-border) 58%, transparent 58%);',
      '  border-bottom-right-radius: var(--tph-shell-rad, 18px); touch-action: none; }',

      // ========================= 通用控件 =========================
      '.tph-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; padding: 7px 12px;',
      '  font-family: inherit; font-size: 12.5px; border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad-sm);',
      '  background: var(--tph-raised); color: var(--tph-text); cursor: pointer; transition: background .14s, opacity .14s; }',
      '.tph-btn:hover { background: var(--tph-hover); }',
      '.tph-btn:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }',
      '.tph-btn.primary { background: var(--tph-accent); border-color: var(--tph-accent); color: #fff; }',
      '.tph-btn.primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); }',
      '.tph-btn.ghost { background: transparent; }',
      '.tph-btn.danger { color: var(--tph-danger); border-color: var(--tph-danger); background: transparent; }',
      '.tph-btn.sm { padding: 5px 9px; font-size: 12px; }',
      '.tph-btn.xs { padding: 3px 7px; font-size: 11px; }',
      '.tph-btn.icon { padding: 5px; width: 28px; height: 28px; }',
      // 全局兜底：`hidden` 属性在带 display 的组件上不生效（作者规则盖过 UA 的
      // [hidden]{display:none}）。本项目大量组件自己写了 display，所以必须兜这一条，
      // 否则 el.hidden = true 会「设了个寂寞」。已踩过两次（抽屉计数徽章、清空按钮）。
      '.tph-root [hidden], .tph-inline [hidden] { display: none !important; }',
      '.tph-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px;',
      '  border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-pill); background: transparent; color: var(--tph-muted); cursor: pointer; }',
      '.tph-chip.on { background: var(--tph-accent); border-color: var(--tph-accent); color: #fff; }',
      '.tph-chip:hover { border-color: var(--tph-accent); }',
      // 抽屉式选择器（见 uiPickDrawer）：收起只占一行，点整行才铺开候选。
      // 取代原来「候选 chip 常驻铺开」的写法 —— 候选一多就占三四行，把下方内容顶出屏幕。
      '.tph-drawer { border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad);',
      '  background: var(--tph-surface); margin: 8px 0; overflow: hidden; }',
      '.tph-drawer-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%;',
      '  padding: 10px 11px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 12.5px; text-align: left;',
      '  background: none; border: none; color: var(--tph-text); cursor: pointer;',
      '  transition: background .14s; }',
      '.tph-drawer-head:hover { background: var(--tph-hover); }',
      '.tph-drawer-t { flex: 0 0 auto; font-weight: 500; }',
      // 摘要只缩不长：右侧要留给徽章与箭头，长了走省略号
      '.tph-drawer-sum { flex: 0 1 auto; min-width: 0; margin-left: auto; font-size: 11.5px;',
      '  color: var(--tph-muted); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }',
      // 有选择时摘要染上 App 主色，一眼区分「配好了」和「还没选」
      '.tph-drawer-sum[data-on="1"] { color: var(--tph-tint, var(--tph-accent)); }',
      '.tph-drawer-badge { flex: 0 0 auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;',
      '  min-width: 17px; height: 17px; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: var(--tph-pill);',
      '  background: var(--tph-accent); color: #fff; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 500; }',
      // 徽章的隐藏靠基础样式里那条全局 [hidden] 兜底（见 .tph-btn.icon 下方）
      '.tph-drawer-chev { flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; color: var(--tph-muted);',
      '  transition: transform .18s ease; }',
      '.tph-drawer.open .tph-drawer-chev { transform: rotate(180deg); }',
      '.tph-drawer-body { display: none; padding: 0 11px 11px; }',
      '.tph-drawer.open .tph-drawer-body { display: block; }',
      '.tph-drawer-hint { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--tph-muted); line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 8px; }',
      // 候选多了不撑高：抽屉内部滚动（约 4 行的位置封顶）
      '.tph-drawer-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; max-height: 168px;',
      '  overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; }',
      '.tph-input, .tph-textarea { width: 100%; padding: 7px 9px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--tph-text);',
      '  background: var(--tph-input); border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad-sm); outline: none; }',
      '.tph-input:focus, .tph-textarea:focus { border-color: var(--tph-accent); }',
      '.tph-input.xs { width: 72px; padding: 4px 6px; font-size: 12px; }',
      // 真机 App 的输入框不该有拖拽手柄（截图里每个框右下角那两道斜线）。
      // 全项目 15 处 textarea 里，只有设置页的 JSON/配置粘贴框值得留手柄（.tph-monobox 单独恢复）。
      // field-sizing: content → 框随内容长高（Chrome 123+）；不支持时退化为原来的固定高度，
      // 不会更差。max-height 封顶，免得 400 字的「背景故事」把整页撑穿。
      '.tph-textarea { min-height: 64px; max-height: 240px; resize: none; line-height: 1.55; field-sizing: content; }',
      '.tph-sw { position: relative; width: 38px; height: 21px; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: var(--tph-pill);',
      '  background: var(--tph-border); cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s; flex: 0 0 auto; }',
      '.tph-sw i { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 17px; height: 17px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff;',
      '  transition: transform .16s ease; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3); }',
      '.tph-sw.on { background: var(--tph-accent); }',
      '.tph-sw.on i { transform: translateX(17px); }',
      '.tph-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 7px; }',
      '.tph-row .tph-input:not(.xs) { flex: 1 1 auto; margin: 0; }',
      '.tph-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--tph-muted); margin: 9px 0 5px; }',
      '.tph-label.inline { margin: 0; flex: 0 0 auto; }',
      '.tph-hint { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--tph-dim); line-height: 1.5; margin: 4px 0; }',
      '.tph-hint.inline { margin: 0; flex: 1 1 auto; }',
      '.tph-hint-x { margin: 4px 0; }',
      '.tph-hint-x-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 5px; }',
      '.tph-hint-more { display: none; }',
      '.tph-hint-more[data-on="1"] { display: block; }',
      '.tph-q { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 15px; height: 15px; padding: 0; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1;',
      '  border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: var(--tph-dim); cursor: pointer; }',
      '.tph-sep { height: 1px; background: var(--tph-border); margin: 10px 0; }',
      '.tph-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin: 8px 0; }',
      '.tph-empty { padding: 24px 16px; text-align: center; color: var(--tph-dim); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.7; }',
      '.tph-bar { height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--tph-border); overflow: hidden; margin: 8px 0; }',
      '.tph-bar i { display: block; height: 100%; width: 40%; background: var(--tph-accent); border-radius: 2px;',
      '  animation: tph-slide 1.1s ease-in-out infinite; }',
      '@keyframes tph-slide { 0% { transform: translateX(-100%); } 100% { transform: translateX(320%); } }',
      '.tph-fold { border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad); margin: 8px 0; overflow: hidden; }',
      '.tph-fold-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; width: 100%; padding: 7px 10px; text-align: left;',
      '  border: none; background: var(--tph-head); color: var(--tph-text); font-family: inherit; font-size: 12.5px; cursor: pointer; }',
      '.tph-fold-head:hover { background: var(--tph-hover); }',
      '.tph-fold-caret { color: var(--tph-dim); font-size: 11px; }',
      '.tph-fold-title { font-weight: 500; }',
      '.tph-fold-sum { margin-left: auto; font-size: 11px; color: var(--tph-dim); }',
      '.tph-fold-body { display: none; padding: 10px; background: var(--tph-surface); }',
      '.tph-fold-body[data-open="1"] { display: block; }',

      // 头像
      '.tph-ava { position: relative; flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;',
      '  overflow: hidden; color: #fff; font-weight: 500; background: var(--tph-raised); user-select: none; }',
      '.tph-ava img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; }',
      '.tph-ava span { font-size: 42%; }',
      '.tph-ava-circle { border-radius: 50%; }',
      '.tph-ava-rounded { border-radius: 28%; }',
      '.tph-ava-square { border-radius: 4px; }',
      // 页面顶部导航（App 内部通用）
      '.tph-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 3; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;',
      '  padding: 8px 10px; background: var(--tph-head); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--tph-border); }',
      '.tph-nav-title { flex: 1 1 auto; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; overflow: hidden;',
      '  text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }',
      '.tph-nav-btn { flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 26px; height: 26px;',
      '  padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: var(--tph-text); cursor: pointer; }',
      '.tph-nav-btn:hover { background: var(--tph-hover); }',
      '.tph-nav-btn[data-on="1"] { background: var(--tph-hover); }',
      // 徽章不换行、不被 flex 压缩。它会被塞进 .tph-ui-head 这类 flex 容器，
      // flex-shrink 默认 1，导航栏一挤「3 份档案」就折成两行，撑高整条顶栏。
      '.tph-badge { padding: 1px 6px; font-size: 10.5px; border-radius: var(--tph-pill); flex: 0 0 auto;',
      '  white-space: nowrap; background: var(--tph-hover); color: var(--tph-muted); }',

      // ========================= 通用卡片 =========================
      '.tph-card { padding: 11px 12px; background: var(--tph-surface); border: 1px solid var(--tph-border);',
      '  border-radius: var(--tph-rad); margin-bottom: 9px; }',
      '.tph-card-title { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 6px; }',

      // ========================= 仿真 App 骨架 =========================
      // 竖向结构固定为：顶栏 / 二级标签栏 / 下拉提示 / 滚动内容区 / 底部导航。
      // height:100%（而非 min-height）让 .tph-ui 定高，.tph-ui-body 才能成为真正的
      // 滚动容器（min-height 时容器被内容撑开，body 永不溢出，滚轮/无限加载全失效），
      // 顶栏与底部导航随之真正固定，不随内容卷走。
      '.tph-ui { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; background: var(--tph-bg); }',
      '.tph-ui-head { flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 12px;',
      '  background: var(--tph-head); color: var(--tph-text); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--tph-border); }',
      '.tph-ui[data-app="tieba"] .tph-ui-head, .tph-ui[data-app="rednote"] .tph-ui-head {',
      '  background: var(--tph-tint); color: #fff; border-bottom-color: rgba(0,0,0,.08); }',
      '.tph-ui-title { flex: 1 1 auto; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; padding-left: 3px; overflow: hidden;',
      '  text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }',
      '.tph-ui-back { flex: 0 0 auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 1px; padding: 3px 7px 3px 2px;',
      '  border: none; border-radius: var(--tph-rad-sm); background: transparent; color: inherit;',
      '  font-family: inherit; font-size: 12.5px; cursor: pointer; }',
      '.tph-ui-back:hover { background: rgba(128,128,128,.18); }',
      '.tph-ui-act { position: relative; flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;',
      '  width: 30px; height: 30px; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent;',
      '  color: inherit; cursor: pointer; }',
      '.tph-ui-act:hover { background: rgba(128,128,128,.18); }',
      '.tph-ui-act-badge { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; min-width: 14px; height: 14px; padding: 0 3px;',
      '  border-radius: var(--tph-pill); background: #f5222d; color: #fff; font-size: 9.5px; line-height: 14px;',
      '  text-align: center; }',

      // 顶栏搜索框（真能输入，输入即过滤）
      '.tph-ui-search { flex: 1 1 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; height: 30px;',
      '  padding: 0 10px; border-radius: var(--tph-pill); background: var(--tph-input); color: var(--tph-muted); }',
      '.tph-ui[data-app="tieba"] .tph-ui-search, .tph-ui[data-app="rednote"] .tph-ui-search {',
      '  background: rgba(255,255,255,.94); color: #9aa0a6; }',
      '.tph-ui-search-in { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; padding: 0; border: none; outline: none; background: transparent;',
      '  font-family: inherit; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--tph-text); }',
      '.tph-ui[data-app="tieba"] .tph-ui-search-in, .tph-ui[data-app="rednote"] .tph-ui-search-in { color: #1c1d1f; }',
      '.tph-ui-search-x { flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 16px; height: 16px;',
      '  padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(128,128,128,.32); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; }',

      // 二级标签栏（推荐 / 热门 / 关注 这类）
      '.tph-ui-subtabs { flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 4px; padding: 0 12px;',
      '  background: var(--tph-surface); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--tph-border); overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; }',
      '.tph-ui-subtabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }',
      '.tph-ui-subtab { position: relative; flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 10px 14px 9px; border: none; background: transparent;',
      '  color: var(--tph-muted); font-family: inherit; font-size: 13.5px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; }',
      '.tph-ui-subtab.on { color: var(--tph-text); font-weight: 500; }',
      '.tph-ui-subtab.on::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 0; width: 18px; height: 2px;',
      '  margin-left: -9px; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--tph-tint); }',

      // 下拉刷新提示条（高度默认 0，拖拽时才撑开）
      '.tph-ui-pull { flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px;',
      '  height: 0; overflow: hidden; color: var(--tph-dim); font-size: 11.5px; transition: height .18s ease; }',
      '.tph-ui-pull[data-on="1"] { transition: none; }',
      '.tph-ui-pull svg { animation: tph-spin 1s linear infinite; animation-play-state: paused; }',
      '.tph-ui-pull[data-on="1"] svg { animation-play-state: running; }',
      '@keyframes tph-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }',

      // 滚动内容区
      '.tph-ui-body { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden; overscroll-behavior: contain;',
      '  scrollbar-width: thin; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }',
      '.tph-ui-body::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }',
      '.tph-ui-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--tph-border); border-radius: 3px; }',

      // 底部导航栏
      '.tph-ui-foot { flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: stretch; padding: 6px 4px 8px;',
      '  background: var(--tph-head); border-top: 1px solid var(--tph-border); }',
      '.tph-ui[data-app="x"] .tph-ui-foot { background: var(--tph-surface); }',
      '.tph-ui-tab { position: relative; flex: 1 1 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px;',
      '  padding: 5px 0 3px; border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--tph-dim); font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; }',
      '.tph-ui-tab-nm { font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.1; }',
      '.tph-ui-tab.on { color: var(--tph-tint); }',
      '.tph-ui-tab-badge { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 50%; margin-left: 3px; min-width: 14px; height: 14px;',
      '  padding: 0 3px; border-radius: var(--tph-pill); background: #f5222d; color: #fff; font-size: 9.5px;',
      '  line-height: 14px; text-align: center; }',

      // ========================= 伪封面 =========================
      // 按种子生成稳定的双色渐变 + 两个错位浅色形状，看起来像一张「有内容的配图」。
      '.tph-cover { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--tph-rad-sm);',
      '  background-image: linear-gradient(152deg, var(--c1), var(--c2)); }',
      '.tph-cover-o1 { position: absolute; left: -14%; top: -30%; width: 62%; height: 96%; border-radius: 50%;',
      '  background: var(--c3); opacity: .5; }',
      '.tph-cover-o2 { position: absolute; right: -10%; bottom: -34%; width: 54%; height: 74%;',
      '  border-radius: 40% 60% 55% 45%; background: rgba(255,255,255,.22); }',
      '.tph-cover::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 48%; z-index: 1;',
      '  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,.34), rgba(0,0,0,0)); pointer-events: none; }',
      '.tph-cover-label { position: absolute; left: 7px; bottom: 6px; right: 7px; z-index: 2; font-size: 10.5px;',
      '  line-height: 1.35; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.45); overflow: hidden;',
      '  display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; }',
      '.tph-cover-x { position: absolute; right: 6px; bottom: 6px; z-index: 2; padding: 1px 5px;',
      '  border-radius: var(--tph-pill); background: rgba(0,0,0,.32); color: #fff; font-size: 9.5px; }',

      // ========================= 富文本（#话题 / @某人） =========================
      '.tph-rich-body { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.65; word-break: break-word; }',
      '.tph-rich-line[data-strong="1"] { font-weight: 500; }',
      '.tph-rich-gap { height: 7px; }',
      '.tph-tag, .tph-at { color: var(--tph-tint); cursor: pointer; }',
      '.tph-tag:hover, .tph-at:hover { text-decoration: underline; }',

      // 点赞 / 收藏的按压反馈
      '.tph-pop { animation: tph-pop .34s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); }',
      '@keyframes tph-pop { 0% { transform: scale(1); } 38% { transform: scale(1.3); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }',

      // 摇一摇：微信发现页摇一摇时给手机外壳加一次抖动
      '.tph-shell.tph-shake { animation: tph-shake .6s ease-in-out; }',
      '@keyframes tph-shake { 0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); } 15% { transform: translateX(-6px) rotate(-1deg); } 30% { transform: translateX(6px) rotate(1deg); } 45% { transform: translateX(-5px) rotate(-.8deg); } 60% { transform: translateX(5px) rotate(.8deg); } 75% { transform: translateX(-3px); } }',

      // ========================= 空状态 / 分组 / 行 / 加载更多 =========================
      '.tph-blank { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; padding: 40px 24px; text-align: center; min-height: 58%; }',
      // 整页只有空态时用（小剧场/状态栏）—— 撑满滚动区，内容落在正中，而不是吊在上半屏留一大片空
      '.tph-blank.fill { min-height: 100%; }',
      // 图标底用主题淡色而不是 --tph-hover：hover 色本身就是"可交互"的语义，
