  /**
   * 皮肤规则：由 13b（液态玻璃）/ 13c（夜之城）各自提供，函数声明提升后在此拼接。
   * 每套皮肤只通过 [data-skin="…"] 作用域覆盖变量与加装饰，不碰 default 的任何规则。
   */
  function skinRules() {
    return glassSkinRules().concat(nightCitySkinRules());
  }

  /**
   * 无障碍与动效偏好规则。放最后拼接 —— 焦点环与命中区要盖住前面的基础样式。
   * 三件事：
   *   1. :focus-visible 焦点环 —— 基础样式里多处 outline:none（为了鼠标点击不出现难看的框），
   *      但键盘用户必须能看见焦点在哪。:focus-visible 只在键盘导航时命中，两者不冲突。
   *   2. prefers-reduced-motion —— 系统开了「减弱动效」就别再转了（前庭敏感用户会不适）。
   *   3. 24px 命中区 —— WCAG 2.5.8 要求可点目标不小于 24×24，小图标按钮用伪元素撑开，
   *      只扩点击范围不改视觉尺寸。
   */
  function a11yRules() {
    return [
      // ========================= 无障碍 =========================
      // 焦点环。作用域限定在 tph-* 内，绝不外溢到酒馆自身。
      '.tph-root :focus-visible, .tph-inline :focus-visible, .tph-orb:focus-visible {',
      '  outline: 2px solid var(--tph-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }',
      // 壁纸态是深色底 + 白字，蓝色焦点环压在上面几乎看不见 → 换白色
      '.tph-shell[data-wall] :focus-visible, .tph-inline-frame[data-wall] :focus-visible {',
      '  outline-color: #fff; }',
      // 键盘聚焦时把可点的 div 行也标出来（它们靠 JS 加的 .tph-tap 语义类识别）
      '.tph-rowline.tap:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--tph-accent); outline-offset: -2px; }',

      // 命中区：小于 24px 的图标按钮用伪元素撑到 24px（min-* 保证大按钮不受影响）
      '.tph-sb-close, .tph-ui-search-x, .tph-music-del { position: relative; }',
      '.tph-sb-close::after, .tph-ui-search-x::after, .tph-music-del::after {',
      '  content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%);',
      '  width: 24px; height: 24px; min-width: 100%; min-height: 100%; }',

      // 减弱动效：系统开了就关掉所有过渡与动画。
      // 不用 display:none 也不用 0s（0s 会让依赖 transitionend 的逻辑永远等不到），
      // 取 .01ms —— 动画瞬间跑完，transitionend 照常触发，不吃任何状态机。
      '@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {',
      '  .tph-root *, .tph-root *::before, .tph-root *::after,',
      '  .tph-inline *, .tph-inline *::before, .tph-inline *::after,',
      '  .tph-orb, .tph-orb * {',
      '    animation-duration: .01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;',
      '    transition-duration: .01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }',
      '}',
    ];
  }

  /** 头像尺寸规则从 AVA_SIZES 生成，保证调用方用到的每一档都有宽高（不然会被 flex 压扁） */
  function avaRules() {
    return AVA_SIZES.map((n) => '.tph-ava.sz' + n + ' { width: ' + n + 'px; height: ' + n + 'px; font-size: '
      + Math.round(n * 0.5) + 'px; }');
  }

  /**
   * 壁纸规则从 WALLPAPERS 生成（单一数据源：加一套壁纸只要改 01-constants 的数组）。
   * 壁纸铺在外壳上而不是屏幕上 —— 这样状态栏和底部小白条也一起压在壁纸上，不会出现断层。
   */
  function wallRules() {
    return WALLPAPERS.map((w) => '.tph-shell[data-wall="' + w.id + '"],'
      + ' .tph-inline-frame[data-wall="' + w.id + '"] { background-image: ' + w.css + '; }');
  }

  /** 把样式注入宿主文档（只注一次；已存在则替换内容，便于开发期热改） */
  function ensureStyle() {
    const id = NS + '-style';
    let el = HD.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) {
      el = HD.createElement('style');
      el.id = id;
      (HD.head || HD.documentElement).appendChild(el);
      session.styleEl = el;
    }
    el.textContent = cssText();
    return el;
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // 8b. 皮肤 · 液态玻璃（iOS 26 Liquid Glass 语言）
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 挂载方式：.tph-root[data-skin="glass"] / .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"]
  // 只覆盖 CSS 变量 + 少量装饰规则，不改任何组件类名。
  //
  // 分层策略（性能）：
  //   玻璃层 —— 外壳、顶栏/底栏/粘性导航、卡片面板、通知面板、船坞这类
  //             「每屏个位数」的结构件，加 backdrop-filter 出真模糊；
  //   性能层 —— 列表行 / 卡片流（.tph-wx-item / .tph-tb-card / .tph-x-card /
  //             .tph-rn-card 等每屏几十个的）绝不加 backdrop-filter，
  //             半透明感全部由变量（--tph-surface / --tph-row）提供。
  // 注意：外壳绝不能用 background 简写 —— 会把壁纸的 background-image 一起重置掉，
  //       高光渐变只能走 background-image 长手并避开 [data-wall] 态。
  // 老浏览器不支持 backdrop-filter 时，@supports 块把半透明全部换回实色。
  // ===========================================================================

  /** 液态玻璃皮肤的 CSS 规则（被 13-css.js 的 skinRules() 拼接） */
  function glassSkinRules() {
    return [
      // —— 变量覆盖 · 浅色：表面全半透明白、圆角加大、accent 提饱和（iOS 蓝 → 紫）——
      '.tph-root[data-skin="glass"], .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] {',
      '  --tph-bg: rgba(243,245,248,.36); --tph-surface: rgba(255,255,255,.62); --tph-raised: rgba(255,255,255,.72);',
      '  --tph-head: rgba(255,255,255,.5); --tph-input: rgba(255,255,255,.45); --tph-hover: rgba(20,40,90,.06);',
      '  --tph-border: rgba(255,255,255,.55); --tph-row: rgba(255,255,255,.3);',
      '  --tph-accent: #0a84ff; --tph-accent-2: #8a5cf6; --tph-danger: #ff3b30;',
      '  --tph-bubble-me: rgba(142,232,100,.55); --tph-bubble-me-text: #14300c;',
      '  --tph-bubble-other: rgba(255,255,255,.62); --tph-bubble-other-text: #1c1d1f;',
      '  --tph-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(20,30,60,.16), 0 4px 16px rgba(20,30,60,.08); --tph-rad: 16px; --tph-rad-lg: 22px; --tph-rad-sm: 10px;',
      '}',

      // —— 变量覆盖 · 深色：白黑系半透明，圆角继承浅色块不用重写 ——
      '.tph-root[data-theme="dark"][data-skin="glass"], .tph-inline[data-theme="dark"][data-skin="glass"] {',
      '  --tph-bg: rgba(16,17,21,.44); --tph-surface: rgba(40,42,48,.55); --tph-raised: rgba(54,57,64,.62);',
      '  --tph-head: rgba(28,30,36,.55); --tph-input: rgba(255,255,255,.07); --tph-hover: rgba(255,255,255,.08);',
      '  --tph-border: rgba(255,255,255,.14); --tph-row: rgba(255,255,255,.045);',
      '  --tph-accent: #3f9dff; --tph-accent-2: #a07bff; --tph-danger: #ff453a;',
      '  --tph-bubble-me: rgba(47,107,69,.62); --tph-bubble-me-text: #eaf6ec;',
      '  --tph-bubble-other: rgba(44,46,52,.62); --tph-bubble-other-text: #e8e9ea;',
      '  --tph-shadow: 0 20px 56px rgba(0,0,0,.55), 0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.35);',
      '}',

      // —— 玻璃壳：整台手机的毛玻璃底 + 上下内高光 ——
      '.tph-shell[data-skin="glass"], .tph-root[data-skin="glass"] .tph-shell,',
      '.tph-inline-frame[data-skin="glass"], .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] .tph-inline-frame {',
      '  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(180%); backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(180%);',
      '  border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.55);',
      '  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.28), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08), var(--tph-shadow);',
      '}',

      // 壳内顶部一层极淡的高光渐变（只走 background-image 长手；壁纸态避开，不然会盖掉壁纸）
      '.tph-shell[data-skin="glass"]:not([data-wall]), .tph-root[data-skin="glass"] .tph-shell:not([data-wall]), .tph-inline-frame[data-skin="glass"]:not([data-wall]), .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] .tph-inline-frame:not([data-wall]) {',
      '  background-image: linear-gradient(168deg, rgba(255,255,255,.14), rgba(255,255,255,0) 42%);',
      '}',

      // 深色下白描边收暗一点，避免壳的轮廓过亮
      '.tph-root[data-theme="dark"][data-skin="glass"] .tph-shell, .tph-inline[data-theme="dark"][data-skin="glass"] .tph-inline-frame {',
      '  border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.16);',
      '}',

      // 壁纸态：玻璃壳只加一圈边缘光，不糊壁纸本身
      '.tph-shell[data-skin="glass"][data-wall], .tph-root[data-skin="glass"] .tph-shell[data-wall],',
      '.tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] .tph-inline-frame[data-wall] {',
      '  border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.26);',
      '  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.3), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.1), inset 0 0 34px rgba(255,255,255,.06), 0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.32);',
      '}',

      // —— 玻璃层 · 栏：App 顶栏 / 底栏 / 粘性导航 / 聊天输入条（每屏个位数）——
      // 内容真正会从下面滚过去的只有 .tph-nav 和 .tph-wx-input 两个 sticky 条，
      // 其余是骨架固定栏，模糊属于质感加成。状态栏不参与：壳的 blur 已垫在它底下。
      '.tph-root[data-skin="glass"] .tph-ui-head, .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] .tph-ui-head,',
      '.tph-root[data-skin="glass"] .tph-ui-foot, .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] .tph-ui-foot,',
      '.tph-root[data-skin="glass"] .tph-nav, .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] .tph-nav,',
      '.tph-root[data-skin="glass"] .tph-wx-input, .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] .tph-wx-input {',
      '  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(160%); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(160%);',
      '  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.22);',
      '}',

      // 贴吧 / 小红书品牌色顶栏：tint 调成半透明玻璃；color-mix 不支持时回退实色，白字不会糊
      '.tph-root[data-skin="glass"] .tph-ui[data-app="tieba"] .tph-ui-head, .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] .tph-ui[data-app="tieba"] .tph-ui-head,',
      '.tph-root[data-skin="glass"] .tph-ui[data-app="rednote"] .tph-ui-head, .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] .tph-ui[data-app="rednote"] .tph-ui-head {',
      '  background: var(--tph-tint);',
      '  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tph-tint) 72%, transparent);',
      '}',

      // —— 玻璃层 · 卡片面板：卡片 / 记忆条 / 发布框 / 折叠块 / 帖子菜单 / 通知面板 ——
      // 1px 白描边 + 顶部内高光，模拟「渐变描边」的玻璃厚度感
      '.tph-root[data-skin="glass"] .tph-card, .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] .tph-card,',
      '.tph-root[data-skin="glass"] .tph-mem-item, .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] .tph-mem-item,',
      '.tph-root[data-skin="glass"] .tph-tb-compose, .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] .tph-tb-compose,',
      '.tph-root[data-skin="glass"] .tph-fold, .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] .tph-fold,',
      '.tph-root[data-skin="glass"] .tph-tb-menu, .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] .tph-tb-menu,',
      '.tph-root[data-skin="glass"] .tph-notif-panel, .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] .tph-notif-panel {',
      '  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(160%); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(160%);',
      '  border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.55);',
      '  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.3), 0 6px 22px rgba(20,30,60,.08);',
      '}',

      // 通知面板是悬浮模态，平时没有边框，补一圈白描边才有玻璃片的形状
      '.tph-root[data-skin="glass"] .tph-notif-panel, .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] .tph-notif-panel { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4); }',

      // 深色下卡片描边与投影收敛：白描边转弱、外投影换成纯黑大扩散
      '.tph-root[data-theme="dark"][data-skin="glass"] .tph-card, .tph-inline[data-theme="dark"][data-skin="glass"] .tph-card,',
      '.tph-root[data-theme="dark"][data-skin="glass"] .tph-mem-item, .tph-inline[data-theme="dark"][data-skin="glass"] .tph-mem-item,',
      '.tph-root[data-theme="dark"][data-skin="glass"] .tph-tb-compose, .tph-inline[data-theme="dark"][data-skin="glass"] .tph-tb-compose,',
      '.tph-root[data-theme="dark"][data-skin="glass"] .tph-fold, .tph-inline[data-theme="dark"][data-skin="glass"] .tph-fold,',
      '.tph-root[data-theme="dark"][data-skin="glass"] .tph-tb-menu, .tph-inline[data-theme="dark"][data-skin="glass"] .tph-tb-menu,',
      '.tph-root[data-theme="dark"][data-skin="glass"] .tph-notif-panel, .tph-inline[data-theme="dark"][data-skin="glass"] .tph-notif-panel {',
      '  border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.14);',
      '  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.09), 0 8px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.3);',
      '}',

      // 船坞（桌面底部）：基础样式本就带模糊，玻璃皮肤下加深加饱和 + 顶部内高光
      '.tph-root[data-skin="glass"] .tph-dock, .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] .tph-dock {',
      '  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%);',
      '  background: rgba(255,255,255,.2); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.3);',
      '  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35), 0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.22);',
      '}',

      // 开关轨道改用淡墨色：白描边体系里 track 若还吃白变量会和卡片糊在一起
      ':is(.tph-root, .tph-inline)[data-skin="glass"] .tph-sw { background: rgba(20,40,90,.14); }',

      // —— 性能层：列表行 / 卡片流（每屏几十个）——
      // 绝不加 backdrop-filter：.tph-tb-card / .tph-tb-msg / .tph-x-card / .tph-x-noti /
      // .tph-rn-card / .tph-rn-goods 等卡片流的半透明直接吃 --tph-surface 变量；
      // 分隔行式列表（微信会话、朋友圈、回复流）只给一层极淡的 --tph-row 冰霜底。
      // 这里用 :is() 压选择器长度：极老浏览器丢了这条也只是回到透明行，无伤大雅。
      ':is(.tph-root, .tph-inline)[data-skin="glass"] :is(.tph-wx-item, .tph-tb-reply, .tph-rn-comment, .tph-mo-item, .tph-rowline) {',
      '  background: var(--tph-row);',
      '}',
      // 上面那条优先级高于基础 hover，会盖掉悬停反馈 —— 补一条更高优先级的还回去
      ':is(.tph-root, .tph-inline)[data-skin="glass"] :is(.tph-wx-item, .tph-rowline.tap):hover { background: var(--tph-hover); }',
      // 小红书瀑布流卡片圆角对齐玻璃圆角
      ':is(.tph-root, .tph-inline)[data-skin="glass"] .tph-rn-card { border-radius: var(--tph-rad); }',

      // —— 微信气泡：me 玻璃绿 / other 半透明白玻璃（底色走变量，这里补高光描边）——
      ':is(.tph-root, .tph-inline)[data-skin="glass"] .tph-wx-bubble {',
      '  border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.5); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.38);',
      '}',
      ':is(.tph-root, .tph-inline)[data-skin="glass"] .tph-wx-msg.me .tph-wx-bubble {',
      '  background: var(--tph-bubble-me); color: var(--tph-bubble-me-text); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.42);',
      '  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.32), 0 2px 10px rgba(35,105,45,.16);',
      '}',

      // 深色气泡的白描边收敛，不然黑玻璃上圈一圈亮边太吵
      ':is(.tph-root, .tph-inline)[data-theme="dark"][data-skin="glass"] :is(.tph-wx-bubble, .tph-wx-msg.me .tph-wx-bubble) {',
      '  border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.16);',
      '}',

      // —— 兼容降级：不支持 backdrop-filter 的老浏览器，半透明全部换回实色，防止糊成一团 ——
      '@supports not ((backdrop-filter: blur(1px)) or (-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(1px))) {',
      '  .tph-root[data-skin="glass"], .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] {',
      '    --tph-bg: #f2f3f5; --tph-surface: #fafbfc; --tph-raised: #ffffff; --tph-head: #f7f8fa;',
      '    --tph-input: #eef0f3; --tph-row: rgba(0,0,0,.02); --tph-border: rgba(0,0,0,.12);',
      '    --tph-bubble-me: #95ec69; --tph-bubble-other: #ffffff; --tph-shadow: 0 10px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.16);',
      '  }',
      '  .tph-root[data-theme="dark"][data-skin="glass"], .tph-inline[data-theme="dark"][data-skin="glass"] {',
      '    --tph-bg: #131417; --tph-surface: #1f2124; --tph-raised: #26282c; --tph-head: #1a1b1f;',
      '    --tph-input: #24262a; --tph-row: rgba(255,255,255,.03); --tph-border: rgba(255,255,255,.12);',
      '    --tph-bubble-me: #2f6b45; --tph-bubble-other: #24262a; --tph-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5);',
      '  }',
      '  .tph-shell[data-skin="glass"], .tph-root[data-skin="glass"] .tph-shell, .tph-inline-frame[data-skin="glass"], .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] .tph-inline-frame {',
      '    background-color: var(--tph-bg); border-color: var(--tph-border);',
      '  }',
      '  .tph-root[data-skin="glass"] .tph-ui[data-app="tieba"] .tph-ui-head, .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] .tph-ui[data-app="tieba"] .tph-ui-head,',
      '  .tph-root[data-skin="glass"] .tph-ui[data-app="rednote"] .tph-ui-head, .tph-inline[data-skin="glass"] .tph-ui[data-app="rednote"] .tph-ui-head {',
      '    background: var(--tph-tint);',
      '  }',
      '}',
    ];
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // 8c. 皮肤 · 夜之城（赛博朋克 2077 / SAMURAI OS）
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 挂载方式：.tph-root[data-skin="nightcity"] / .tph-inline[data-skin="nightcity"]
  // 强制深色：浅色/深色主题下都走暗黑变量。
  // 视觉基调（Cyberpunk 2077 官方 UI 色）：霓虹黄 #FCEE0A（SAMURAI 标志黄）主强调，
  // 电子青 #00F0FF 次强调，用品红 #FF2E88 / 官方红 #FF003C 做 danger；
  // 表面一律深黑蓝，直角锐利边框，扫描线 + 色差 glitch + HUD 角标全靠 CSS 装饰。
  // ===========================================================================

  /** 夜之城皮肤的 CSS 规则（被 13-css.js 的 skinRules() 拼接） */
  function nightCitySkinRules() {
    // 两种挂载形态（浮窗 / 楼层内嵌）共用一个作用域前缀
    const SC = ':is(.tph-root, .tph-inline)[data-skin="nightcity"]';
    return [
      // ------------------------- 变量覆盖 -------------------------
      // 基础 + 明暗主题两种组合一起写死：皮肤永远夜之城，不随主题翻面。
      // 主题组合选择器多带一个属性，无论拼接顺序如何都能压过主题变量块。
      SC + ',',
      ':is(.tph-root, .tph-inline)[data-theme="light"][data-skin="nightcity"],',
      ':is(.tph-root, .tph-inline)[data-theme="dark"][data-skin="nightcity"] {',
      '  --tph-bg: #0a0a0f; --tph-surface: #12121a; --tph-raised: #171722; --tph-head: #0e0e15; --tph-input: #0d0d16;',
      '  --tph-hover: rgba(0,240,255,.08); --tph-border: rgba(252,238,10,.22);',
      '  --tph-text: #e8eaf0; --tph-muted: #9aa3b2; --tph-dim: #6b7284;',
      '  --tph-accent: #fcee0a; --tph-accent-2: #00f0ff; --tph-danger: #ff003c; --tph-wx: #fcee0a;',
      '  --tph-bubble-me: #fcee0a; --tph-bubble-me-text: #141400;',
      '  --tph-bubble-other: rgba(0,240,255,.06); --tph-bubble-other-text: #d9e6ee;',
      '  --tph-shadow: 0 14px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.62), 0 0 0 1px rgba(252,238,10,.08);',
      '  --tph-cover: linear-gradient(160deg, #232d3f, #0c0c14);',
      // 赛博 UI 是锐利的：圆角全线收紧
      '  --tph-rad: 4px; --tph-rad-lg: 6px; --tph-rad-sm: 2px;',
      // 皮肤私有变量：所有霓虹色从这里取，改色只动这一处
      '  --nc-yellow: #fcee0a; --nc-cyan: #00f0ff; --nc-pink: #ff2e88; --nc-red: #ff003c;',
      '  --nc-ink: #141400; --nc-line: rgba(252,238,10,.26); --nc-line-cyan: rgba(0,240,255,.20);',
      '}',

      // ------------------------- 字体 / 原生件 -------------------------
      // 标题与时间走等宽栈，带终端味；原生滚动条/输入件跟着走深色
      SC + ' .tph-ui-title, ' + SC + ' .tph-nav-title, ' + SC + ' .tph-sb-time {',
      '  font-family: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .5px; }',
      SC + ' ::selection { background: var(--nc-yellow); color: var(--nc-ink); }',
      SC + ' { color-scheme: dark; }',

      // ------------------------- 外壳 / 状态栏 -------------------------
      SC + ' .tph-shell, ' + SC + ' .tph-inline-frame {',
      '  border-color: var(--nc-line); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: var(--tph-shadow), 0 0 26px rgba(0,240,255,.06); }',
      // 状态栏：底部 1px 黄色微光边
      SC + ' .tph-statusbar {',
      '  border-bottom-color: rgba(252,238,10,.30); box-shadow: 0 1px 10px rgba(252,238,10,.08); }',
      // 壁纸态状态栏保持透明，只留一条更弱的黄线
      SC + ' .tph-shell[data-wall] .tph-statusbar,',
      SC + ' .tph-inline-frame[data-wall] .tph-statusbar {',
      '  background: transparent; border-bottom-color: rgba(252,238,10,.16); box-shadow: none; }',
      // 时间霓虹黄 + 灵动岛青描边 + 底部小黄条
      SC + ' .tph-sb-time { color: var(--nc-yellow); text-shadow: 0 0 7px rgba(252,238,10,.45); }',
      SC + ' .tph-sb-island { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,240,255,.28); }',
      SC + ' .tph-homebar i { background: var(--nc-yellow); opacity: .5; }',

      // ------------------------- 桌面 / 船坞 / 悬浮球 -------------------------
      SC + ' .tph-dock { background: rgba(0,240,255,.07); border-color: rgba(0,240,255,.20); }',
      SC + ' .tph-orb { color: var(--nc-ink);',
      '  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.5), 0 0 16px rgba(252,238,10,.28); }',
      // 未读徽标统一换成官方红
      SC + ' .tph-app-dot, ' + SC + ' .tph-ui-act-badge, ' + SC + ' .tph-ui-tab-badge,',
      SC + ' .tph-wx-tab-badge, ' + SC + ' .tph-sb-notif { background: var(--nc-red); }',

      // ------------------------- 顶栏扫描线 -------------------------
      SC + ' .tph-ui-head { position: relative; overflow: hidden; }',
      // 一条 1px 霓虹青线贴着顶栏底边，从左到右循环扫（宽 30%）
      SC + ' .tph-ui-head::after {',
      '  content: ""; position: absolute; left: -30%; bottom: 0; width: 30%; height: 1px;',
      '  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--nc-cyan) 50%, transparent); opacity: .5;',
      '  pointer-events: none; animation: nc-scan 6s linear infinite; }',
      // 贴吧/小红书顶栏原本刷品牌 tint，夜之城统一压回暗底
      SC + ' .tph-ui[data-app="tieba"] .tph-ui-head, ' + SC + ' .tph-ui[data-app="rednote"] .tph-ui-head {',
      '  background: var(--tph-head); color: var(--tph-text); border-bottom-color: var(--nc-line-cyan); }',
      // 顶栏搜索框（贴吧/小红书的白底版 → 青玻璃）
      SC + ' .tph-ui[data-app="tieba"] .tph-ui-search, ' + SC + ' .tph-ui[data-app="rednote"] .tph-ui-search {',
      '  background: rgba(0,240,255,.07); color: var(--tph-muted); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,240,255,.16); }',
      SC + ' .tph-ui[data-app="tieba"] .tph-ui-search-in, ' + SC + ' .tph-ui[data-app="rednote"] .tph-ui-search-in {',
      '  color: var(--tph-text); }',
      SC + ' .tph-ui-back:hover, ' + SC + ' .tph-ui-act:hover { background: rgba(0,240,255,.10); }',

      // ------------------------- 标题 glitch（色差错位） -------------------------
      SC + ' .tph-ui-title:hover, ' + SC + ' .tph-nav-title:hover {',
      '  text-shadow: 1px 0 var(--nc-pink), -1px 0 var(--nc-cyan); animation: nc-glitch .2s linear; }',

      // ------------------------- 标签栏 / 底部导航 -------------------------
      SC + ' .tph-ui-subtab.on::after { background: var(--nc-yellow); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(252,238,10,.55); }',
      SC + ' .tph-ui-tab.on { color: var(--nc-yellow); text-shadow: 0 0 9px rgba(252,238,10,.4); }',
      SC + ' .tph-nav-home { background: rgba(252,238,10,.06); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(252,238,10,.22); }',

      // ------------------------- 卡片：直角 + 霓虹描边 + HUD 角标 -------------------------
      SC + ' .tph-card { position: relative; border-color: var(--nc-line); }',
      SC + ' .tph-mem-item { position: relative; border-color: var(--nc-line-cyan); }',
      // 左上角 L 形角标：普通卡片黄、记忆卡片青，像取景框
      SC + ' .tph-card::before, ' + SC + ' .tph-mem-item::before {',
      '  content: ""; position: absolute; left: -1px; top: -1px; width: 9px; height: 9px;',
      '  border-left: 2px solid var(--nc-yellow); border-top: 2px solid var(--nc-yellow); pointer-events: none; }',
      SC + ' .tph-mem-item::before { border-color: var(--nc-cyan); }',
      // 悬停：边框点亮 + 微光（黄/青各走各的）
      SC + ' .tph-card:hover { border-color: rgba(252,238,10,.5); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(252,238,10,.15); }',
      SC + ' .tph-mem-item:hover { border-color: rgba(0,240,255,.5); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0,240,255,.15); }',
      // 信息流整幅卡（贴吧/X）：左侧 2px 霓虹轨，hover 加一圈描边
      SC + ' .tph-tb-card, ' + SC + ' .tph-x-card {',
      '  position: relative; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 rgba(252,238,10,.35); }',
      SC + ' .tph-tb-card:hover, ' + SC + ' .tph-x-card:hover {',
      '  box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--nc-yellow), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(252,238,10,.14); }',

      // ------------------------- 按钮体系 -------------------------
      // primary：霓虹黄底黑字（赛博按钮经典样式），hover 泛黄光
      SC + ' .tph-btn.primary {',

      // ------------------------- 电话 / 通知 -------------------------

      SC + ' .tph-notif-panel { border: 1px solid var(--nc-line); }',
      SC + ' .tph-notif-warning .tph-notif-msg { color: var(--nc-red); }',
      SC + ' .tph-notif-success .tph-notif-msg { color: var(--nc-cyan); }',

      // ------------------------- 关键帧 -------------------------

      '@keyframes nc-glitch { 0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); } 25% { transform: translateX(-1px); } 75% { transform: translateX(1px); } }',

      // ------------------------- 动效尊重系统设置 -------------------------
      '@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {',
      // 扫描线停在画外（初始 left:-30% + overflow:hidden = 不可见），glitch 只剩静态色差
      '  ' + SC + ' .tph-ui-head::after, ' + SC + ' .tph-ui-title:hover,',
      '  ' + SC + ' .tph-nav-title:hover { animation: none; }',
      '}',
    ];
  }

      // 评论行内输入条（替代系统弹窗）
      '.tph-mo-cmtbar { display: flex; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 8px; margin-top: 5px; }',
      '.tph-mo-cmtbar-in { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; padding: 5px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--tph-border);',
      '  border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; color: var(--tph-text); font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; outline: none; }',
      // 朋友圈昵称藏蓝（真实微信朋友圈链接色）
      '.tph-mo-author { color: #576b95; }',
      '.tph-mo-src { color: var(--tph-dim); font-size: 10.5px; }',

      // ========================= 电话 =========================
      '.tph-call-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; }',
      // 舞台头部紧凑：内容顶对齐，剩余空间全给台词区（避免大片渐变空白）
      '.tph-call-stage { flex: 1 1 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start;',
      '  gap: 8px; padding: 18px 16px 10px; background: linear-gradient(170deg, var(--tph-raised), var(--tph-bg)); min-height: 0; }',
      '.tph-call-peer { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 500; }',
      '.tph-call-state { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--tph-muted); letter-spacing: .5px; }',
      // 对话记录：对外挂 16px 内边距（stage 已经给了），所以这里不再补左右 padding，
      // 否则浮窗窄的时候文字会被挤成两三列。详情页那条用 .tall 单独补。
      // flex:1 撑满舞台剩余空间，对白像聊天记录滚动
      '.tph-call-log { width: 100%; flex: 1 1 auto; overflow-y: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }',
      '.tph-call-log.tall { padding: 0 14px 14px; }',
      '.tph-call-empty { font-size: 12px; color: var(--tph-dim); text-align: center; padding: 6px 0; }',
      '.tph-call-line { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 6px; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.6; }',
      // 自己的台词靠右，删除键跟着镜像到左侧 —— 视线不会在两端来回跳
      '.tph-call-line.me { flex-direction: row-reverse; }',
      '.tph-call-line-tx { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; word-break: break-word; }',
      '.tph-call-line.me .tph-call-line-tx { text-align: right; }',
      '.tph-call-line b { color: var(--tph-accent); font-weight: 500; }',
      '.tph-call-line.me b { color: var(--tph-muted); }',
      // 删除键：平时半透明，指到那一行才实体化 —— 记录是「可以删」，不是「等着你删」
      '.tph-call-del { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 0; margin-top: 1px; border: none; border-radius: 50%;',
      '  background: transparent; color: var(--tph-dim); opacity: .32; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center;',
      '  justify-content: center; transition: opacity .12s, background .12s, color .12s; }',
      '.tph-call-line:hover .tph-call-del, .tph-call-del:focus-visible { opacity: 1; }',
      '.tph-call-del:hover { background: var(--tph-hover); color: var(--tph-text); }',
      // —— 流式输出预览 ——
      // 有增量时（data-live=1）当普通文本块逐字冒；没有增量（酒馆通道）时退化成
      // 「对方正在说话 ●●●」—— 让「在等」和「卡死了」在视觉上能区分开。
      '.tph-call-typing { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--tph-dim); }',
      '.tph-call-typing[data-live="1"] { display: block; color: var(--tph-text); white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }',
      // 说话人：群通话里模型把多个成员的台词混在一个 msgs 数组里流出来，标上名字才分得清
      '.tph-call-typing-who { color: var(--tph-accent); font-weight: 500; }',
      '.tph-call-typing-tx { white-space: pre-wrap; }',
      // 光标：让「还在写」和「已经写完」在静态截图里也能区分开
      // 基态就带 opacity —— 减动效模式（iteration-count 被压成 1）下动画跑完会退回基态，
      // 光标仍在，不会因为「不闪了」就直接消失
      '.tph-call-typing[data-live="1"]::after { content: "▍"; margin-left: 1px; color: var(--tph-accent);',
      '  opacity: .8; animation: tph-call-caret .9s steps(1) infinite; }',
      '@keyframes tph-call-caret { 0%, 50% { opacity: 1; } 50.01%, 100% { opacity: 0; } }',
      '.tph-call-thinking { flex: 0 0 auto; }',
      '.tph-call-dots { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; }',
      '.tph-call-dots i { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--tph-accent); animation: tph-call-dot 1.05s ease-in-out infinite; }',
      '.tph-call-dots i:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .18s; }',
      '.tph-call-dots i:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .36s; }',
      '@keyframes tph-call-dot { 0%, 60%, 100% { opacity: .26; transform: translateY(0); } 30% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-2px); } }',
      // —— 在场成员条（@ 拉人后出现）——
      '.tph-call-members { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; margin-bottom: 8px; }',
      '.tph-call-members-t { font-size: 11px; color: var(--tph-dim); }',
      '.tph-call-pad { padding: 10px 14px 18px; }',
      '.tph-call-num { text-align: center; font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: 2px; min-height: 32px; margin-bottom: 12px;',
      '  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }',
      '.tph-call-keys { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 13px 17px; max-width: 262px; margin: 0 auto 16px; }',
      '.tph-call-key { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; border-radius: 50%; border: none; background: var(--tph-hover);',
      '  color: var(--tph-text); font-family: inherit; font-size: 27px; font-weight: 300; cursor: pointer; display: flex; flex-direction: column;',
      '  align-items: center; justify-content: center; line-height: 1.05; }',
      '.tph-call-key:hover { background: var(--tph-border); }',
      '.tph-call-key:active { background: var(--tph-border); filter: brightness(.96); }',
      '.tph-call-key small { font-size: 9px; color: var(--tph-dim); letter-spacing: 2.5px; font-weight: 400; }',

      // —— 通话中主控区：键盘 / 大语音键 / 挂断 ——
      // 原 iOS 四宫格（静音·键盘·扬声器·联系人）已删：前两个在这个 App 里没有真实语义，
      // 后两个分别由「@ 拉人」和「挂断」承担。留下一个真正好按的大语音键。
      '.tph-call-tools { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 22px; padding: 2px 0; }',
      '.tph-call-tool { width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; cursor: pointer; display: flex;',
      '  align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--tph-hover); color: var(--tph-text);',
      '  transition: background .15s, color .15s, filter .15s; }',
      '.tph-call-tool:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); }',
      '.tph-call-tool.on { background: var(--tph-accent); color: #fff; }',
      '.tph-call-tool.hang { background: #ff3b30; color: #fff; }',
      // 大语音键：整页最显眼的元素 —— 精简之后它是通话里唯一的输入方式，尺寸必须给足
      '.tph-call-mic { width: 76px; height: 76px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; cursor: pointer; display: flex;',
      '  align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--tph-accent); color: #fff;',
      '  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.28); transition: transform .14s, background .14s; }',
      '.tph-call-mic:hover { transform: scale(1.04); }',
      '.tph-call-mic:active { transform: scale(.97); }',
      // 录制中：红色 + 向外扩散的呼吸光环，一眼看出「话筒正开着」
      '.tph-call-mic.rec { background: #ff3b30; animation: tph-call-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; }',
      '@keyframes tph-call-pulse {',
      '  0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255,59,48,.5), 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.28); }',
      '  50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 12px rgba(255,59,48,0), 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.28); } }',
      '.tph-call-hint { text-align: center; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--tph-dim); margin-top: 6px; min-height: 16px; }',
      '.tph-call-hint[data-rec="1"] { color: #ff3b30; }',
      // 文字输入行：position:relative 是 @ 联想浮层（absolute + bottom:100%）的定位基准
      '.tph-call-input { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 7px; margin-bottom: 8px; }',
      '.tph-call-input .tph-wx-ta { min-width: 0; }',
      '.tph-call-go { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; }',
      '.tph-call-btn { width: 54px; height: 54px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; color: #fff; cursor: pointer;',
      '  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }',
      '.tph-call-btn.answer { background: #34c759; }',
      '.tph-call-btn.hang { background: #ff3b30; }',
      '.tph-call-btn.back { background: var(--tph-raised); border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); color: var(--tph-text); }',
      '.tph-call-btn:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); }',
      '.tph-call-ring { animation: tph-ring 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; }',
      '@keyframes tph-ring { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-4px); } }',
      '.tph-call-recent { padding: 8px 12px; }',
      '.tph-call-recent-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 8px 0;',
      '  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--tph-border); cursor: pointer; }',
      '.tph-call-recent-row:hover { background: var(--tph-hover); }',

      // ========================= 记忆 =========================
      '.tph-mem-wrap { padding: 10px 12px 16px; }',
      '.tph-mem-item { padding: 9px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad);',
      '  background: var(--tph-surface); margin-bottom: 7px; }',
      '.tph-mem-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 4px; }',
      '.tph-mem-type { padding: 1px 6px; font-size: 10px; border-radius: var(--tph-pill); background: var(--tph-hover);',
      '  color: var(--tph-muted); }',
      '.tph-mem-title { flex: 1 1 auto; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;',
      '  white-space: nowrap; }',
      '.tph-mem-src { font-size: 10px; color: var(--tph-dim); }',
      '.tph-mem-body { font-size: 12px; color: var(--tph-muted); line-height: 1.6; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }',

      // ========================= 贴吧 =========================
      // 信息流圆角卡片化（真实贴吧是灰底上的白色圆角卡片带间隙）
      '.tph-tb-card { margin: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: 12px;',
      '  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.04); }',
      // 楼主徽标（帖子详情里作者回复带蓝色「楼主」chip）
      '.tph-tb-op { flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--tph-tint);',
      '  color: #fff; font-size: 9.5px; line-height: 1.5; }',
      // 进吧页的吧圆形头像 + 关注 chip
      '.tph-tb-barava { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; }',
      '.tph-tb-follow { flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 3px 12px; border: none; border-radius: var(--tph-pill);',
      '  background: var(--tph-tint); color: #fff; font-family: inherit; font-size: 11.5px; cursor: pointer; }',
      '.tph-tb-follow[data-on="1"] { background: var(--tph-hover); color: var(--tph-muted); }',
      '.tph-tb-barchip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--tph-surface);',
      '  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--tph-border); }',
      '.tph-tb-barchip-t { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; }',
      '.tph-tb-barchip-x { flex: 1 1 auto; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--tph-dim); }',
      '.tph-tb-card { padding: 13px 14px; background: var(--tph-surface); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--tph-border);',
      '  cursor: pointer; }',
      '.tph-tb-card:hover { background: var(--tph-hover); }',
      '.tph-tb-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin-bottom: 8px; }',
      '.tph-tb-info { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }',
      '.tph-tb-author { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; }',
      '.tph-tb-meta { font-size: 11px; color: var(--tph-dim); }',
      '.tph-tb-title { font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.45; margin-bottom: 6px; }',
      '.tph-tb-title-lg { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.45; }',
      '.tph-tb-preview { font-size: 13px; color: var(--tph-muted); line-height: 1.6; }',
      '.tph-tb-thumbs { display: flex; gap: 5px; margin-top: 9px; }',
      '.tph-tb-thumb { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; }',
      '.tph-tb-foot { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; margin-top: 10px; }',
      '.tph-tb-stat { flex: 1 1 auto; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--tph-dim); }',
      '.tph-tb-act { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 4px 3px; border: none;',
      '  background: transparent; color: var(--tph-dim); font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; }',
      '.tph-tb-act:hover { color: var(--tph-tint); }',
      '.tph-tb-act.on { color: #e5484d; }',
      '.tph-tb-act.lg { padding: 6px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-pill); font-size: 13px; }',
      '.tph-tb-act-n { font-size: 11.5px; }',
      '.tph-tb-act-t { font-size: 12.5px; }',
      '.tph-tb-act-t.dim { color: var(--tph-dim); }',
      '.tph-tb-menu { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 24px; z-index: 3; padding: 6px; border-radius: var(--tph-rad-sm);',
      '  background: var(--tph-raised); border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); box-shadow: var(--tph-shadow); }',
      '.tph-tb-ai { flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: var(--tph-pill); background: var(--tph-tint);',
      '  color: #fff; font-size: 9.5px; }',
      '.tph-tb-compose { padding: 11px 12px; background: var(--tph-surface); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--tph-border); }',
      '.tph-tb-compose-t { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 8px; }',
      '.tph-tb-main { padding: 14px 14px 10px; background: var(--tph-surface); }',
      '.tph-tb-main-who { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px; }',
      '.tph-tb-main-wi { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; }',
      '.tph-tb-content { padding: 12px 14px 0; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.62; white-space: pre-wrap; }',
      '.tph-tb-imgs { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 14px 0; }',
      '.tph-tb-dacts { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--tph-border); }',
      '.tph-tb-reply { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 9px; padding: 11px 13px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--tph-border); }',
      '.tph-tb-reply-body { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }',
      '.tph-tb-reply-top { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 3px; }',
      '.tph-tb-reply-from { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; }',
      '.tph-tb-floor { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--tph-dim); }',
      '.tph-tb-reply-time { margin-left: auto; font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--tph-dim); }',

      '.tph-tb-inputbar-in { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--tph-border);',
      '  border-radius: var(--tph-pill); background: var(--tph-input); color: var(--tph-text); font-family: inherit;',
      '  font-size: 12.5px; outline: none; }',
      '.tph-tb-send { flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 7px 14px; border: none; border-radius: var(--tph-pill);',
      '  background: var(--tph-tint); color: #fff; font-family: inherit; font-size: 12.5px; cursor: pointer; }',
      '.tph-tb-msg { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 9px; padding: 11px 13px; background: var(--tph-surface);',
      '  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--tph-border); }',
      '.tph-tb-msg.tap { cursor: pointer; }',
      '.tph-tb-msg.tap:hover { background: var(--tph-hover); }',
      '.tph-tb-msg-mid { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }',
      '.tph-tb-msg-top { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; }',
      '.tph-tb-msg-from { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; }',
      '.tph-tb-msg-time { margin-left: auto; font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--tph-dim); }',
      '.tph-tb-msg-text { margin: 3px 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; }',
      '.tph-tb-msg-quote { padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: var(--tph-rad-sm); background: var(--tph-hover);',
      '  font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--tph-dim); }',
      '.tph-tb-me { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 22px 16px 16px;',
      '  background: var(--tph-surface); }',
      '.tph-tb-me-nm { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; }',
      '.tph-tb-me-stats { display: flex; gap: 26px; margin-top: 6px; }',
      '.tph-tb-me-stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 1px; }',
      '.tph-tb-me-n { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; }',
      '.tph-tb-me-l { font-size: 11px; color: var(--tph-dim); }',

      // ========================= 小红书 =========================

      '  transition: width .18s ease, background .18s ease; }',
      '.tph-rn-pips i[data-on="1"] { width: 16px; background: var(--tph-accent); }',
      '.tph-rn-body { padding: 12px 14px; }',
      '.tph-rn-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin-bottom: 10px; }',
      '.tph-rn-head-i { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; }',
      '.tph-rn-author-lg { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; }',
      '.tph-rn-head-s { font-size: 11px; color: var(--tph-dim); }',
      '.tph-rn-title-lg { margin-bottom: 7px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.45; }',
      '.tph-rn-content { font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.62; }',
      '.tph-rn-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; margin-top: 10px; }',
      '.tph-rn-tagc { padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: var(--tph-pill); background: var(--tph-hover);',
