      '.tph-mp-cover { flex: none; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 8px; }',
      '.tph-mp-meta { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }',
      '.tph-mp-name { display: block; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--tph-text);',
      '  white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }',
      '.tph-mp-sub { display: block; margin-top: 1px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--tph-dim);',
      '  white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }',
      '.tph-mp-acts { flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; }',
      '.tph-mp-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 0;',
      '  border: none; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: var(--tph-text); cursor: pointer; }',
      '.tph-mp-btn:hover { background: var(--tph-hover); }',
      '.tph-mp-btn.main { color: #fff; background: var(--tph-tint); }',
      '.tph-mp-btn.main:hover { background: var(--tph-tint); filter: brightness(1.1); }',
      '.tph-mp-prog { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 12px 6px; }',
      // 视觉 4px、命中区 16px：靠 background-size 把线压细，元素本身留够高度才拖得动
      '.tph-mp .tph-music-seek { flex: 1 1 auto; width: auto; min-width: 0; height: 16px; border-radius: 0;',
      '  background-size: 100% 4px; background-position: 0 center; background-repeat: no-repeat; }',
      // 迷你条平时不画圆点（真机那条细线本来就没有），悬停才浮出来提示「可以拖」。
      // 用 background:transparent 而不是 opacity:0 —— 后者在部分 Chrome 版本上对
      // ::-webkit-slider-thumb 不生效，圆点会一直挂在那儿。
      // -webkit-appearance:none 必须在每条 ::-webkit-slider-thumb 规则里重复声明，
      // 否则 Chrome 会退回默认外观（一个白圆点），盖住我们要的细线。
      '.tph-mp .tph-music-seek::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none;',
      '  width: 11px; height: 11px; background: transparent; transition: background .12s; }',
      '.tph-mp .tph-music-seek::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { background: transparent; }',
      '.tph-mp .tph-music-seek::-moz-range-thumb { width: 11px; height: 11px; background: transparent; }',
      '.tph-mp:hover .tph-music-seek::-webkit-slider-thumb { background: var(--tph-tint); }',
      '.tph-mp .tph-music-seek:active::-webkit-slider-thumb { background: var(--tph-tint); }',
      // —— 迷你条上的音量入口（进度条右端那颗小喇叭）——
      '.tph-mp-vol { flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 24px; height: 22px;',
      '  padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--tph-muted); cursor: pointer; }',
      '.tph-mp-vol:hover { background: var(--tph-hover); color: var(--tph-text); }',
      '.tph-mp-vol.on { color: var(--tph-tint); }',
      // 两颗图标叠着放，靠 .muted 切显示，省一次重建 DOM
      '.tph-mp-vol .i-off { display: none; }',
      '.tph-mp-vol.muted .i-on { display: none; }',
      '.tph-mp-vol.muted .i-off { display: block; }',
      // 音量浮层：往上弹出，盖在歌单之上（dock 在滚动区之外，DOM 靠后，天然在上面）
      '.tph-mp-vol-pop { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 100%; z-index: 3;',
      '  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 13px;',
      '  background: var(--tph-head); border-top: 1px solid var(--tph-border);',
      '  box-shadow: 0 -8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.26); animation: tph-vol-in .16s ease-out; }',
      '.tph-mp-vol-pop > svg { flex: none; color: var(--tph-muted); }',
      '.tph-mp-vol-val { flex: none; min-width: 36px; text-align: right; font-size: 11.5px;',
      '  color: var(--tph-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }',
      '@keyframes tph-vol-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(7px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }',
      '.tph-mp-vol-hint { flex: none; font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--tph-dim); }',
      '.tph-music-bar-empty { text-align: center; color: var(--tph-dim); font-size: 12.5px; padding: 11px 0; }',
      // —— 滑条（进度 / 音量）——
      // 已播段用 --tph-p 百分比做渐变填充：JS 在 timeupdate 里只改这一个变量，
      // 不用重建 DOM 就能让进度条动起来。
      // 必须用 background 简写（而不是 background-image）：input 的 UA 默认背景色是白色，
      // 只写 background-image 的话，中间那条 3px 的线之外会露出一整条白底。
      '.tph-music-seek { flex: 1; -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; outline: none;',
      '  background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--tph-tint) 0 var(--tph-p, 0%), var(--tph-track) var(--tph-p, 0%) 100%); }',
      '.tph-music-seek::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%;',
      '  background: var(--tph-tint); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.34); }',
      '.tph-music-seek::-moz-range-thumb { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--tph-tint);',
      '  cursor: pointer; border: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.34); }',
      '.tph-music-vol-slider { flex: 1; -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; height: 5px; border-radius: 3px; outline: none;',
      '  background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--tph-tint) 0 var(--tph-v, 80%), var(--tph-track) var(--tph-v, 80%) 100%); }',
      '.tph-music-vol-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%;',
      '  background: var(--tph-text); cursor: pointer; }',
      '.tph-music-vol-slider::-moz-range-thumb { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--tph-text);',
      '  cursor: pointer; border: none; }',
      // —— 全屏播放页 ——
      '.tph-mnp { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; padding: 2px 22px 18px; }',
      '.tph-mnp-art { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 118px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;',
      '  padding-bottom: 14px; }',
      // 正方形：先定高（取「容器高」与 260 的较小值），宽由 aspect-ratio 反推。
      // 反过来写 width + height:100% 会把封面拉成长方形 —— 专辑封面一旦不是方的就假了。
      '.tph-mnp-art .tph-cover { flex: 0 0 auto; height: min(100%, 360px); width: auto; max-width: 100%;',
      '  aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.38); }',
      '.tph-mnp-info { flex: none; text-align: center; padding-bottom: 14px; }',
      '.tph-mnp-name { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--tph-text); word-break: break-word;',
      '  display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }',
      '.tph-mnp-sub { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--tph-dim); }',
      '.tph-mnp-seek { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; }',
      '.tph-music-time { flex: none; min-width: 34px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--tph-dim);',
      '  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }',
      '.tph-music-time-dur { text-align: right; }',
      '.tph-mnp-ctrl { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; padding: 15px 0 12px; }',
      '.tph-mnp-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 42px; height: 42px; padding: 0;',
      '  border: none; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: var(--tph-muted); cursor: pointer; }',
      '.tph-mnp-btn:hover { background: var(--tph-hover); color: var(--tph-text); }',
      '.tph-mnp-btn.on { color: var(--tph-tint); }',
      '.tph-mnp-btn.play { width: 58px; height: 58px; color: #fff; background: var(--tph-tint); }',
      '.tph-mnp-btn.play:hover { background: var(--tph-tint); filter: brightness(1.08); }',
      '.tph-mnp-vol { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; color: var(--tph-dim); }',

      // ========================= 小剧场 =========================
      // 模式选择卡片：竖排卡片网格（标题上、简介下），选中态高亮。
      // JS 的 DOM 是 .mode > .mode-nm + .mode-dsc 两个块级元素，这里用 column 排。
      '.tph-theater-modes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 9px; padding: 2px 0 0; }',
      '.tph-theater-mode { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 4px; padding: 12px 13px;',
      '  border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad); background: var(--tph-surface);',
      '  cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .15s, background .15s; }',
      '.tph-theater-mode:hover { background: var(--tph-hover); }',
      '.tph-theater-mode.on { border-color: var(--tph-tint); background: var(--tph-hover); }',
      '.tph-theater-mode-ic { flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;',
      '  width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: var(--tph-rad-sm); background: var(--tph-tint); color: #fff; }',
      '.tph-theater-mode-mid { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }',
      '.tph-theater-mode-t { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 3px; }',
      '.tph-theater-mode-d { font-size: 12px; color: var(--tph-dim); line-height: 1.5; }',
      '.tph-theater-mode-x { flex: 0 0 auto; align-self: center; color: var(--tph-tint); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .15s; }',
      '.tph-theater-mode.on .tph-theater-mode-x { opacity: 1; }',
      // JS 实际使用的标题/简介类
      '.tph-theater-mode-nm { font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--tph-text); }',
      '.tph-theater-mode.on .tph-theater-mode-nm { color: var(--tph-tint); }',
      '.tph-theater-mode-dsc { font-size: 12px; color: var(--tph-dim); line-height: 1.5; }',

      // 剧本列表卡片：封面 + 标题 + 简介 + 角色/幕数角标
      '.tph-theater-scripts { padding: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }',
      '.tph-theater-script { display: flex; gap: 11px; padding: 11px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--tph-border);',
      '  border-radius: var(--tph-rad); background: var(--tph-surface); cursor: pointer;',
      '  transition: border-color .15s, background .15s; }',
      '.tph-theater-script:hover { background: var(--tph-hover); border-color: var(--tph-tint); }',
      '.tph-theater-script.on { border-color: var(--tph-tint); }',
      '.tph-theater-script-cover { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 52px; height: 70px; border-radius: var(--tph-rad-sm);',
      '  overflow: hidden; }',
      '.tph-theater-script-mid { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }',
      '.tph-theater-script-t { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }',
      '.tph-theater-script-d { flex: 1 1 auto; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--tph-dim); line-height: 1.5;',
      '  display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }',
      '.tph-theater-script-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--tph-dim); }',
      '.tph-theater-script-meta b { font-weight: 400; color: var(--tph-muted); }',

      // 对白气泡：左右分栏（对方在左、我在右），复用聊天气泡观感
      '.tph-theater-scene { padding: 12px 12px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }',
      '.tph-theater-line { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; }',
      '.tph-theater-line.me { flex-direction: row-reverse; }',
      '.tph-theater-line-ava { flex: 0 0 auto; }',
      '.tph-theater-line-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-width: 78%; min-width: 0; }',
      '.tph-theater-line.me .tph-theater-line-col { align-items: flex-end; }',
      '.tph-theater-line-who { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--tph-dim); margin-bottom: 3px; padding: 0 2px; }',
      '.tph-theater-line-bubble { padding: 8px 11px; border-radius: var(--tph-rad); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55;',
      '  word-break: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; background: var(--tph-bubble-other); color: var(--tph-bubble-other-text);',
      '  border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); }',
      '.tph-theater-line.me .tph-theater-line-bubble { background: var(--tph-bubble-me); color: var(--tph-bubble-me-text);',
      '  border-color: transparent; }',

      // 整幕的容器。这个名字在 CSS 里原本写的是「舞台提示那一行」的样式
      // （居中 + 斜体 + 灰），但 JS 是拿它当容器把整幕套住的 —— 于是对白、角色名、
      // 场景标题统统继承了 text-align:center 和 italic，气泡一行左一行右全歪掉。
      // 舞台提示行本来就另有 .tph-theater-direction（文件末尾），这里改成中性的竖排容器。
      '.tph-theater-stage { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; padding: 2px 0 4px; }',

      // 旁白：居中（正文体，比舞台提示更正式，不带括号）
      '.tph-theater-narration { text-align: center; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--tph-muted); line-height: 1.7;',
      '  padding: 8px 24px; margin: 4px 0; }',

      // 分幕翻页控件：上一幕 / 幕标 / 下一幕 + 进度圆点
      '.tph-theater-acts { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--tph-head);',
      '  border-top: 1px solid var(--tph-border); }',
      '.tph-theater-act-btn { flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;',
      '  width: 32px; height: 32px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: 50%;',
      '  background: var(--tph-surface); color: var(--tph-text); cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, opacity .15s; }',
      '.tph-theater-act-btn:hover { background: var(--tph-hover); }',
      '.tph-theater-act-btn:disabled { opacity: .35; cursor: not-allowed; }',
      '.tph-theater-act-label { flex: 1 1 auto; text-align: center; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--tph-text); }',
      '.tph-theater-act-label small { font-size: 11px; color: var(--tph-dim); font-weight: 400; }',
      '.tph-theater-act-dots { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 0 8px; }',
      '.tph-theater-act-dots i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--tph-border);',
      '  transition: background .18s, transform .18s; }',
      '.tph-theater-act-dots i.on { background: var(--tph-tint); transform: scale(1.2); }',

      // 草稿面板：编剧草稿录入 + 草稿列表
      '.tph-theater-draft { padding: 12px; }',
      '.tph-theater-draft-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; }',
      '.tph-theater-draft-t { flex: 1 1 auto; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; }',
      '.tph-theater-draft-body { border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad);',
      '  background: var(--tph-surface); padding: 10px; margin-bottom: 8px; }',
      '.tph-theater-draft-in { width: 100%; min-height: 96px; max-height: 240px; padding: 8px 10px; font-family: inherit;',
      '  font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--tph-text); background: var(--tph-input);',
      '  border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad-sm); outline: none; resize: none; field-sizing: content; }',
      '.tph-theater-draft-in:focus { border-color: var(--tph-accent); }',
      '.tph-theater-draft-acts { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }',
      '.tph-theater-draft-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; margin-top: 10px; }',
      '.tph-theater-draft-item { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 9px; padding: 9px 10px;',
      '  border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad); background: var(--tph-surface); }',
      '.tph-theater-draft-item-mid { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }',
      '.tph-theater-draft-item-t { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 2px; overflow: hidden;',
      '  text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }',
      '.tph-theater-draft-item-x { font-size: 11px; color: var(--tph-dim); line-height: 1.5; display: -webkit-box;',
      '  -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }',
      '.tph-theater-draft-item-ts { flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: 10px; color: var(--tph-dim); }',
      '.tph-theater-draft-item-del { flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;',
      '  width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent;',
      '  color: var(--tph-dim); cursor: pointer; }',
      '.tph-theater-draft-item-del:hover { background: var(--tph-hover); color: var(--tph-danger); }',

      // ========================= 状态栏 App（.tph-st-*，与 37-status.js 的 DOM 对齐）=========================
      // 两个 App 的内容贴 body 边，这里统一给左右内边距（卡片自己只管上下间距）
      '.tph-ui[data-app="status"] .tph-ui-body, .tph-ui[data-app="theater"] .tph-ui-body { padding: 2px 12px 14px; }',

      // App 内设置面板容器（小剧场/状态栏右上角齿轮展开的面板）
      '.tph-app-settings { margin: 8px 0 4px; padding: 10px 13px 12px; background: var(--tph-surface);',
      '  border: 1px dashed var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad-lg); }',
      '.tph-app-settings .tph-input, .tph-app-settings .tph-textarea { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; }',

      // 角色选择区：留空=全部
      '.tph-st-cast { margin: 8px 0 4px; }',

      // 状态卡片：世界状态 / 角色状态两个分区
      '.tph-st-card { margin: 8px 0; padding: 12px 13px; background: var(--tph-surface);',
      '  border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad-lg); }',
      '.tph-st-world { margin-bottom: 4px; }',
      // 角色区加一条分隔线：世界三行 + 角色两段之间原来只靠 10px 间距，扫读时分不出换区了
      '.tph-st-chars { margin-top: 12px; padding-top: 11px; border-top: 1px solid var(--tph-border); }',
      '.tph-st-sec-t { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--tph-tint); letter-spacing: .5px;',
      '  margin: 2px 0 4px; }',
      '.tph-st-chars .tph-st-sec-t { margin-top: 0; }',

      // 字段行：字段名 + 值，整行可点击编辑
      '.tph-st-field { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 8px; margin: 0 -8px;',
      '  border-radius: var(--tph-rad-sm); cursor: pointer; transition: background .12s; }',
      '.tph-st-field:hover { background: var(--tph-hover); }',
      // 字段名固定成一列宽，值才有统一的左边界可以扫读（原来 key 宽度随字数变，值起点参差）
      '.tph-st-field-k { flex: 0 0 auto; min-width: 4.6em; font-size: 12px; color: var(--tph-muted); }',
      // 值是整句话（MVU 常见形态），必须让它换行。
      // 原来是 nowrap + ellipsis + text-align:right —— 长句被砍掉一半，而且右对齐让每行
      // 左边界都在飘，十一行看下来找不到落点。
      '.tph-st-field-v { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--tph-text);',
      '  line-height: 1.55; word-break: break-word; }',
      // 角色名下的字段行：比世界字段再紧一档，且不用外扩负边距（它在角色行内，会顶出卡片）
      '.tph-st-field.sub { padding: 3px 6px; margin: 0 -6px; }',
      // 「配了但没提取到」的字段：汇成一行小字，而不是逐行摆一堆「—」占位
      '.tph-st-miss { font-size: 11px; color: var(--tph-dim); padding: 3px 0 1px; line-height: 1.5; }',

      // 空态小字
      '.tph-st-empty { font-size: 12px; color: var(--tph-dim); padding: 4px 0; }',
      '.tph-st-empty.inline { padding: 0; }',

      // 角色状态行：头像 + 名字 + 字段 chips
      '.tph-st-char { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 9px; padding: 7px 0; }',
      '.tph-st-char-mid { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }',
      '.tph-st-char-name { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--tph-text); }',
      // 角色字段改成与世界字段同构的 key-value 行。
      // 原来是 pill chip：值放在 .tph-st-chip-v 子节点里，而 text-overflow:ellipsis 写在
      // 父级 chip 上 —— 省略号作用不到子节点的文字，超长时既不折行也不出现「…」，
      // 就是硬生生砍断在半句（截图里「…对班级氛围的反」）。
      // 何况 chip 本就是装短标签的，拿来装整句话本身就不对。
      '.tph-st-char-fields { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; }',

      // 元信息行：来源标签 + 时间
      '.tph-st-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px; padding-top: 8px;',
      '  border-top: 1px solid var(--tph-border); }',
      '.tph-st-src { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 1px 7px; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 500;',
      '  border-radius: var(--tph-pill); letter-spacing: .3px; color: var(--tph-accent-2); background: rgba(106,88,232,.13); }',
      '.tph-st-time { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--tph-dim); }',

      // （原 .tph-st-detail-sec「世界状态字段/角色状态字段」两个分区已删除：它们把
      //   同一份状态又按配置字段表铺了一遍，与上方卡片完全重复，一页要滚三屏多。）
      //   配置里有、记录里没有的字段，改由卡片内的 .tph-st-miss 一行汇总。

      // ========================= 小剧场补缺（JS 用到但此前未定义的类）=========================
      // 生成表单容器
      '.tph-theater-compose { margin: 8px 0 4px; padding: 12px 13px; background: var(--tph-surface);',
      '  border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad-lg); }',
      '.tph-theater-compose .tph-textarea, .tph-theater-compose .tph-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; }',

      // 剧本列表容器 + 卡片（JS 用 .tph-theater-card，与 .tph-theater-script 同风格）
      '.tph-theater-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }',
      // 卡片是「左内容 / 右操作」两栏；内容栏竖排（模式标签+标题 / 内容预览 / 幕数·行数·时间）。
      // 之前父级 align-items:center 且没有竖排中间层，四个区块被并排塞进一行，
      // 标题被挤到只剩十来个字、副信息竖着折成「1 幕3 行昨 / 天」。
      '.tph-theater-card { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 14px;',
      '  background: var(--tph-surface); border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad);',
      '  cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .15s, background .15s; }',
      '.tph-theater-card:hover { border-color: var(--tph-tint); }',
      // 草稿行没有 ops 容器，两个按钮是卡片的直接子元素，居中才不会吊在顶部
      '.tph-theater-card.draft { border-style: dashed; opacity: .85; align-items: center; }',
      '.tph-theater-card-mid { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }',
      // 标题不抢伸展空间（只许缩）—— 抢了的话头像条的 margin-left:auto 就分不到剩余空间，
      // 头像会贴在标题后面；标题长短不同时位置还会飘。让它只缩不长，头像就永远靠右。
      '.tph-theater-card-t { flex: 0 1 auto; min-width: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--tph-text);',
      '  white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }',
      // 内容预览：卡片原来只报「几幕几行」，看不出这出戏演的是什么
      '.tph-theater-card-prev { font-size: 12px; color: var(--tph-dim); line-height: 1.5;',
      '  overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }',
      '.tph-theater-card-sub, .tph-theater-detail-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 11px; color: var(--tph-muted); }',
      // 用中点做分隔，而不是靠 gap —— gap 只给间距，三项连在一起读成「1 幕3 行昨天」
      '.tph-theater-card-sub span + span::before, .tph-theater-detail-meta span + span::before { content: "·"; margin: 0 7px; color: var(--tph-border); }',
      '.tph-theater-card-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }',
      '.tph-theater-card-ops { flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; gap: 4px; align-self: center; }',

      // 模式标签 pill：theater 紫 / stage 蓝
      '.tph-theater-tag { flex: 0 0 auto; display: inline-flex; padding: 1px 8px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500;',
      '  border-radius: var(--tph-pill); letter-spacing: .3px; color: var(--tph-accent-2); background: rgba(106,88,232,.13); }',
      '.tph-theater-tag.stage { color: var(--tph-accent); background: rgba(47,127,240,.13); }',

      // 头像堆（详情/卡片头部的角色串）
      '.tph-theater-avas { display: flex; align-items: center; margin-left: auto; }',
      '.tph-theater-avas .tph-ava { margin-left: -7px; border: 2px solid var(--tph-surface); }',
      '.tph-theater-avas .tph-ava:first-child { margin-left: 0; }',
      '.tph-theater-avas-more { margin-left: 5px; font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--tph-dim); }',

      // 详情页
      '.tph-theater-detail { padding: 4px 0 10px; }',
      // 头部只放「模式标签 + 元信息 + 出场角色」——标题交给顶栏（滚动时一直可见），
      // 原来两处标题上下紧挨着重复一遍
      '.tph-theater-detail-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; flex-wrap: wrap;',
      '  padding: 2px 0 11px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--tph-border); margin-bottom: 12px; }',
      // 只缩不长：头像条的 margin-left:auto 才拿得到剩余空间（同卡片标题那条注释）
      '.tph-theater-detail-meta { flex: 0 1 auto; min-width: 0; }',
      '.tph-theater-detail-ops { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px; margin: 12px 0 4px; }',

      // 分幕导航条：上一幕 / 圆点 / 下一幕
      '.tph-theater-scenes { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; padding: 8px 0 12px; }',
      '.tph-theater-scene-btn { background: none; border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: 50%;',
      '  width: 32px; height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;',
      '  color: var(--tph-muted); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .14s, color .14s; }',
      '.tph-theater-scene-btn:hover { border-color: var(--tph-tint); color: var(--tph-tint); }',
      '.tph-theater-scene-dots { display: flex; gap: 6px; }',
      '.tph-theater-scene-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; padding: 0;',
      '  background: var(--tph-border); cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, transform .15s; }',
      '.tph-theater-scene-dot.on { background: var(--tph-tint); transform: scale(1.25); }',
      '.tph-theater-scene-title { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--tph-tint);',
      '  margin: 14px 0 6px; letter-spacing: .5px; }',

      // 舞台提示（对应 .tph-theater-stage 的别名，JS 用 direction）
      '.tph-theater-direction { font-size: 12px; color: var(--tph-dim); font-style: italic; text-align: center; padding: 5px 20px; line-height: 1.6; }',
      // 对白名（同 line-who 的角色）
      '.tph-theater-line-from { font-size: 11px; color: var(--tph-muted); margin-bottom: 3px; }',
      // 聊天式左右分栏：right 加在 .tph-theater-line 上（头像翻到右侧、名字与气泡右对齐）
      '.tph-theater-line.right { flex-direction: row-reverse; }',
      '.tph-theater-line.right .tph-theater-line-col { align-items: flex-end; }',
      '.tph-theater-line.right .tph-theater-line-from { text-align: right; }',
      // 右侧气泡用主题色淡底，和左侧的白底一眼区分
      '.tph-theater-line.right .tph-theater-bubble {',
      '  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tph-tint) 14%, var(--tph-surface));',
      '  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tph-tint) 30%, var(--tph-border)); }',
      // 气泡别名（JS 在部分路径用 bubble 而不是 line-bubble）
      '.tph-theater-bubble { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: var(--tph-rad);',
      '  font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; background: var(--tph-surface); border: 1px solid var(--tph-border);',
      '  color: var(--tph-text); word-break: break-word; }',

      // 朗读键 —— 详情页的**主操作**（次操作「注入」是 .tph-btn.sm，三级「存草稿」是 ghost）。
      // 原来这里只有 .on 一条状态样式、没有基础样式，按钮就落回了浏览器 UA 默认外观：
      // 灰底黑字 + 2px outset 边框 + 无圆角 + Arial 13.3px。在酒馆里更糟 ——
      // 宿主主题的 button 规则会渗进来，变成白底 + 主题色文字（暖色主题下就是白底黄字）。
      // 项目里没有全局 button 复位，所以每个 button 都必须自己吃到一条定义外观的规则。
      '.tph-theater-speak { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px;',
      '  flex: 0 0 auto; white-space: nowrap; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px;',
      '  border: 1px solid var(--tph-accent); border-radius: var(--tph-rad-sm);',
      '  background: var(--tph-accent); color: #fff; cursor: pointer;',
      '  transition: filter .14s, background .14s, border-color .14s, color .14s; }',
      '.tph-theater-speak:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); }',
      // 朗读中：换成绿色浅底 + 绿字。「停止」不该再和主按钮抢注意力，所以从实心降到浅底。
      '.tph-theater-speak.on { color: #34c759; border-color: #34c759; background: rgba(52,199,89,.14); }',
      '.tph-theater-speak.on:hover { filter: none; background: rgba(52,199,89,.22); }',

      // 原文折叠区
      '.tph-theater-raw pre.tph-theater-raw-pre { margin: 0; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.6;',
      '  color: var(--tph-muted); background: var(--tph-input); border-radius: var(--tph-rad-sm);',
      '  white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; font-family: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; }',

      // ========================= 游戏小游戏：采访 / 日记 / 真心话 =========================
      // —— 角色采访 ——
      '.tph-interview-card { border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad);',
      '  padding: 10px 12px; margin: 8px 0; background: var(--tph-surface); }',
      '.tph-interview-title-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 6px; }',
      '.tph-interview-title { flex: 1 1 auto; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--tph-accent); }',
      '.tph-interview-q { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--tph-text); margin: 7px 0 2px; }',
      '.tph-interview-a { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--tph-muted); line-height: 1.55; margin-bottom: 4px; }',
      // —— 角色日记 ——
      '.tph-diary-page { border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad);',
      '  padding: 10px 12px; margin: 8px 0; background: var(--tph-surface); }',
      '.tph-diary-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 4px; }',
      '.tph-diary-author { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--tph-accent);',
      '  white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }',
      '.tph-diary-text { font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--tph-text); white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }',
      // —— 真心话大冒险 ——
      '.tph-truth-card { border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad);',
      '  padding: 12px; margin: 8px 0; background: var(--tph-surface); }',
      '.tph-truth-type { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--tph-accent); }',
      '.tph-truth-content { font-size: 13px; color: var(--tph-text); line-height: 1.55; margin-bottom: 6px; }',
      '.tph-truth-response { font-size: 13px; color: var(--tph-text); line-height: 1.6;',
      '  background: var(--tph-input); border-radius: var(--tph-rad-sm); padding: 8px 10px; }',
      // —— 角色问答 ——
      '.tph-quiz-card { border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad);',
      '  padding: 12px; margin: 8px 0; background: var(--tph-surface); }',
      '.tph-quiz-quote { font-size: 15px; font-style: italic; color: var(--tph-text); margin: 6px 0; line-height: 1.6; }',
      '.tph-quiz-verdict { font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; margin-top: 8px; }',
      '.tph-quiz-verdict.ok { color: #34c759; }',
      '.tph-quiz-verdict.no { color: #ff3b30; }',
      '.tph-quiz-answer { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--tph-muted); margin-top: 3px; }',
      '.tph-quiz-opts { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; margin-top: 6px; }',
      '.tph-quiz-opt { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 7px 11px; margin: 0;',
      '  border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad-sm); background: var(--tph-surface);',
      '  color: var(--tph-text); font-size: 12.5px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .14s, background .14s; }',
      '.tph-quiz-opt:hover { background: var(--tph-hover); }',
      '.tph-quiz-opt.on { border-color: var(--tph-accent); color: var(--tph-accent); background: rgba(47,127,240,.08); }',
      '.tph-quiz-opt.ok { border-color: #34c759; color: #34c759; }',
      '.tph-quiz-opt.no { border-color: #ff3b30; color: #ff3b30; }',
      // —— 每日运势 ——
      '.tph-fortune-card { border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad);',
      '  padding: 11px 13px; margin: 8px 0; background: var(--tph-surface); }',
      '.tph-fortune-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }',
      '.tph-fortune-luck { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .5px; }',
      '.tph-fortune-card-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px; margin-top: 8px; }',
      '.tph-fortune-card-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--tph-muted); }',
      '.tph-fortune-card-val { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--tph-text); }',
      '.tph-fortune-desc { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--tph-text); margin-top: 8px; }',
      '.tph-fortune-advice { font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--tph-accent); margin-top: 4px; }',
      // —— 命运抽卡 ——
      '.tph-gacha-wallet { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 13px;',
      '  border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad); background: var(--tph-surface); margin: 8px 0; }',
      '.tph-gacha-wallet-t { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--tph-muted); }',
      '.tph-gacha-wallet-v { flex: 1 1 auto; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; color: #FFB300; }',
      '.tph-gacha-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; margin-top: 6px; }',
      '.tph-gacha-card { border: 1.8px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad);',
      '  padding: 10px 11px; background: var(--tph-surface); cursor: pointer; display: flex;',
      '  flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; transition: transform .12s, box-shadow .12s; }',
      '.tph-gacha-card:not(.frozen):active { transform: scale(.97); }',
      '.tph-gacha-card:not(.frozen):hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.12); }',
      '.tph-gacha-card.picked { border-width: 2.5px; box-shadow: 0 2px 14px rgba(255,179,0,.28); }',
      '.tph-gacha-card.frozen { opacity: .55; cursor: default; }',
      '.tph-gacha-card-r { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1px; }',
      '.tph-gacha-card-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--tph-text); }',
      '.tph-gacha-card-type { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--tph-muted); }',
      '.tph-gacha-card-desc { font-size: 11px; color: var(--tph-dim); line-height: 1.5; }',
      '.tph-gacha-card-keep { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: #FFB300; margin-top: 2px; }',
      '.tph-gacha-specials { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; background: var(--tph-border);',
      '  border-radius: var(--tph-rad-sm); overflow: hidden; }',
      '.tph-gacha-special { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 11px; background: var(--tph-surface); }',
      '.tph-gacha-special-r { flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1px; }',
      '.tph-gacha-special-mid { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }',
      '.tph-gacha-special-name { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--tph-text); }',
      '.tph-gacha-special-desc { font-size: 11px; color: var(--tph-muted); line-height: 1.45; }',

      // ========================= 麻将 v2（.tph-mj2-*，对齐新版 DOM 契约）=========================
      // 契约结构：wrap > status / cloud / styles / table(top 座位 + table-mid 三列) / hand /
      // pending / actions / chat(list+tools) / over。全部类名 tph-mj2-*，与旧 tph-mj-* 无关。

      // —— 大浮窗骨架（替代旧的 wrap 内嵌布局）——
      // overlay 铺满视口做遮罩；panel 是窗口本体（定高 + 头部固定 + 内容区滚动）。
      // 入场动画只在「刚打开」时播（JS 挂 .tph-mj2-open）；
      // 内容落位动画只在「局面真的变了」时播（JS 按状态签名挂 .tph-mj2-live）——
      // 否则 AI 每 300-600ms 一次的整屏重渲染会把动画刷成高频闪烁。
      '.tph-mj2-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 2147482000;',
      '  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 16px;',
      '  --tph-mjt-w: 34px; --tph-mjt-h: 44px; --tph-mjt-f: 14px;',
      '  background: rgba(8,10,12,.62); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px); backdrop-filter: blur(3px); }',
      '.tph-mj2-overlay.tph-mj2-open { animation: tph-mj2-fade-in .2s ease-out; }',
      '.tph-mj2-overlay.tph-mj2-open .tph-mj2-panel { animation: tph-mj2-win-in .24s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1); }',
      '@keyframes tph-mj2-fade-in { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }',
      '@keyframes tph-mj2-win-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px) scale(.982); }',
      '  to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }',
      // 窗口本体：定高撑出「一个窗口」的体积感；头部不滚，内容区自己滚
      '.tph-mj2-panel { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column;',
      '  width: min(1000px, 96vw); height: min(880px, 92vh); min-height: 380px;',
      '  background: var(--tph-bg); border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: 16px;',
      '  box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.55); overflow: hidden; }',
      // 标题栏：整条是拖拽把手（JS 用 pointer 事件拖动 panel，位置记在 session）
      '.tph-mj2-winbar { flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 9px 11px;',
      '  background: var(--tph-head); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--tph-border);',
      '  cursor: grab; user-select: none; touch-action: none; }',
      '.tph-mj2-winbar.dragging { cursor: grabbing; }',
      '.tph-mj2-grip { flex: 0 0 auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 3px); gap: 3px; opacity: .55; }',
      '.tph-mj2-grip i { display: block; width: 3px; height: 3px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--tph-muted); }',
      '.tph-mj2-win-t { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .6px;',
      '  color: var(--tph-text); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }',
      '.tph-mj2-win-sub { flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 1px 8px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .4px;',
      '  border-radius: var(--tph-pill); color: var(--tph-muted); background: var(--tph-hover); }',
      '.tph-mj2-close { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 28px; height: 28px; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box;',
      '  border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--tph-surface);',
      '  color: var(--tph-text); font-family: inherit; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer;',
      '  transition: background .14s, transform .08s; }',
      '.tph-mj2-close:hover { background: var(--tph-hover); }',
      '.tph-mj2-close:active { transform: scale(.9); }',
      // 内容区：唯一滚动容器
      '.tph-mj2-winbody { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden;',
      '  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 11px 12px 14px; overscroll-behavior: contain; }',
      // 关键：内容块一律不许被压。winbody 是定高的 flex 列，子项默认 flex-shrink:1，
      // 内容一超高就会把牌桌压扁，而牌桌自带 overflow:hidden → 弃牌河整块被裁掉。
      // 锁成 flex:0 0 auto 后，超高就交给 winbody 自己滚。
      '.tph-mj2-winbody > * { flex: 0 0 auto; }',
      '.tph-mj2-winbody::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 7px; }',
      '.tph-mj2-winbody::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--tph-border); border-radius: 4px; }',
      // 内容区外框：只为给「结算浮层」当定位容器（absolute 相对它铺满）。
      // 这样结算卡盖在内容上、不占高度 —— 否则横幅+番种卡会把牌桌和手牌顶到折叠线以下。
      '.tph-mj2-bodywrap { position: relative; flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0;',
      '  display: flex; flex-direction: column; }',
      // 结算浮层：半透明遮罩 + 居中的横幅/番种卡；点任意处收起去看牌桌
      '.tph-mj2-settle { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 6; display: flex; flex-direction: column;',
      '  align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 9px; padding: 14px 12px;',
      '  overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; cursor: pointer;',
      '  background: rgba(6,8,10,.74); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px); backdrop-filter: blur(4px);',
      '  animation: tph-mj2-fade-in .18s ease-out; }',
      '.tph-mj2-settle > * { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 100%; max-width: 540px; }',
      '.tph-mj2-settle-hint { max-width: 540px; text-align: center; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .5px;',
      '  color: rgba(255,255,255,.5); }',
      // 结算态下小屏也要能一眼看全（卡宽跟着浮层收）
      '.tph-mj2-bodywrap > .tph-mj2-settle .tph-mj2-card { max-width: 100%; }',
      // 局面变化时的轻微落位：只改透明度，避免位移造成的「跳」
      '.tph-mj2-overlay.tph-mj2-live .tph-mj2-table,',
      '.tph-mj2-overlay.tph-mj2-live .tph-mj2-hand { animation: tph-mj2-rise .18s ease-out; }',
      '@keyframes tph-mj2-rise { from { opacity: .62; } to { opacity: 1; } }',

      // —— 状态行：badge 标签 + 阶段文字 + 牌墙余数 + 回合指示 ——
      '.tph-mj2-status { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px;',
      '  min-height: 20px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--tph-muted); }',
      // badge：彩色小标签；云库模式换青绿色
      '.tph-mj2-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 1px 8px;',
      '  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .3px; border-radius: var(--tph-pill);',
      '  color: var(--tph-accent); background: rgba(47,127,240,.13); }',
      '.tph-mj2-badge.cloud { color: #0a8f7e; background: rgba(10,143,126,.15); }',
      // 阶段文字：比辅助信息重一档
      '.tph-mj2-phase-t { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--tph-text); }',
      // 牌墙余数：等宽字体数字，递减时宽度不跳
      '.tph-mj2-wall { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--tph-dim); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }',
      // 回合指示：琥珀色 pill 推到行尾（配色沿用档案页「主角」徽章，两套主题都验证过）
      '.tph-mj2-turn { margin-left: auto; padding: 1px 8px; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600;',
      '  border-radius: var(--tph-pill); color: #9a6700; background: rgba(255,193,7,.20); }',
      // 轮到你了：暖色呼吸（一直挂着，不看牌桌也能扫到「该我了」）
      '.tph-mj2-turn.on { animation: tph-mj2-turn 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }',
      '@keyframes tph-mj2-turn { 0%, 100% { background: rgba(255,193,7,.20); box-shadow: none; }',
      '  50% { background: rgba(255,193,7,.42); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,193,7,.45); } }',

      // —— 云库 URL 配置行：label + input + btn + st 同行排，挤了自动折行 ——
      '.tph-mj2-cloud { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 10px;',
      '  font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--tph-text); background: var(--tph-surface);',
      '  border: 1px dashed var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad); }',
      // 类名对齐 JS：输入框 = .tph-mj2-url，按钮复用 .tph-mj2-btn，状态 = .tph-mj2-st
      '.tph-mj2-url { flex: 1 1 180px; min-width: 0; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 6px 9px;',
      '  font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; color: var(--tph-text); background: var(--tph-input);',
      '  border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad-sm); outline: none;',
      '  transition: border-color .14s; }',
      '.tph-mj2-url:focus { border-color: var(--tph-accent); }',
      // 「加载」是这一行的主操作：在云库行里升级成实心强调色
      '.tph-mj2-cloud .tph-mj2-btn { border-color: transparent; background: var(--tph-accent); color: #fff; }',
      '.tph-mj2-cloud .tph-mj2-btn:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); border-color: transparent; }',
      '.tph-mj2-cloud .tph-mj2-btn:active { filter: brightness(.94); }',
      '.tph-mj2-st { flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: 11px; color: var(--tph-dim); }',

      // —— 风格确认面板：4 行「名称 + 标签 + 描述」 ——
      '.tph-mj2-styles { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; padding: 9px 11px;',
      '  background: var(--tph-surface); border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad); }',
      '.tph-mj2-style-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 8px; }',
      '.tph-mj2-style-name { flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--tph-text); }',
      // 风格标签：紫色 pill（与 .tph-theater-tag 同一套视觉语言）
      '.tph-mj2-style-tag { flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 1px 7px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500;',
      '  letter-spacing: .3px; border-radius: var(--tph-pill); color: var(--tph-accent-2);',
      '  background: rgba(106,88,232,.13); }',
      // 四种风格各配一色（旧版只有一个通用色，四种风格长得一模一样）
      '.tph-mj2-style-tag.st-进攻 { color: #d94848; background: rgba(217,72,72,.14); }',
      '.tph-mj2-style-tag.st-稳健 { color: #1f9d55; background: rgba(31,157,85,.14); }',
      '.tph-mj2-style-tag.st-保守 { color: #2f7ff0; background: rgba(47,127,240,.14); }',
      '.tph-mj2-style-tag.st-搅局 { color: #b4690e; background: rgba(232,134,46,.16); }',
      '.tph-mj2-style-tag.st-平衡 { color: var(--tph-muted); background: var(--tph-hover); }',
      // 描述吃剩余宽度，允许换行
      '.tph-mj2-style-desc { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--tph-dim); }',

      // —— 牌桌：三行（上=对家 / 中=左+中央+右 / 下=玩家信息条）。
      // 深绿绒毯渐变铺底，四层 gradient 叠出布面质感，内阴影把四角压暗。
      // 三行都必须是 auto：写成 1fr 会被 grid 压到可用高度以内，
      // 再叠加 overflow:hidden 就把中央的弃牌河整块裁掉了（实测过）。
      // 千万别再加 aspect-ratio：高度由内容撑。
      '.tph-mj2-table { display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto auto auto; align-content: start;',
      '  gap: 8px; padding: 10px; min-height: 240px;',
      '  border-radius: 18px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.35);',
      '  background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(255,255,255,.08) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 40%),',
      '  repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,.05) 0 1px, rgba(0,0,0,0) 1px 3px),',
      '  repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,0,0,.05) 0 1px, rgba(0,0,0,0) 1px 3px),',
      '  linear-gradient(180deg, #2e6b46 0%, #1e5134 70%, #163c27 100%);',
      '  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,.10), inset 0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,.36),',
      '    0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.22); }',

      // —— AI 座位：绒毯上的半透明白卡片（top / left / right 位置类由 JS 挂）。
      // 深绿绒毯是两套主题里的固定色，座位内文字写死浅色系，不跟 --tph-text。
      '.tph-mj2-seat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 9px; min-width: 0;',
      '  border-radius: var(--tph-rad); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);',
      '  background: rgba(255,255,255,.07); transition: border-color .18s, box-shadow .18s; }',
      // 当前回合：金边 + 同色柔光，光随回合在座位间缓缓移动
      '.tph-mj2-seat.on { border-color: rgba(255,190,60,.85);',
      '  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,190,60,.35), 0 0 16px rgba(255,190,60,.28); }',
      // 座位头部：头像 + 名字 + 剩牌数
      // （类名对齐 JS 的 -head/-name/-cnt；旧版写的是 -seat-head/-seat-name/-seat-cnt，
      //   对不上 → 名字和张数掉进块级流里竖着排）
      '.tph-mj2-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }',
      '.tph-mj2-name { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #f5f7ee;',
      '  white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }',
      '.tph-mj2-cnt { flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 0 6px; font-size: 9.5px; line-height: 14px; color: #ffd76a;',
      '  background: rgba(0,0,0,.42); border-radius: var(--tph-pill); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }',
      // 手牌背：换行平铺（旧名 -seat-backs 对不上 JS 的 -backs → 牌背容器无 display:flex，
      //   inline 的 span 拿不到宽高，整排塌成 0 尺寸直接看不见）
      '.tph-mj2-backs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 3px; }',
      // 牌背：18×24 深蓝渐变；display:block 必须（span 默认 inline，宽高会失效）
      '.tph-mj2-back { display: block; flex: 0 0 auto; width: 18px; height: 24px; box-sizing: border-box;',
      '  border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0;',
      '  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #2c5575 0%, #1c3a55 55%, #152a40 100%);',
      '  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.13), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.20),',
      '    0 1.5px 2.5px rgba(0,0,0,.40); }',

      // —— 桌面中部三列：左座位 | 中央区 | 右座位。列内不拉伸，高度随内容 ——
      '.tph-mj2-table-mid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr 1fr; gap: 8px; align-items: start; }',

      // —— 中央区：宝牌指示 + 四家弃牌河，深一格的内陷面板 ——
      '.tph-mj2-mid { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; padding: 7px;',
      '  border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.28); border-radius: var(--tph-rad); background: rgba(0,0,0,.16); }',
      // 宝牌行：横排小牌；min-height 免得宝牌未开出时整块塌陷跳动
      '.tph-mj2-doras { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; min-height: 30px; }',
      // 宝牌指示：旧版是个没有牌面的裸 span（文字直接飘在绒毯上），补成和小牌同款
      '.tph-mj2-dora { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: 0 0 auto;',
      '  min-width: 22px; height: 30px; padding: 0 4px; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 3px;',
      '  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #26241d;',
      '  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fefdf7 0%, #f7f2e4 55%, #e9e2cf 100%);',
      '  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.06), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95),',
      '    0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.30); }',
      // 弃牌河：每家一组，纵向堆叠
      '.tph-mj2-discards { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }',
      '.tph-mj2-disc-pl { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 3px; min-width: 0;',
      '  padding: 5px 6px; border-radius: var(--tph-rad-sm); background: rgba(255,255,255,.05); }',
      // 组标题独占一行（类名对齐 JS 的 -disc-pl-t；旧名 -pl-t 对不上 → 标题和牌挤在同一行）
      '.tph-mj2-disc-pl-t { flex: 0 0 100%; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .5px;',
      '  color: rgba(255,235,170,.78); }',

      // —— 牌面：34×44 白底圆角，真牌观感（暖白渐变 + 内高光 + 底部投影）。
      // 牌面是实物配色，不随主题变量走。手牌是 button，必须自带完整外观（项目无全局复位）。
      // 牌面尺寸统一走 --tph-mjt-w/h/f 三个变量（定义在 .tph-mj2-overlay 上），
      // 窗口变窄时只改这三个变量就能整体缩放，不必逐个区块改。
      '.tph-mj2-tile { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;',
      '  gap: 1px; flex: 0 0 auto; width: var(--tph-mjt-w, 34px); height: var(--tph-mjt-h, 44px);',
      '  box-sizing: border-box; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 5px; font-family: inherit;',
      '  font-size: var(--tph-mjt-f, 14px); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1;',
      '  color: #26241d; white-space: nowrap; user-select: none; cursor: pointer;',
      '  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fefdf7 0%, #f7f2e4 55%, #e9e2cf 100%);',
      '  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.06), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95),',
      '    0 1.5px 2.5px rgba(0,0,0,.32);',
      '  transition: transform .08s, box-shadow .08s, filter .08s; }',
      // 刚摸的那张：金色描边 + 微光 + 落位动画，一眼看出「这张是新摸的」
      '.tph-mj2-tile.drawn { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(255,180,40,.90), 0 0 10px rgba(255,190,60,.45),',
      '    0 1.5px 2.5px rgba(0,0,0,.32); }',
      '.tph-mj2-overlay.tph-mj2-live .tph-mj2-tile.drawn { animation: tph-mj2-deal .22s ease-out; }',
      '@keyframes tph-mj2-deal { from { transform: translateY(-6px) scale(1.06); opacity: .55; }',
      '  to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } }',
      // 牌河里最后打出的一张：暖色描边 + 脉冲，一眼看出「刚打了什么」
      '.tph-mj2-tile.last { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(255,120,90,.95), 0 0 9px rgba(255,120,90,.5),',
      '    0 1.5px 2.5px rgba(0,0,0,.32); }',
      '.tph-mj2-overlay.tph-mj2-live .tph-mj2-tile.last { animation: tph-mj2-last .5s ease-out; }',
      '@keyframes tph-mj2-last { 0% { transform: translateY(-5px) scale(1.1); } 100% { transform: none; } }',
      // 悬停浮起 / 按下压进绒毯的反馈
      '.tph-mj2-tile:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); transform: translateY(-2px); }',
      '.tph-mj2-tile:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.94); filter: brightness(.97);',
      '  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.09); }',
      // 小号牌（弃牌河 / 宝牌 / 听牌条用）：按主牌尺寸等比缩，跟着变量一起自适应
      '.tph-mj2-tile.sm { width: calc(var(--tph-mjt-w, 34px) * .64); height: calc(var(--tph-mjt-h, 44px) * .68);',
      '  border-radius: 3px; font-size: calc(var(--tph-mjt-f, 14px) * .74); }',
      '.tph-mj2-doras .tph-mj2-tile, .tph-mj2-disc-pl .tph-mj2-tile {',
      '  width: calc(var(--tph-mjt-w, 34px) * .64); height: calc(var(--tph-mjt-h, 44px) * .68);',
      '  border-radius: 3px; font-size: calc(var(--tph-mjt-f, 14px) * .74); }',

      // —— 手牌区：一整块带底色的条（含牌面 + 提示语 + 听牌提示），轮到你就呼吸 ——
      '.tph-mj2-hand { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 9px;',
      '  border-radius: var(--tph-rad); border: 1px solid transparent; background: rgba(255,255,255,.05);',
      '  transition: border-color .2s; }',
      '.tph-mj2-hand.on { border-color: rgba(255,190,60,.45); }',
      // 轮到你可出牌：手牌区慢慢呼吸，视线一扫就知道该你了
      '.tph-mj2-hand.on .tph-mj2-hand-tiles { animation: tph-mj2-breathe 1.9s ease-in-out infinite; }',
      '@keyframes tph-mj2-breathe { 0%, 100% { filter: none; }',
      '  50% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(255,190,60,.45)); } }',
      // 手牌排：一行排开，窄了自动换行（旧版没有 -hand-tiles 规则，纯靠父级 flex 侥幸兜住）
      '.tph-mj2-hand-tiles { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; }',
      '.tph-mj2-hand-acts { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px;',
      '  font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--tph-muted); }',

      // —— 响应面板：胡/杠/碰/吃/过。这是唯一会误操作的入口，等级必须一眼可分 ——
      '.tph-mj2-pending { display: flex; align-items: stretch; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; padding: 10px;',
      '  background: var(--tph-surface); border: 1px solid var(--tph-border); border-radius: var(--tph-rad);',
      '  box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.10); }',
      // 没有可响应的操作时不占位（父级 gap 也不产生空隙）
      '.tph-mj2-pending:empty { display: none; }',
      // 基础外观挂在按钮元素上（项目无全局 button 复位）。
      // 选择器写成 .tph-mj2-pending .tph-mj2-act（而非 .tph-mj2-pending button）：
      // 带元素名的写法特异度更高，会把下面按类型上的底色 / 边框覆盖掉。
      '.tph-mj2-pending .tph-mj2-act, .tph-mj2-pending .tph-btn { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 64px;',
      '  min-height: 44px; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; box-sizing: border-box; font-family: inherit;',
      '  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 3px; border: 1.5px solid transparent;',
      '  border-radius: var(--tph-rad-sm); color: #fff; cursor: pointer;',
      '  text-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.32); transition: filter .14s, transform .08s; }',
      '.tph-mj2-pending .tph-mj2-act:hover, .tph-mj2-pending .tph-btn:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); }',
      '.tph-mj2-pending .tph-mj2-act:active, .tph-mj2-pending .tph-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px);',
      '  filter: brightness(.94); }',
      // 胡 = 最大最红（实心宽键）/ 杠=蓝 / 碰=橙 / 吃=绿 / 过 = 弱化成描边
      // 底色都压深一档：白字要压得住（#e8862e / #1f9d55 那种亮底上白字几乎看不见）
      '.tph-mj2-pending .tph-mj2-act.ron { flex: 2 1 40%; background: #d13c3c; letter-spacing: 5px; }',
      '.tph-mj2-pending .tph-mj2-act.kan { background: #2f6fd0; }',
