        if (typeof runStorageClean !== 'function') { notify('清理模块未加载', 'warning'); return; }
        var trimmed = runStorageClean();
        notify(trimmed ? '已按阈值清理超量的旧数据' : '数据都在阈值以内，无需清理', trimmed ? 'success' : 'info');
        rerender();
      },
    }, ['立即清理']));
    body.appendChild(acts);
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // 13. 微信（会话列表 / 私聊 / 群聊 / 红包 / 转账 / 通讯录 / 发现 / 我）
  // ===========================================================================

  /** 微信底部导航：微信 | 通讯录 | 发现 | 我 */
  const WX_TABS = ['chat', 'contacts', 'discover', 'me'];
  const WX_TAB_NAMES = { chat: '微信', contacts: '通讯录', discover: '发现', me: '我' };

  /** 底部导航的公共配置 */
  function wxTabOpts(tab) {
    const unread = wxUnreadTotal();
    return {
      app: 'wechat',
      tab: tab,
      badges: unread > 0 ? { chat: unread } : null,
      onTab: (id) => {
        session.wxTab = id;
        session.wxSub = null;
        session.wxNewOpen = false;
        session.wxMenu = null;
        session.wxOps = false;
        renderScreen();
      },
      onHome: () => gotoApp('home'),
    };
  }

  // ========================= 会话列表 =========================

  function wxBuildList(el) {
    const shell = uiShell(Object.assign(wxTabOpts('chat'), {
      title: '微信',
      nav: {
        search: '搜索',
        query: session.wxQuery,
        onSearch: (v) => { session.wxQuery = v; renderScreen(); },
        actions: [{
          icon: 'plus', title: '新建会话',
          onClick: () => { session.wxNew = { selected: [] }; session.wxNewOpen = true; renderScreen(); },
        }],
      },
    }));

    if (session.wxNewOpen && session.wxNew) wxBuildNew(shell.body);

    let list = chatsSorted();
    if (session.wxQuery) list = list.filter((c) => uiHit(session.wxQuery, c.name, (c.members || []).join(' ')));
    if (!list.length) {
      shell.body.appendChild(uiBlank({
        icon: 'wechat',
        title: session.wxQuery ? '没有找到会话' : '还没有会话',
        text: session.wxQuery ? '换个关键词试试。' : '选一个角色开始聊天，选两个以上可以建群。',
        actions: session.wxQuery ? null : [{
          text: '新建会话', primary: true,
          onClick: () => { session.wxNew = { selected: [] }; session.wxNewOpen = true; renderScreen(); },
        }],
      }));
    } else {
      list.forEach((c) => shell.body.appendChild(wxBuildItem(c)));
    }
    uiFeel(shell, { onRefresh: () => { renderScreen(); } });
    el.appendChild(shell.root);
  }

  function wxBuildNew(el) {
    const want = session.wxNew;
    const card = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-new' });
    // 原来这里挂着一行常驻说明「选 1 个角色 = 私聊…」。现在这句话是抽屉展开后的
    // 说明 —— 同一句写两遍是冗余，而收起态的空摘要已改成「点击选择」，
    // 可点提示不缺了。省下的这一行正是本次改造要还回去的纵向空间。

    // 确认按钮先建好引用，点选时局部更新文案
    const goBtn = h('button', {
      class: 'tph-btn primary sm', type: 'button',
      onclick: () => {
        const c = wxCreateChat(want.selected);
        if (!c) { notify('至少选 1 个角色', 'warning'); return; }
        session.wxNew = null;
        session.wxNewOpen = false;
        session.wxActiveId = c.id;
        session.wxDraft = '';
        renderScreen();
      },
    });
    // 抽屉句柄。收起行右侧的摘要与计数徽章靠它刷新 —— 抽屉不知道外部选中集合变没变，
    // 所以每次选中集合一变就调 refreshGo()，摘要和按钮文案一起走。
    let drawer = null;
    const refreshGo = () => {
      goBtn.textContent = '开始聊天' + (want.selected.length >= 2 ? '（群聊 ' + want.selected.length + ' 人）' : '');
      if (drawer) drawer.sync();
    };
    const toggleSel = (n) => {
      const i = want.selected.indexOf(n);
      if (i >= 0) want.selected.splice(i, 1);
      else want.selected.push(n);
      refreshGo();
    };

    // 候选容器：有候选时是抽屉内部的滚动区，没候选时是卡片里的普通一行
    let chips;
    /** 长按删除候选角色（从剧情名单移除；有档案的不许删） */
    const chipLongPressDelete = (n) => {
      const prof = (session.profiles || []).find((p) => p.name === n);
      if (prof) { notify('「' + n + '」已有档案，请到档案App删除', 'warning'); return; }
      if (!HW.confirm('从候选中删除「' + n + '」？（不影响已有聊天记录）')) return;
      if (typeof removeChar === 'function') removeChar(n);
      const si = want.selected.indexOf(n);
      if (si >= 0) want.selected.splice(si, 1);
      refreshGo();
      notify('已删除「' + n + '」', 'success');
      chipRemoveUi(n);
    };
    /** 造一个候选 chip：点击只切换自己的样式，不整页重绘；长按删除候选 */
    const mkChip = (n) => {
      const on = want.selected.indexOf(n) >= 0;
      const chip = h('button', {
        class: 'tph-chip' + (on ? ' on' : ''), type: 'button',
        title: '点击选择 · 长按删除',
        onclick: () => {
          toggleSel(n);
          const nowOn = want.selected.indexOf(n) >= 0;
          chip.className = 'tph-chip' + (nowOn ? ' on' : '');
        },
      }, [n]);
      let pressTimer = 0;
      const clearPress = () => { if (pressTimer) { clearTimeout(pressTimer); pressTimer = 0; } };
      chip.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => {
        clearPress();
        pressTimer = setTimeout(() => { pressTimer = 0; chipLongPressDelete(n); }, 500);
      });
      ['pointerup', 'pointerleave', 'pointercancel'].forEach((ev) => chip.addEventListener(ev, clearPress));
      return chip;
    };
    /** 删除候选后把它的 chip 从列表里摘掉（局部，不整页重绘） */
    const chipRemoveUi = (n) => {
      const doomed = Array.from(chips.children).find((c) => c.textContent === n);
      if (doomed) chips.removeChild(doomed);
    };
    // 输入框先建：有候选时它要作为抽屉的展开内容一起塞进去
    const inp = h('input', { class: 'tph-input', placeholder: '手动输入角色名，回车添加' });

    // 候选收进抽屉：收起只占一行，不再把下面的输入框和按钮一起顶出屏幕。
    // 没有候选时不套抽屉 —— 里面没东西可点，只会白白多一次展开动作。
    const cands = wxCandidates();
    if (cands.length) {
      drawer = uiPickDrawer({
        title: '选角色',
        hint: '选 1 个角色 = 私聊；选 2 个以上 = 建群一起聊。候选多了可在框内滚动。',
        tools: inp,
        summary: () => ({ text: want.selected.join(' + '), count: want.selected.length }),
      });
      chips = drawer.chips;
      cands.forEach((n) => chips.appendChild(mkChip(n)));
      card.appendChild(drawer.root);
    } else {
      chips = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-chips' });
      card.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-hint', text: '还没识别到角色。用下面的输入框手动加名字也能建会话。' }));
      card.appendChild(inp);
      card.appendChild(chips);
    }

    inp.addEventListener('keydown', (ev) => {
      if (ev.key !== 'Enter') return;
      ev.preventDefault();
      const v = String(inp.value || '').trim();
      if (!v) return;
      // 已有 chip：直接选中它；没有：新建 chip 追加并选中
      let chip = Array.from(chips.children).find((c) => c.textContent === v);
      if (!chip) {
        chip = mkChip(v);
        chips.appendChild(chip);
      }
      if (want.selected.indexOf(v) < 0) toggleSel(v);
      chip.className = 'tph-chip on';
      inp.value = '';
    });
    // 注意：这里**不能**再 card.appendChild(inp) —— 有候选时 inp 已经挂进抽屉了，
    // 再 append 一次会把它从抽屉里搬出来（appendChild 是移动，不是复制）。

    const acts = h('div', { class: 'tph-actions' });
    refreshGo();
    acts.appendChild(goBtn);
    acts.appendChild(h('button', {
      class: 'tph-btn ghost sm', type: 'button',
      onclick: () => { session.wxNew = null; session.wxNewOpen = false; renderScreen(); },
    }, ['取消']));
    card.appendChild(acts);
    el.appendChild(card);
  }

  // ========================= 聊天页 =========================

  function wxBuildChat(el, chat) {
    // 打开会话即已读：进来先清零未读（列表红点与底部角标随之归零）
    if (Number(chat.unread) > 0) { chat.unread = 0; saveChats(); }

    const nav = h('div', { class: 'tph-nav' });
    const back = h('button', {
      class: 'tph-nav-btn', type: 'button', title: '返回会话列表',
      onclick: () => { session.wxActiveId = null; session.wxOps = false; session.wxDraft = ''; session.wxScroll = el.scrollTop; renderScreen(); },
    });
    back.appendChild(iconSvg('back', 16));
    nav.appendChild(back);
    const title = h('span', { class: 'tph-nav-title center', text: chat.name });
    title.title = chat.members.join('、');
    nav.appendChild(title);
    if (chat.type === 'group') nav.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-badge', text: chat.members.length + '人' }));
    const ops = h('button', {
      class: 'tph-nav-btn', type: 'button', title: '成员与操作',
      onclick: () => { session.wxOps = !session.wxOps; renderScreen(); },
    });
    ops.appendChild(iconSvg('dots', 16));
    if (session.wxOps) ops.setAttribute('data-on', '1');
    nav.appendChild(ops);
    el.appendChild(nav);

    if (session.wxOps) wxBuildOps(el, chat);

    // 消息区：保存引用到 session，让 wxSend 可以局部刷新而不动输入栏
    const msgs = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-msgs' });
    session._wxMsgsEl = msgs;
    session._wxChatEl = el;
    const fillMsgs = () => {
      clearChildren(msgs);
      if (!chat.msgs.length) {
        msgs.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-empty', text: chat.type === 'group' ? '群聊建好了，说点什么吧' : '发出第一条消息吧' }));
      } else {
        // 相隔超过 5 分钟就插一条居中的时间胶囊，替代原来每条气泡下方的小时间戳
        let lastTs = 0;
        chat.msgs.forEach((m) => {
          const hidden = m.kind === 'system' && !config.wechat.showSystem;
          if (!hidden && (!lastTs || (Number(m.ts) || 0) - lastTs > 5 * 60000)) {
            const sep = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-tsep' });
            sep.appendChild(h('span', { text: fmtTime(m.ts) }));
            msgs.appendChild(sep);
          }
          if (!hidden) lastTs = Number(m.ts) || lastTs;
          wxBuildMsg(msgs, chat, m);
        });
      }
      if (session.wxPhase === 'sending') msgs.appendChild(wxBuildTyping(chat));
    };
    fillMsgs();
    el.appendChild(msgs);
    // 局部刷新消息区（保留输入栏焦点与滚动位置）。
    // 注意滚到底要滚外层 el（.tph-screen，聊天页的真实滚动容器）——
    // .tph-wx-msgs 只有 min-height 没有 overflow，它自己永远不滚。
    session._wxRefreshMsgs = () => {
      fillMsgs();
      setTimeout(() => { try { el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight; } catch (_e) { /* 忽略 */ } }, 0);
    };

    // 输入栏（真实微信布局：输入框 / 表情 / 语音识别麦克风 / 加号或发送键）
    const bar = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-input' });

    const ta = h('textarea', { class: 'tph-wx-ta', rows: '1' });
    ta.value = session.wxDraft || '';
    ta.placeholder = chat.type === 'group' ? '发消息…（@角色名 可点名）' : '发消息…';
    ta.addEventListener('input', () => {
      session.wxDraft = ta.value;
      if (session._wxSyncBar) session._wxSyncBar();
      wxDetectAt(ta, chat, bar);
    });
    ta.addEventListener('keydown', (ev) => {
      if (ev.key === 'Enter' && !ev.shiftKey && config.wechat.enterToSend) {
        ev.preventDefault();
        wxSend(chat);
      }
    });
    bar.appendChild(ta);
    session._wxTaEl = ta;   // 保存引用：wxSend 后手动清空（不重绘输入栏）

    const smileBtn = h('button', {
      class: 'tph-nav-btn', type: 'button', title: '表情',
    });
    smileBtn.appendChild(iconSvg('smile', 18));
    bar.appendChild(smileBtn);

    // 表情面板：常驻渲染，点按钮只切换显隐（不整页重绘，避免闪烁）
    const EMOJIS = ['😀','😂','❤️','👍','😢','😡','😱','🤔','🎉','🙏','💪','😍','😭','🥰','😅','😉','😌','😎','🤗','✨','🔥','💯','🫶','👋'];
    const panel = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-emoji', style: 'position:absolute;bottom:46px;left:0;right:0;background:var(--tph-raised);border-top:1px solid var(--tph-border);padding:8px 6px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(8,1fr);gap:2px;z-index:4;max-height:120px;overflow-y:auto;display:none' });
    EMOJIS.forEach((em) => {
      const b = h('button', { class: 'tph-chip', type: 'button', style: 'font-size:18px;padding:4px 0;line-height:1' }, [em]);
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        session.wxDraft = (session.wxDraft || '') + em;
        if (session._wxTaEl) { session._wxTaEl.value = session.wxDraft; try { session._wxTaEl.focus(); } catch (_e) { /* 忽略 */ } }
        if (session._wxSyncBar) session._wxSyncBar();
      });
      panel.appendChild(b);
    });
    bar.appendChild(panel);

    // 表情按钮切换面板显隐（局部，不整页重绘）
    smileBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      var opening = panel.style.display === 'none';
      panel.style.display = opening ? 'grid' : 'none';
      if (opening && payMenu) payMenu.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // 语音识别麦克风：按住说话，松开识别+发送（或填入输入框）
    const _sttAvail = !!(HW.SpeechRecognition || HW.webkitSpeechRecognition || window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition);
    const sttBtn = h('button', {
      class: 'tph-nav-btn' + (_sttAvail ? '' : ' disabled'), type: 'button', title: '按住说话',
    });
    sttBtn.appendChild(iconSvg('mic', 16));
    if (_sttAvail) {
      const onSttDown = (ev) => {
        if (!(config.stt && config.stt.enabled)) { notify('语音识别未开启，去设置里开启', 'warning'); return; }
        if (session._wxSttOn) return;
        ev.preventDefault();
        sttBtn.setAttribute('data-on', '1');
        sttBtn.style.color = '#FF3B30';
        session._wxSttOn = true;
        startSTT(
          (partial) => {
            if (session._wxTaEl) session._wxTaEl.value = (session.wxDraft || '') + partial;
          },
          (finalText) => {
            session._wxSttOn = false;
            sttBtn.removeAttribute('data-on');
            sttBtn.style.color = '';
            if (finalText && finalText.trim()) {
              session.wxDraft = (session.wxDraft || '') + finalText;
              if (session._wxTaEl) { session._wxTaEl.value = session.wxDraft; try { session._wxTaEl.focus(); } catch (_e) { /* */ } }
              if (session._wxSyncBar) session._wxSyncBar();
              if (config.stt.autoSend !== false) {
                notify('语音发送：' + finalText.slice(0, 20), 'success');
                setTimeout(() => { try { wxSend(chat); } catch (_e) { /* */ } }, 100);
              } else {
                notify('识别完成，按发送', 'info');
              }
            }
          }
        );
      };
      const onSttUp = () => {
        if (session._wxSttOn) { stopSTT(); }
      };
      sttBtn.addEventListener('pointerdown', onSttDown);
      sttBtn.addEventListener('pointerup', onSttUp);
      sttBtn.addEventListener('pointerleave', onSttUp);
      sttBtn.addEventListener('pointercancel', onSttUp);
    } else {
      sttBtn.addEventListener('click', () => notify('浏览器不支持语音识别（Chrome/Edge 可用）', 'warning'));
    }
    bar.appendChild(sttBtn);

    const addBtn = h('button', {
      class: 'tph-nav-btn', type: 'button', title: '红包 / 转账',
    });
    addBtn.appendChild(iconSvg('plus', 16));
    bar.appendChild(addBtn);

    // 加号菜单：常驻渲染，点按钮只切换显隐（不整页重绘，避免闪烁）
    const payMenu = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-chips', style: 'position:absolute;bottom:46px;left:10px;background:var(--tph-raised);border:1px solid var(--tph-border);border-radius:8px;padding:7px;z-index:4;display:none' });
    payMenu.appendChild(h('button', {
      class: 'tph-chip', type: 'button',
      onclick: () => { payMenu.style.display = 'none'; wxSendPay(chat, 'redpacket'); },
    }, ['红包']));
    payMenu.appendChild(h('button', {
      class: 'tph-chip', type: 'button',
      onclick: () => { payMenu.style.display = 'none'; wxSendPay(chat, 'transfer'); },
    }, ['转账']));
    bar.appendChild(payMenu);
    addBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      var opening = payMenu.style.display === 'none';
      payMenu.style.display = opening ? 'block' : 'none';
      if (opening) panel.style.display = 'none';
    });

    const sending = session.wxPhase === 'sending';
    const sendBtn = h('button', {
      class: 'tph-wx-send' + (sending ? ' busy' : ''), type: 'button',
      onclick: () => { panel.style.display = 'none'; payMenu.style.display = 'none'; wxSend(chat); },
    }, [sending ? '…' : '发送']);
    bar.appendChild(sendBtn);
    session._wxSendBtn = sendBtn;   // 保存引用：发送中/完成时局部更新按钮状态

    // 草稿非空 → 显示「发送」；为空 → 显示「+」。只切显隐，不重绘输入栏
    const syncBar = () => {
      const has = String(session.wxDraft || '').length > 0;
      sendBtn.style.display = has ? '' : 'none';
      addBtn.style.display = has ? 'none' : '';
    };
    syncBar();
    session._wxSyncBar = syncBar;
    el.appendChild(bar);

    // 渲染后滚到底（新消息总在视野里）
    setTimeout(() => {
      try { el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight; } catch (_e) { /* 滚动失败不影响渲染 */ }
    }, 0);
  }

  function wxBuildMsg(msgs, chat, m) {
    if (m.kind === 'system') {
      if (!config.wechat.showSystem) return;
      const sys = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-sys' });
      sys.appendChild(h('span', { text: m.text }));
      msgs.appendChild(sys);
      return;
    }

    const mine = m.from === 'me';
    const row = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-msg' + (mine ? ' me' : '') });
    if (!mine) row.appendChild(avaNode(m.from, 34, false));

    const col = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-col' });
    if (!mine && chat.type === 'group') col.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-sender', text: m.from }));

    if (m.kind === 'redpacket' || m.kind === 'transfer') {
      col.appendChild(wxBuildPay(m, mine));
    } else if (m.kind === 'voice') {
      const b = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-bubble tph-wx-voice' });
      const w = h('span', { class: 'tph-wx-voice-w' });
      [6, 11, 8, 13, 7].forEach((hh) => w.appendChild(h('i', { style: 'height:' + hh + 'px' })));
      b.appendChild(w);
      b.appendChild(h('span', { text: Math.max(1, Math.round(String(m.text || '').length / 6)) + '″' }));
      b.title = '语音条（点击查看文字）';
      b.addEventListener('click', () => notify(m.text || '（无内容）'));
      col.appendChild(b);
    } else if (m.kind === 'image') {
      col.appendChild(wxBuildImg(m));
    } else {
      const b = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-bubble', text: m.text });
      wxAttachLongPress(b, m, chat);
      col.appendChild(b);
    }

    // 时间统一由消息之间的 .tph-wx-tsep 呈现，气泡下不再挂小时间戳
    row.appendChild(col);
    msgs.appendChild(row);
  }

  function wxBuildTyping(chat) {
    const row = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-msg' });
    const who = chat.type === 'group' ? (chat.members[0] || '…') : (chat.members[0] || '…');
    row.appendChild(avaNode(who, 34, false));
    const bubble = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-bubble tph-wx-typing' });
    [0, 1, 2].forEach((i) => bubble.appendChild(h('i', { style: 'animation-delay:' + (i * 0.15) + 's' })));
    row.appendChild(bubble);
    return row;
  }

  function wxBuildOps(el, chat) {
    const card = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-ops' });

    /** 成员增删后局部同步聊天页头部（标题 + 成员数 badge），不整页重绘 */
    const syncHead = () => {
      const ui = card.closest('.tph-ui');
      if (!ui) return;
      const title = ui.querySelector('.tph-nav-title');
      if (title) { title.textContent = chat.name; title.title = chat.members.join('、'); }
      let badge = ui.querySelector('.tph-nav .tph-badge');
      if (chat.type === 'group') {
        if (badge) badge.textContent = chat.members.length + '人';
        else if (title && title.parentNode) {
          badge = h('span', { class: 'tph-badge', text: chat.members.length + '人' });
          title.parentNode.insertBefore(badge, title.nextSibling);
        }
      } else if (badge) {
        badge.remove();
      }
    };

    /** 成员增删后只重建本卡片内容（成员/候选 chips + 计数），不整页重绘 */
    const fill = () => {
      clearChildren(card);
      card.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-label', text: chat.type === 'group' ? '群成员（' + chat.members.length + '）' : '对话对象' }));

      const chips = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-chips' });
      chat.members.forEach((m) => {
        chips.appendChild(h('button', {
          class: 'tph-chip on', type: 'button', title: '点一下把「' + m + '」移出对话',
          onclick: () => {
            if (chat.members.length <= 1) { notify('至少保留 1 个成员', 'warning'); return; }
            chat.members = chat.members.filter((x) => x !== m);
            if (chat.members.length < 2) chat.type = 'dm';
            if (!chat.nameManual) chat.name = wxAutoName(chat.members);
            saveChats();
            syncHead();
            fill();
          },
        }, [m + ' ×']));
      });
      card.appendChild(chips);

      const cands = wxCandidates().filter((n) => chat.members.indexOf(n) < 0);
      if (cands.length) {
        const quick = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-chips' });
        cands.slice(0, 12).forEach((n) => {
          quick.appendChild(h('button', {
            class: 'tph-chip', type: 'button',
            onclick: () => {
              chat.members.push(n);
              if (chat.members.length >= 2) chat.type = 'group';
              if (!chat.nameManual) chat.name = wxAutoName(chat.members);
              saveChats();
              syncHead();
              fill();
            },
          }, ['＋ ' + n]));
        });
        card.appendChild(quick);
      }

      const inp = h('input', { class: 'tph-input', placeholder: '输入角色名，回车拉进对话' });
      inp.addEventListener('keydown', (ev) => {
        if (ev.key !== 'Enter') return;
        ev.preventDefault();
        const v = String(inp.value || '').trim();
        if (!v) return;
        if (chat.members.indexOf(v) >= 0) { notify('已经在对话里了', 'warning'); return; }
        chat.members.push(v);
        if (chat.members.length >= 2) chat.type = 'group';
        if (!chat.nameManual) chat.name = wxAutoName(chat.members);
        saveChats();
        syncHead();
        fill();
      });
      card.appendChild(inp);

      const acts = h('div', { class: 'tph-actions' });
      acts.appendChild(h('button', {
        class: 'tph-btn sm', type: 'button', title: '把整段对话追加到最新楼层，让后续剧情能引用',
        onclick: () => wxInjectToChat(chat),
      }, ['注入剧情']));
      acts.appendChild(h('button', {
        class: 'tph-btn sm', type: 'button',
        onclick: () => {
          const nm = askText('会话名？', chat.name);
          if (nm === null) return;
          chat.name = String(nm).trim() || chat.name;
          chat.nameManual = true;
          saveChats();
          syncHead();
          fill();
        },
      }, ['改名']));
      if (chat.msgs.length) {
        acts.appendChild(h('button', {
          class: 'tph-btn ghost sm', type: 'button',
          onclick: () => {
            if (!HW.confirm('清空「' + chat.name + '」的全部消息？')) return;
            chat.msgs = [];
            saveChats();
            fill();
          },
        }, ['清空消息']));
      }
      acts.appendChild(h('button', {
        class: 'tph-btn danger sm', type: 'button',
        onclick: () => {
          if (!HW.confirm('删除会话「' + chat.name + '」？消息记录一并清除，不可恢复。')) return;
          wxDeleteChat(chat.id);
          session.wxActiveId = null;
          session.wxOps = false;
          renderScreen();
        },
      }, ['删除会话']));
      card.appendChild(acts);
    };
    fill();

    el.appendChild(card);
  }

  // ========================= 发送与 AI 回复 =========================

  async function wxSend(chat) {
    if (session.wxPhase === 'sending') return;
    const draft = String(session.wxDraft || '').trim();
    if (!draft) { notify('先输入要发的内容', 'warning'); return; }
    // 语音回复指令：以 /voice 或 /语音 开头 → 角色这轮用语音条回复
    const voiceCmd = draft.match(/^\/(voice|语音)\b/);
    const wantVoice = !!voiceCmd;
    const aiText = wantVoice
      ? (String(draft.replace(/^\/(voice|语音)\s*/, '').trim()) || '（对方请求用语音回复）')
      : draft;
    session.wxDraft = '';
    // 手动清空输入栏（不重绘，保留焦点），并把发送键切回「+」
    if (session._wxTaEl) { session._wxTaEl.value = ''; try { session._wxTaEl.focus(); } catch (_e) { /* 忽略 */ } }
    if (session._wxSyncBar) session._wxSyncBar();
    wxPushMsg(chat, 'me', draft, 'text');
    session.wxPhase = 'sending';
    // 局部更新发送按钮状态
    if (session._wxSendBtn) { session._wxSendBtn.classList.add('busy'); session._wxSendBtn.textContent = '…'; }
    // 局部刷新消息区（保留输入栏焦点）
    if (session._wxRefreshMsgs) session._wxRefreshMsgs();
    else renderScreen();
    try {
      const replies = await wxGenReplies(chat, aiText, { voiceMode: wantVoice });
      if (!replies.length) notify('角色没有回复（AI 未返回内容或格式不对）', 'warning');
      else {
        replies.forEach((r) => wxPushMsg(chat, r.from, r.text, wantVoice ? 'voice' : 'text'));
        if (config.memory.enabled && config.memory.phoneSync) wxSyncMemory(chat);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      notify('发送失败：' + errText(e), 'warning');
    } finally {
      session.wxPhase = 'idle';
      // 局部更新发送按钮状态
      if (session._wxSendBtn) { session._wxSendBtn.classList.remove('busy'); session._wxSendBtn.textContent = '发送'; }
      // 局部刷新消息区（保留输入栏焦点）
      if (session._wxRefreshMsgs) session._wxRefreshMsgs();
      else rerender();
    }
  }

  /** 语音消息发送后让 AI 回复（复用 wxGenReplies，不做草稿清理——语音模式已清过） */
  async function wxSendVoiceReply(chat, text) {
    if (session.wxPhase === 'sending') return;
    session.wxPhase = 'sending';
    if (session._wxSendBtn) { session._wxSendBtn.classList.add('busy'); session._wxSendBtn.textContent = '…'; }
    try {
      const replies = await wxGenReplies(chat, text);
      if (!replies.length) notify('角色没有回复（AI 未返回内容或格式不对）', 'warning');
      else {
        replies.forEach((r) => wxPushMsg(chat, r.from, r.text, 'text'));
        if (config.memory.enabled && config.memory.phoneSync) wxSyncMemory(chat);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      notify('发送失败：' + errText(e), 'warning');
    } finally {
      session.wxPhase = 'idle';
      if (session._wxSendBtn) { session._wxSendBtn.classList.remove('busy'); session._wxSendBtn.textContent = '发送'; }
      if (session._wxRefreshMsgs) session._wxRefreshMsgs();
      else rerender();
    }
  }

  /** 让 AI 扮演角色回复：私聊单角色 / 群聊多角色（@点名者必须发言） */
  async function wxGenReplies(chat, userText, opts) {
    const o = opts || {};
    const voiceHint = o.voiceMode ? '（对方请求用语音回复：这轮回复像发语音一样，更口语、更短，1-2句）' : '';
    const transcript = await readTranscript((config.extract && config.extract.floorRange) || 20);
    const ctx = (transcript && transcript.trim()) ? transcript.slice(0, 2200) : '（暂无剧情背景）';
    const hist = chat.msgs
      .filter((m) => m.kind !== 'system')
      .slice(-24)
      .map((m) => (m.from === 'me' ? '我' : m.from) + '：' + wxPreview(m))
      .join('\n');

    if (chat.type === 'group') {
      const profs = chat.members.map((m) => profileByName(m)).filter(Boolean);
      const profileCtx = profs.length ? buildProfileContext(profs) : '';
      const fullCtx = ctx + (profileCtx ? '\n\n' + profileCtx : '');
      const at = chat.members.filter((m) => userText.indexOf('@' + m) >= 0);
      const prompt = fillVars(promptText('groupReply'), {
        name: chat.name,
        members: chat.members.join('、'),
        context: fullCtx + voiceHint,
        history: hist,
        input: userText,
        atHint: at.length ? '- 「' + at.join('、') + '」这轮被点名了，必须在回复里出现' : '',
      });
      const resp = await llm(prompt, '微信群回复');
      if (!resp) return [];
      const json = extractJSON(resp) || {};
      if (!Array.isArray(json.msgs)) return [];
      return json.msgs.map((m) => ({
        from: wxMatchMember(m && m.from, chat.members),
        text: String((m && m.text) || '').trim(),
      })).filter((m) => m.text).slice(0, 5);
    }

    const who = chat.members[0] || chat.name || '角色';
    const prof = profileByName(who);
    const profileCtx = prof ? buildProfileContext(prof) : '';
    const fullCtx = ctx + (profileCtx ? '\n\n' + profileCtx : '') + voiceHint;
    const prompt = fillVars(promptText('dmReply'), {
      who: who,
      me: userNameNow() || '我',
      context: fullCtx,
      history: hist,
      input: userText,
    });
    const resp = await llm(prompt, '微信回复');
    if (!resp) return [];
    const json = extractJSON(resp) || {};
    const text = String(json.reply || json.text || '').trim();
    return text ? [{ from: who, text: text }] : [];
  }

  /** 发红包 / 转账：用户发出后让 AI 反应一句 */
  async function wxSendPay(chat, kind) {
    const isRp = kind === 'redpacket';
    const amt = askText(isRp ? '红包金额（元）' : '转账金额（元）', '');
    if (amt === null || !String(amt).trim()) return;
    const note = askText('留言（可留空）', isRp ? '恭喜发财' : '') || '';
    wxPushMsg(chat, 'me', '', kind, { amount: String(amt).trim(), note: String(note).trim(), opened: false });
    renderScreen();

    if (session.wxPhase === 'sending') return;
    session.wxPhase = 'sending';
    renderScreen();
    try {
      const fake = '（我发了一个' + (isRp ? '红包' : '转账') + '：¥' + String(amt).trim() + (note ? '，留言「' + note + '」' : '') + '）';
      const replies = await wxGenReplies(chat, fake);
      if (replies.length) {
        replies.forEach((r) => wxPushMsg(chat, r.from, r.text, 'text'));
        if (config.memory.enabled && config.memory.phoneSync) wxSyncMemory(chat);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setDiag('红包反应失败：' + errText(e));
    } finally {
      session.wxPhase = 'idle';
      rerender();
    }
  }

  /** 会话内容 → 记忆：每个会话固定一条，每次更新为最近几轮，避免记忆列表堆爆 */
  function wxSyncMemory(chat) {
    const title = '手机 · ' + chat.name;
    const tail = chat.msgs.filter((m) => m.kind !== 'system').slice(-8)
      .map((m) => (m.from === 'me' ? '我' : m.from) + '：' + wxPreview(m)).join('\n');
    if (!tail) return;
    const floor = API.lastMessageId() || 0;
    addMemory('relationship', title, '最近对话：\n' + tail.slice(0, 400), floor, 'phone');
  }

  /** 把整段对话追加到最新楼层（写进聊天记录，后续剧情可引用） */
  async function wxInjectToChat(chat) {
    const real = chat.msgs.filter((m) => m.kind !== 'system');
    if (!real.length) { notify('还没有可注入的对话内容', 'warning'); return; }
    const lines = real.map((m) => (m.from === 'me' ? '我' : m.from) + '：' + wxPreview(m));
    const text = '【手机' + (chat.type === 'group' ? '群聊' : '消息') + ' · ' + chat.name + '】\n' + lines.join('\n');
    try {
      const err = await appendToLatestMessage(text);
      if (err) notify('注入失败：' + err, 'warning');
      else notify('已把这段对话追加到最新楼层，后续剧情可引用', 'success');
    } catch (e) {
      notify('注入失败：' + errText(e), 'warning');
    }
  }

  /** 候选角色名：AI 提取的剧情角色 + 已有会话成员 + 立绘映射里配过的 */
  function wxCandidates() {
    const names = [];
    const push = (n) => {
      const s = String(n || '').trim();
      if (s && s !== 'me' && s !== 'system' && names.indexOf(s) < 0) names.push(s);
    };
    // 已注入档案的角色（enabled !== false）优先出现在联系人里（主角档案不算候选）
    (session.profiles || []).forEach((p) => { if (p.enabled !== false && !p.isMain && p.name) push(p.name); });
    // AI 从剧情中提取出的角色（trackedChars）
    ((session.chars || {}).tracked || []).forEach(push);
    Object.keys(session.portrait || {}).forEach(push);
    (session.chats || []).forEach((c) => (c.members || []).forEach(push));
    (session.moments || []).forEach((m) => { push(m.author); (m.likes || []).forEach(push); (m.comments || []).forEach((c) => push(c.from)); });
    // 通话对象：群呼记录用 members 名单；老记录/合并串按「 + 」拆开，避免"高木 + 早苗"混进候选
    (session.calls || []).forEach((c) => {
      if (Array.isArray(c.members) && c.members.length) c.members.forEach(push);
      else String(c.peer || '').split(/\s\+\s/).forEach(push);
    });
    return names;
  }

  /** 清洗角色名：剥危险字符，限长，排除当前用户名、保留词与无意义路人（词表见 07b 的 JUNK_NAME_RE） */
  function sanitizeCharName(name) {
    const s = String(name || '').trim()
      .replace(/[<>&"'`]/g, '')
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .slice(0, 30);
    if (!s) return '';
    const u = userNameNow();
    if (u && s === u) return '';
    if (['me', 'system', '你', '我', '用户', '旁白', '系统'].indexOf(s) >= 0) return '';
    // 无意义的路人/背景角色（统一词表，07b-data-assets 定义、比本文件先加载）
    if (typeof JUNK_NAME_RE !== 'undefined' && JUNK_NAME_RE.test(s)) return '';
    return s;
  }

  /** 从最近剧情中 AI 提取角色名单，合并进 trackedChars（已有名单不丢失） */
  async function extractCharacters(silent) {
    const depth = (config.extract && config.extract.floorRange) || 12;
    const transcript = await readTranscript(depth);
    if (!transcript || !transcript.trim()) {
      if (!silent) notify('没有可分析的聊天记录', 'warning');
      return null;
    }
    const tmpl = promptText('charExtract');
    const prompt = tmpl
      .replace('{{transcript}}', transcript.slice(0, 8000))
      .replace('{{me}}', userNameNow() || '用户');
    const resp = await llm(prompt, '角色提取');
    if (!resp) {
      if (!silent) notify('角色提取失败：AI 没有返回内容', 'warning');
      return null;
    }
    let parsed = extractJSON(resp);
    // 剥 ```json 围栏重试
    if (!parsed) {
      const stripped = resp.replace(/```json\s*/gi, '').replace(/```\s*/g, '').trim();
      parsed = extractJSON(stripped);
    }
    if (!parsed || !Array.isArray(parsed.characters)) {
      if (!silent) notify('角色提取失败：AI 返回格式不正确', 'warning');
      return null;
    }
    const names = parsed.characters
      .map(sanitizeCharName)
      .filter(Boolean);
    if (!names.length) {
      if (!silent) notify('没有识别到新角色', 'info');
      return { tracked: ((session.chars || {}).tracked || []), added: [] };
    }
    const before = ((session.chars || {}).tracked || []).slice();
    mergeChars(names);
    const added = ((session.chars || {}).tracked || []).filter((n) => before.indexOf(n) < 0);
    if (!silent) {
      const msg = added.length
        ? '识别到 ' + names.length + ' 个角色，新增 ' + added.length + ' 个：' + added.join('、')
        : '识别到 ' + names.length + ' 个角色（均已在名单中）';
      notify(msg, 'success');
    }
    // 未建档角色在「档案」App 的常驻待入档面板里随时可加，不再依赖一次性弹板
    return { tracked: (session.chars || {}).tracked || [], added: added };
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // 13b. 微信渲染入口与辅助页：renderWeChat / 通讯录 / 发现（摇一摇·扫一扫）/ 我
  // 及会话列表组件（未读角标 / 列表项 / 预览 / 长按气泡菜单 / @ 弹层 / 红包转账气泡）
  // ===========================================================================

  function renderWeChat(el) {
    // 聊天页是二级页，优先渲染（它不带底部导航，靠顶栏返回）
    if (session.wxActiveId) {
      const chat = activeChat();
      if (chat) { wxBuildChat(el, chat); return; }
      session.wxActiveId = null;
    }
    let tab = session.wxTab || 'chat';
    if (WX_TABS.indexOf(tab) < 0) { tab = 'chat'; session.wxTab = 'chat'; }

    if (tab === 'contacts') { wxBuildContacts(el); return; }
    if (tab === 'discover') {
      // 朋友圈现在是「发现」页里的一项，不再是底部 Tab
      if (session.wxSub === 'moments') { renderMoments(el); return; }
      if (session.wxSub === 'shake') { renderShake(el); return; }
      if (session.wxSub === 'scan') { renderScan(el); return; }
      wxBuildDiscover(el);
      return;
    }
    if (tab === 'me') { wxBuildMe(el); return; }
    wxBuildList(el);
  }

  /** 所有会话的未读总数（底部导航「微信」角标用，0 时不传角标） */
  function wxUnreadTotal() {
    return (session.chats || []).reduce((n, c) => n + (Number(c.unread) || 0), 0);
  }

  /** 打开与某角色的私聊（没有就新建）—— 贴吧 / 小红书 / X 里点 @某人 会跳到这里 */
  function openChatWith(name) {
    const nm = String(name || '').trim();
    if (!nm) return;
    let chat = (session.chats || []).find((c) => c.type !== 'group' && (c.members || []).indexOf(nm) >= 0);
    if (!chat) chat = wxCreateChat([nm]);
    if (!chat) { notify('打不开会话', 'warning'); return; }
    session.wxActiveId = chat.id;
    session.wxTab = 'chat';
    session.wxSub = null;
    session.wxDraft = '';
    gotoApp('wechat');
  }

  // ========================= 通讯录 =========================

  function wxBuildContacts(el) {
    const shell = uiShell(Object.assign(wxTabOpts('contacts'), {
      title: '通讯录',
      nav: {
        search: '搜索联系人',
        query: session.wxQuery,
        onSearch: (v) => { session.wxQuery = v; renderScreen(); },
      },
    }));

    // 「识别新角色」按钮：AI 从最近剧情中提取角色名
    if (!session.wxQuery) {
      const btn = h('button', {
        class: 'tph-btn ghost sm' + (session.charBusy ? ' disabled' : ''),
        type: 'button',
        style: 'width:100%;margin-bottom:8px',
        onclick: async () => {
          if (session.charBusy) return;
          session.charBusy = true;
          renderScreen();
          try { await extractCharacters(); }
          catch (e) { notify('角色提取异常：' + errText(e), 'warning'); }
          finally { session.charBusy = false; renderScreen(); }
        },
      }, [session.charBusy ? '识别中…' : '✦ 从剧情识别新角色']);
      shell.body.appendChild(btn);
    }

    // 通讯录顶部功能行
    if (!session.wxQuery) {
      const tracked = ((session.chars || {}).tracked || []);
      const inChat = (n) => (session.chats || []).some((c) => c.type !== 'group' && (c.members || []).indexOf(n) >= 0);
      const newOnes = tracked.filter((n) => !inChat(n));
      const fnBox = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-list' });
      fnBox.appendChild(wxFnRow('👤', '#FA9D3B', '新的朋友', newOnes.length ? newOnes.length + ' 个待联系' : null,
        () => { notify(newOnes.length ? '下方「剧情角色」分组里有 ' + newOnes.length + ' 个待联系角色' : '暂无新角色', 'info'); }));
      fnBox.appendChild(wxFnRow('👥', '#07C160', '群聊', (session.chats || []).filter(c => c.type === 'group').length + ' 个', () => { session.wxTab = 'chat'; renderScreen(); }));
      fnBox.appendChild(wxFnRow('🏷️', '#3E7BFA', '标签', tracked.length ? tracked.length + ' 个角色' : null, () => {
        session.wxTagFilter = !session.wxTagFilter;
        renderScreen();
      }));
      shell.body.appendChild(fnBox);

      // 标签筛选展开：点「标签」后展开角色 chips，点击过滤联系人
      if (session.wxTagFilter) {
        const tracked = ((session.chars || {}).tracked || []);
        if (tracked.length) {
          const chipBox = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-chips', style: 'padding:6px 12px 8px' });
          tracked.slice(0, 12).forEach((n) => {
            const on = session.wxTagSel === n;
            chipBox.appendChild(h('button', {
              class: 'tph-chip' + (on ? ' on' : ''), type: 'button',
              onclick: () => { session.wxTagSel = on ? null : n; session.wxQuery = on ? '' : n; renderScreen(); },
            }, [n]));
          });
          shell.body.appendChild(chipBox);
        }
      }
    }

    const groups = (session.chats || []).filter((c) => c.type === 'group');
    if (groups.length && !session.wxQuery) {
      shell.body.appendChild(uiGroup('群聊', groups.length + ' 个'));
      groups.forEach((g) => shell.body.appendChild(uiRow(
        'group', g.name,
        g.members.length + ' 人 · ' + (g.msgs || []).length + ' 条消息',
        () => { session.wxActiveId = g.id; renderScreen(); }
      )));
    }

    let cands = wxCandidates();
    if (session.wxQuery) cands = cands.filter((n) => uiHit(session.wxQuery, n));

    // 「剧情角色」分组：trackedChars 里还没建私聊会话的角色
    if (!session.wxQuery) {
      const tracked = ((session.chars || {}).tracked || []);
      const inChat = (n) => (session.chats || []).some((c) => c.type !== 'group' && (c.members || []).indexOf(n) >= 0);

  function renderShake(el) {
    const shell = uiShell({
      app: 'wechat',
      onHome: () => gotoApp('home'),
      back: {
        text: '发现',
        onClick: () => { stopShakeMotion(); session.wxSub = null; renderScreen(); },
      },
      title: '摇一摇',
      tabs: null,
    });

    const wrap = h('div', { class: 'tph-shake-wrap' });

    // 大圆按钮：摇动手机或点一下都能触发
    const iconBtn = h('button', {
      class: 'tph-shake-icon', type: 'button', title: '摇一摇',
    });
    iconBtn.appendChild(iconSvg('bell', 28));

    const hint = h('div', { class: 'tph-shake-hint', text: '摇动手机或点击按钮，发现随机事件' });

    // 结果容器：摇到事件后在这里显示文字
    const result = h('div', { class: 'tph-shake-result' });
    if (session.shakeResult) {
      result.appendChild(h('span', { text: session.shakeResult }));
    }

    // 真正触发摇一摇：加动画 class → 调 AI → 显示结果
    const triggerShake = async () => {
      if (session._shakeBusy) return;
      session._shakeBusy = true;
      iconBtn.classList.add('shaking');
      setBusy('shake', true);
      try {
        const ctx = await storyContext((config.extract && config.extract.floorRange) || 20);
        const prompt = fillVars(promptText('shakeEvent'), { context: ctx });
        const resp = await llm(prompt, '摇一摇');
        if (!resp) { notify('摇一摇失败：AI 没有返回内容', 'warning'); return; }
        const json = extractJSON(resp) || {};
        const ev = String(json.event || '').trim();
        if (!ev) { notify('摇一摇失败：AI 返回格式不正确', 'warning'); return; }
        session.shakeResult = ev;
        clearChildren(result);
        result.appendChild(h('span', { text: ev }));
      } catch (e) {
        softFail('摇一摇', e);
        notify('摇一摇失败：' + errText(e), 'warning');
      } finally {
        iconBtn.classList.remove('shaking');
        setBusy('shake', false);
        session._shakeBusy = false;
      }
    };

    iconBtn.addEventListener('click', triggerShake);

    wrap.appendChild(iconBtn);
    wrap.appendChild(hint);
    wrap.appendChild(result);
    shell.body.appendChild(wrap);
    el.appendChild(shell.root);

    // 移动端 devicemotion：加速度 > 15 触发（用 session 标记防重复 + 离开页面时移除）
    startShakeMotion(triggerShake);
  }

  /** 注册 devicemotion 监听；重复进入时先清掉旧的，离开页面调 stopShakeMotion */
  function startShakeMotion(trigger) {
    stopShakeMotion();
    if (!HW || typeof HW.addEventListener !== 'function') return;
    if (typeof HW.DeviceMotionEvent === 'undefined' && typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.DeviceMotionEvent === 'undefined') return;
    let lastFire = 0;
    const handler = (ev) => {
      const acc = ev && (ev.acceleration || (ev.accelerationIncludingGravity && { x: ev.accelerationIncludingGravity.x, y: ev.accelerationIncludingGravity.y, z: ev.accelerationIncludingGravity.z }));
      if (!acc) return;
      const mag = Math.sqrt((acc.x || 0) * (acc.x || 0) + (acc.y || 0) * (acc.y || 0) + (acc.z || 0) * (acc.z || 0));
      if (mag > 15 && Date.now() - lastFire > 1500) {
        lastFire = Date.now();
        try { trigger(); } catch (_e) { /* 触发失败不影响监听 */ }
      }
    };
    try {
      // iOS 13+ 需要显式请求权限
      const DM = (typeof HW.DeviceMotionEvent !== 'undefined') ? HW.DeviceMotionEvent : (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.DeviceMotionEvent : undefined);
      if (DM && typeof DM.requestPermission === 'function') {
        DM.requestPermission().then((res) => {
          if (res === 'granted') {
            HW.addEventListener('devicemotion', handler);
            session._shakeHandler = handler;
          }
        }).catch(() => { /* 权限拒绝就静默 */ });
      } else {
        HW.addEventListener('devicemotion', handler);
        session._shakeHandler = handler;
      }
    } catch (_e) { /* 监听失败不影响点击 */ }
  }

  function stopShakeMotion() {
    const h2 = session._shakeHandler;
    if (h2 && HW && typeof HW.removeEventListener === 'function') {
      try { HW.removeEventListener('devicemotion', h2); } catch (_e) { /* 忽略 */ }
    }
    session._shakeHandler = null;
  }

        notify('扫描失败：' + errText(e), 'warning');
      } finally {
        setBusy('scan', false);
        session._scanBusy = false;
      }
    };

    renderContent();
    el.appendChild(shell.root);

  /** 会话列表里的最后一条预览文本（富媒体单独特判） */
  function wxPreview(m) {
    if (!m) return '';
    if (m.kind === 'redpacket') return '[红包] ' + (m.meta && m.meta.note || '');
    if (m.kind === 'transfer') return '[转账] ' + ((m.meta && m.meta.amount) || '');
    if (m.kind === 'voice') return '[语音]';
    if (m.kind === 'image') return '[图片]';
    return String(m.text || '').replace(/\n/g, ' ').slice(0, 40);
  }

  /** 长按文本气泡 → 弹出黑色菜单（复制 / 引用 / 删除） */
  function wxAttachLongPress(bubble, m, chat) {
    let timer = 0;
    let sx = 0, sy = 0;
    const cancel = () => { if (timer) { clearTimeout(timer); timer = 0; } };
    bubble.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
      if (e.button !== undefined && e.button !== 0) return;
      sx = e.clientX; sy = e.clientY;
      timer = setTimeout(() => {
        timer = 0;
        wxShowBubbleMenu(m, chat, e.clientX, e.clientY);
      }, 500);
    });
    bubble.addEventListener('pointerup', cancel);
    bubble.addEventListener('pointerleave', cancel);
    bubble.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
      if (!timer) return;
      if (Math.abs(e.clientX - sx) > 10 || Math.abs(e.clientY - sy) > 10) cancel();
    });
    bubble.addEventListener('pointercancel', cancel);
  }

  /** 构建并弹出气泡菜单（挂到 document.body，fixed 定位） */
  function wxShowBubbleMenu(m, chat, x, y) {
    wxCloseBubbleMenu();
    const menu = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-popmenu' });
    menu.style.position = 'fixed';
    menu.style.zIndex = '20';

    // 复制
    const copyBtn = h('button', { class: 'tph-wx-popmenu-btn', type: 'button' }, ['复制']);
    copyBtn.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
      ev.stopPropagation();
      const txt = String(m.text || '');
      const nav = HW.navigator;
      if (nav && nav.clipboard && nav.clipboard.writeText) {
        try { nav.clipboard.writeText(txt); notify('已复制', 'success'); }
        catch (_e) { notify('内容：' + txt.slice(0, 40)); }
      } else {
        notify('内容：' + txt.slice(0, 40));
      }
      wxCloseBubbleMenu();
    });
    menu.appendChild(copyBtn);

    // 引用：把「发送者：片段」回填到输入框
    const quoteBtn = h('button', { class: 'tph-wx-popmenu-btn', type: 'button' }, ['引用']);
    quoteBtn.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
      ev.stopPropagation();
      const snippet = String(m.text || '').slice(0, 40);
      const quote = '「' + m.from + '：' + snippet + '」\n';
      session.wxDraft = quote + (session.wxDraft || '');
      if (session._wxTaEl) {
        session._wxTaEl.value = session.wxDraft;
        try { session._wxTaEl.focus(); } catch (_e) { /* 忽略 */ }
      }
      if (session._wxSyncBar) session._wxSyncBar();
      wxCloseBubbleMenu();
    });
    menu.appendChild(quoteBtn);

    // 删除（仅自己发的消息）
    if (m.from === 'me') {
      menu.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-popmenu-sep' }));
      const delBtn = h('button', { class: 'tph-wx-popmenu-btn', type: 'button' }, ['删除']);
      delBtn.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
        ev.stopPropagation();
        chat.msgs = chat.msgs.filter((x) => x !== m);
        saveChats();
        if (session._wxRefreshMsgs) session._wxRefreshMsgs();
        wxCloseBubbleMenu();
      });
      menu.appendChild(delBtn);
    }

    // 挂到 body 再测尺寸定位，避免溢出屏幕
    HD.body.appendChild(menu);
    const rect = menu.getBoundingClientRect();
    const vw = HW.innerWidth || HD.documentElement.clientWidth || rect.width;
    let left = x, top = y - rect.height - 6;
    if (left + rect.width > vw - 6) left = vw - rect.width - 6;
    if (left < 6) left = 6;
    if (top < 6) top = y + 12;   // 上方放不下就放到下方
    menu.style.left = left + 'px';
    menu.style.top = top + 'px';

    session._wxPopMenu = menu;
    // 点击菜单外区域关闭（一次性捕获）
    setTimeout(() => {
      HD.addEventListener('click', wxCloseBubbleMenu, { capture: true, once: true });
    }, 0);
  }

  function wxCloseBubbleMenu() {
    if (session._wxPopMenu) {
      try { if (session._wxPopMenu.parentNode) session._wxPopMenu.parentNode.removeChild(session._wxPopMenu); }
      catch (_e) { /* 忽略 */ }
      session._wxPopMenu = null;
    }
    try { HD.removeEventListener('click', wxCloseBubbleMenu, { capture: true }); }
    catch (_e) { /* 忽略 */ }
  }

  /** @mention 检测：从光标往前找最近一个 @，命中则弹出候选浮层 */
  function wxDetectAt(ta, chat, bar) {
    const val = ta.value || '';
    const pos = ta.selectionStart;
    if (pos == null) { wxCloseAtPop(); return; }
    // 从光标往前找最近的 @
    const before = val.slice(0, pos);
    const atIdx = before.lastIndexOf('@');
    if (atIdx < 0) { wxCloseAtPop(); return; }
    // @ 到光标之间的文本
    const frag = before.slice(atIdx + 1);
    // 含空格/换行 → 不算 @ 名字；长度超 15 → 关闭
    if (/[\s\n]/.test(frag) || frag.length > 15) { wxCloseAtPop(); return; }
    // @ 之前必须是行首或空白（避免邮箱 a@b）
    const prev = before.charAt(atIdx - 1);
    if (atIdx > 0 && !/[\s\n]/.test(prev)) { wxCloseAtPop(); return; }

    // 候选名单
    let cands;
    if (chat.type === 'group') {
      cands = (chat.members || []).filter((n) => String(n).indexOf(frag) >= 0);
    } else {
      cands = (wxCandidates() || []).filter((n) => String(n).indexOf(frag) >= 0).slice(0, 6);
    }
    if (!cands.length) { wxCloseAtPop(); return; }
    wxShowAtPop(ta, bar, cands, atIdx, frag);
  }

  /** 弹出 @ 候选浮层（挂在 bar 上，absolute 定位于 textarea 上方） */
  function wxShowAtPop(ta, bar, cands, atIdx, frag) {
    wxCloseAtPop();
    const pop = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-atpop' });
    pop.style.position = 'absolute';
    pop.style.bottom = '100%';
    pop.style.left = '12px';
    pop.style.marginBottom = '2px';
    pop.style.zIndex = '10';
    pop.style.maxHeight = '180px';
    pop.style.overflowY = 'auto';

    cands.forEach((name) => {
      const item = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-atpop-item' });
      item.appendChild(avaNode(name, 20, false));
      item.appendChild(h('span', { text: name }));
      item.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
        ev.stopPropagation();
        const val = ta.value || '';
        // 把 @半截 替换成 @完整名 （尾部带空格）
        const after = val.slice(ta.selectionStart);
        const head = val.slice(0, atIdx);
        ta.value = head + '@' + name + ' ' + after;
        // 光标放到名字+空格之后
        const caret = (head + '@' + name + ' ').length;
        try { ta.focus(); ta.setSelectionRange(caret, caret); } catch (_e) { /* 忽略 */ }
        session.wxDraft = ta.value;
        if (session._wxSyncBar) session._wxSyncBar();
        wxCloseAtPop();
      });
      pop.appendChild(item);
    });

    bar.appendChild(pop);
    session._wxAtPop = pop;
    session._wxAtPopBar = bar;   // 记宿主，重绘时 bar 被丢弃，浮层随之消失
  }

  function wxCloseAtPop() {
    if (session._wxAtPop) {
      try { if (session._wxAtPop.parentNode) session._wxAtPop.parentNode.removeChild(session._wxAtPop); }
      catch (_e) { /* 忽略 */ }
      session._wxAtPop = null;
      session._wxAtPopBar = null;
    }
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // 13c. 语音识别（STT）双通道：浏览器 SpeechRecognition / API（Whisper 录音）
  // 供微信与电话输入栏共用（22 系列加载在 24 之前，同一作用域）
  // ===========================================================================

  // —— 语音识别（STT）：浏览器 SpeechRecognition 或 API（Whisper 兼容）——
  // 放这里供微信与电话输入栏共用（22 在 24 之前加载，同一作用域）

  let _recognition = null;

  // —— API 录音通道：MediaRecorder 录音 blob ——
  let _mediaRec = null;       // MediaRecorder 实例
  let _mediaStream = null;    //麦克风流
  let _mediaChunks = [];      // 录音数据块
  let _sttApiCb = null;       // 录完回调 { onResult, onEnd, settled }

  /** 启动录音（API 通道用） */
  async function startRec(onResult, onEnd) {
    try {
      const md = (HW.navigator && HW.navigator.mediaDevices) || navigator.mediaDevices || (navigator.mediaDevices ? navigator.mediaDevices : null);
      if (!md || !md.getUserMedia) { notify('浏览器不支持录音（MediaRecorder）', 'warning'); return false; }
      const stream = await md.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
      _mediaStream = stream;
      _mediaChunks = [];
      const MR = (HW.MediaRecorder) || (typeof MediaRecorder !== 'undefined' ? MediaRecorder : null);
      if (!MR) { notify('浏览器不支持 MediaRecorder', 'warning'); stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop()); return false; }
      const mr = new MR(stream);
      _mediaRec = mr;
      mr.ondataavailable = (e) => { if (e.data && e.data.size > 0) _mediaChunks.push(e.data); };
      mr.onstop = async () => {
        // 停止录音 → 拼 blob → 调 API → onEnd(text)
        if (_mediaStream) { _mediaStream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop()); _mediaStream = null; }
        const blob = new Blob(_mediaChunks, { type: 'audio/webm' });
        _mediaChunks = [];
        if (!blob.size) { if (onEnd) onEnd(''); return; }
        if (onResult) onResult('正在识别…', false);
        const r = await callSttApi(blob);
        if (_sttApiCb && _sttApiCb.settled) return;
        if (onEnd) onEnd(r.ok ? r.text : '');
        if (!r.ok && r.err) notify('语音识别失败：' + r.err, 'warning');
      };
      mr.start();
      if (onResult) onResult('正在录音…', false);
      _sttApiCb = { onResult: onResult, onEnd: onEnd, settled: false };
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      notify('录音启动失败：' + errText(e), 'warning');
      return false;
    }
  }

  /** 停止录音 → 触发 onstop → 调 API */
  function stopRec() {
    if (_mediaRec && _mediaRec.state !== 'inactive') {
      try { _mediaRec.stop(); } catch (_e) { /* 忽略 */ }
    }
    _mediaRec = null;
  }

  /**
   * 启动语音识别。按 config.stt.engine 分流：
   * - browser: 浏览器 SpeechRecognition（有 partial 实时预览）
   * - api: MediaRecorder 录音 → callSttApi（整段识别，无 partial）
   * @param onResult(partialText) 中间结果（未定稿）
   * @param onEnd(finalText)      识别结束，给出定稿文本
   * @param opts.continuous        true=一直录到主动 stopSTT()（通话大语音键用）
   */
  function startSTT(onResult, onEnd, opts) {
    const o = opts || {};
    const engine = (config.stt && config.stt.engine) || 'browser';
    if (engine === 'api') {
      // API 通道：录音 → 停止 → 调 API → onEnd
      startRec(onResult, onEnd);
      return true;
    }
    // 浏览器通道（原逻辑）
    try {
      const SR = HW.SpeechRecognition || HW.webkitSpeechRecognition || window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
      if (!SR) { notify('浏览器不支持语音识别', 'warning'); return false; }
      if (_recognition) { try { _recognition.stop(); } catch (_e) { /* 忽略 */ } }
      _recognition = new SR();
      _recognition.lang = (config.stt && config.stt.lang) || 'zh-CN';
      _recognition.continuous = o.continuous === true;
      _recognition.interimResults = true;
      let finalText = '';
      let settled = false;
      const finish = () => {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true;
        if (_recognition === rec) _recognition = null;
        if (onEnd) onEnd(finalText);
      };
      const rec = _recognition;
      rec.onresult = (e) => {
        for (let i = e.resultIndex; i < e.results.length; i++) {
          if (e.results[i].isFinal) finalText += e.results[i][0].transcript;
          else if (onResult) onResult(e.results[i][0].transcript, false);
        }
      };
      rec.onend = finish;
      rec.onerror = (ev) => {
        const code = String((ev && ev.error) || '');
        if (code && code !== 'no-speech' && code !== 'aborted') notify('语音识别失败（' + code + '）', 'warning');
        finish();
      };
      rec.start();
      return true;
    } catch (e) { notify('语音识别启动失败', 'warning'); return false; }
  }

  /** 停止语音识别（双通道都支持） */
  function stopSTT() {
    if (_recognition) { try { _recognition.stop(); } catch (_e) { /* 忽略 */ } }
    if (_mediaRec) { stopRec(); }
  }

  function sttBusy() { return !!(_recognition || _mediaRec); }

  /**
   * 剧情背景：读最近若干楼，剥掉占位符，截断成一段可直接塞进提示词的文本。
   * 微信 / 朋友圈 / 电话 / 助手共用，避免每处各写一遍。
   */
  async function storyContext(limit) {
    const n = clampNum(limit || (config.extract && config.extract.floorRange) || 20, 1, 200, 20);
    try {
      const t = await readTranscript(n);
      if (t && t.trim()) return t.slice(0, 2200);
    } catch (e) { softFail('读取剧情背景', e); }
    return '（暂无剧情背景）';
  }

  /** 朋友圈的相对时间：刚刚 / N分钟前 / 今天 N小时前 / 昨天 / N天前(≤7天) / MM-DD */
  function fmtRelTime(ts) {
    const n = Number(ts) || 0;
    if (!n) return '';
    const diff = Date.now() - n;
    if (diff < 60000) return '刚刚';
    if (diff < 3600000) return Math.floor(diff / 60000) + '分钟前';
    const d = new Date(n);
    const now = new Date();
    const sameDay = (a, b) => a.getFullYear() === b.getFullYear() && a.getMonth() === b.getMonth() && a.getDate() === b.getDate();
    if (sameDay(d, now)) return Math.floor(diff / 3600000) + '小时前';
    const y = new Date(now.getTime() - 86400000);
    if (sameDay(d, y)) return '昨天';
    if (diff <= 7 * 86400000) return Math.floor(diff / 86400000) + '天前';
    return pad2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad2(d.getDate());
  }

    // —— 双圆点菜单：黑色「赞 | 评论」气泡 ——
    let bubble = null;

      likeB.addEventListener('click', () => {

      const fire = () => {
