  async function assistantSend(shell) {
    if (session.asstPhase === 'sending') return;
    const text = String(session.asstDraft || '').trim();
    if (!text) { notify('先输入要问的内容', 'warning'); return; }
    session.asstDraft = '';
    session.asstHistory.push({ role: 'me', content: text, at: Date.now() });
    session.asstPhase = 'sending';
    // 局部刷新：显示「我」的气泡 + 助手正在输入
    if (shell && shell.updateBody) shell.updateBody((b) => asstBuildBody(b, shell));
    try {
      const ctx = await storyContext((config.extract && config.extract.floorRange) || 20);
      const memList = (session.memoryList || []).slice(-(config.memory.injectCount || 20));
      const memText = memList.length
        ? memList.map((it) => '◆ ' + (TYPE_LABEL[it.type] || it.type) + '：' + it.title + (it.content ? '——' + it.content : '')).join('\n')
        : '（暂无记忆）';
      const hist = session.asstHistory
        .slice(-12)
        .map((m) => (m.role === 'me' ? '用户：' : '助手：') + m.content)
        .join('\n');
      const prompt = fillVars(promptText('assistantChat'), {
        context: ctx,
        memory: memText,
        history: hist,
        input: text,
      });
      const resp = await llm(prompt, '助手');
      if (!resp) {
        session.asstHistory.push({ role: 'ai', content: '（没有拿到回复：' + (session.lastLlmErr || 'AI 未返回内容') + '）', at: Date.now() });
      } else {
        session.asstHistory.push({ role: 'ai', content: cleanScriptText(resp).slice(0, 4000), at: Date.now() });
      }
      if (session.asstHistory.length > 60) session.asstHistory.splice(0, session.asstHistory.length - 60);
    } catch (e) {
      softFail('助手对话', e);
      session.asstHistory.push({ role: 'ai', content: '（出错：' + errText(e) + '）', at: Date.now() });
    } finally {
      session.asstPhase = 'idle';
      // 局部刷新对话区（保留输入栏焦点，不调 renderScreen）
      if (shell && shell.updateBody) shell.updateBody((b) => asstBuildBody(b, shell));
      else rerender();
    }
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // 15. 贴吧（论坛风格：帖子流 / 进吧 / 消息 / 我的 / 楼中楼 / AI 发帖）
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 定位：角色世界里的大事件吐槽广场 —— 剧情里发生了什么事，角色可以在贴吧发帖讨论。
  // 形态对齐真实贴吧：蓝顶栏 + 搜索框 + 分类标签 + 帖子卡片（吧名 / 楼主 / 回复赞 / 配图）
  //                  + 底部导航（首页 / 进吧 / 消息 / 我的）+ 帖子详情与楼中楼。
  // ===========================================================================

  /** 首页的分类标签 */
  const TB_SORTS = [
    { id: 'hot', name: '推荐' },
    { id: 'new', name: '最新' },
    { id: 'reply', name: '热帖' },
  ];

  function ensureTbState() {
    if (!session.tbTab) session.tbTab = 'home';
    if (!session.tbSort) session.tbSort = 'hot';
    if (session.tbQuery == null) session.tbQuery = '';
    if (!session.tbPage) session.tbPage = 1;
  }

  function renderTieba(el) {
    ensureTbState();
    if (session.tbDetailView) {
      const fresh = (session.tiebaPosts || []).find((x) => x.id === session.tbDetailView.id);
      if (!fresh) { session.tbDetailView = null; session.tbTab = 'home'; }
      else { session.tbDetailView = fresh; renderTbDetail(el, fresh); return; }
    }
    if (session.tbTab === 'bars') renderTbBars(el);
    else if (session.tbTab === 'msg') renderTbMsg(el);
    else if (session.tbTab === 'me') renderTbMe(el);
    else renderTbHome(el);
  }

  /** 吧名统一带「吧」后缀，但用户自己写了就不再补（免得出现「搬家吧吧」） */
  function tbBarLabel(name) {
    const n = String(name || '综合').trim() || '综合';
    return /吧$/.test(n) ? n : n + '吧';
  }

  /** 底部导航（四个页面共用） */
  /** 未读消息数：进入消息页后红点消失（时间戳水位，新回复 ts 晚于水位才计入） */
  function tbUnreadCount() {
    const read = Number(session.tbInboxReadTs) || 0;
    return tbInbox().filter((it) => (Number(it.reply.ts) || 0) > read).length;
  }

  function tbTabOpts(el, tab) {
    return {
      app: 'tieba',
      tab: tab,
      onTab: (id) => {
        session.tbTab = id; session.tbPage = 1; session.tbBar = ''; session.tbDetailView = null;
        // 进消息页即已读：红点消失
        if (id === 'msg') { session.tbInboxReadTs = Date.now(); saveReadTs(); }
        renderScreen();
      },
      onHome: () => gotoApp('home'),
      badges: { msg: tbUnreadCount() },
    };
  }

  // ========================= 首页 =========================

  function renderTbHome(el) {
    const opts = tbTabOpts(el, 'home');
    const shell = uiShell(Object.assign(opts, {
      nav: {
        search: '搜索贴吧内容',
        query: session.tbQuery,
        onSearch: (v) => { session.tbQuery = v; session.tbPage = 1; renderScreen(); },
        actions: [{
          icon: session.tbCompose ? 'close' : 'plus',
          title: session.tbCompose ? '收起' : '发帖',
          onClick: () => {
            session.tbCompose = !session.tbCompose;
            if (!session.tbCompose) { session.tbDraft = ''; session.tbWho = ''; session.tbBarName = ''; }
            renderScreen();
          },
        }],
      },
      subTabs: {
        items: TB_SORTS, active: session.tbSort,
        onPick: (id) => { session.tbSort = id; session.tbPage = 1; renderScreen(); },
      },
    }));

    if (session.tbCompose) shell.body.appendChild(tbBuildCompose());
    if (session.tbBar) shell.body.appendChild(tbBarChip());

    const all = tbFiltered();
    if (!all.length) {
      shell.body.appendChild(uiBlank({
        icon: 'comment',
        title: session.tbQuery ? '没有搜到相关帖子' : (session.tbBar ? '这个吧还没有帖子' : '还没有帖子'),
        text: session.tbQuery ? '换个关键词试试。' : '帖吧还空着，来发第一帖。',
        actions: [{ text: session.tbBar ? '看全部' : '发帖', primary: true, onClick: () => {
          if (session.tbBar) { session.tbBar = ''; session.tbPage = 1; }
          else { session.tbCompose = true; session.tbBarName = session.tbBar; }
          renderScreen();
        } }],
      }));
    } else {
      uiSlice(all, session.tbPage).forEach((p) => shell.body.appendChild(tbBuildRow(p)));
      shell.body.appendChild(uiMoreBar(
        uiMore(all, session.tbPage),
        () => { uiMorePage('tbPage', all.length); renderScreen(); },
        session.tbMore
      ));
    }

    uiFeel(shell, {
      onRefresh: () => { session.tbPage = 1; session.tbSort = 'new'; renderScreen(); },
      onMore: () => { if (uiMorePage('tbPage', all.length)) renderScreen(); },
      hasMore: () => uiMore(all, session.tbPage),
    });
    el.appendChild(shell.root);
  }

  /** 从「进吧」进来时的当前贴吧条 */
  function tbBarChip() {
    const row = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-barchip' });
    row.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-barchip-t', text: session.tbBar }));
    row.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-barchip-x', text: (session.tiebaPosts || []).filter((p) => p.barName === session.tbBar).length + ' 帖' }));
    const clr = h('button', { class: 'tph-btn xs ghost', type: 'button', onclick: () => { session.tbBar = ''; session.tbPage = 1; renderScreen(); } }, ['看全部']);
    row.appendChild(clr);
    return row;
  }

  /** 排序 + 过滤（贴吧名 / 关键词）后的帖子列表 */
  function tbFiltered() {
    let list = tiebaSorted();
    if (session.tbBar) list = list.filter((p) => p.barName === session.tbBar);
    if (session.tbQuery) list = list.filter((p) => uiHit(session.tbQuery, p.title, p.content, p.author, p.barName));
    if (session.tbSort === 'hot') list.sort((a, b) => tbScore(b) - tbScore(a));
    else if (session.tbSort === 'reply') list.sort((a, b) => (b.replies || []).length - (a.replies || []).length);
    return list;
  }

  /** 热度：回复权重最高，其次是赞，再按新旧衰减 */
  function tbScore(p) {
    const fresh = Math.max(0, 48 - Math.floor((Date.now() - (p.ts || 0)) / 3600000));
    return (p.replies || []).length * 3 + (p.likes || []).length * 2 + fresh;
  }

  // ========================= 帖子卡片（首页） =========================

  function tbBuildRow(p) {
    const card = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-card' });
    card.addEventListener('click', () => { session.tbDetailView = p; renderScreen(); });

    const head = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-head' });
    head.appendChild(avaNode(p.author, 28));
    const info = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-info' });
    info.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-author', text: p.author }));
    info.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-meta', text: tbBarLabel(p.barName) + ' · ' + timeAgo(p.ts) }));
    head.appendChild(info);
    if (p.source === 'ai') head.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-ai', text: 'AI' }));
    card.appendChild(head);

    card.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-title', text: p.title }));
    if (p.content) {
      const prev = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-preview' });
      prev.appendChild(richText(p.content.slice(0, 90) + (p.content.length > 90 ? '…' : ''), tbRichOpts()));
      card.appendChild(prev);
    }
    if (p.images && p.images.length) card.appendChild(tbThumbs(p.images));

    card.appendChild(tbFoot(p));
    return card;
  }

  /** 缩略图行：最多 3 张，超出显示 +N */
  function tbThumbs(imgs) {
    const row = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-thumbs' });
    imgs.slice(0, 3).forEach((desc, i) => {
      const cell = fakeCover(desc, null, 58);
      cell.className = 'tph-cover tph-tb-thumb';
      if (i === 2 && imgs.length > 3) cell.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-cover-x', text: '+' + (imgs.length - 3) }));
      row.appendChild(cell);
    });
    return row;
  }

  /** 卡片底栏：回复 / 赞 / 更多 */
  function tbFoot(p) {
    const foot = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-foot' });
    foot.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-stat', text: (p.replies || []).length + ' 回复' }));

    const me = userNameNow() || '我';
    const liked = (p.likes || []).indexOf(me) >= 0;
    const likeBtn = h('button', {
      class: 'tph-tb-act' + (liked ? ' on' : ''), type: 'button',
    });
    likeBtn.appendChild(iconSvg('heart', 13));
    likeBtn.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-act-n', text: tbNum((p.likes || []).length) }));
    likeBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      uiPop(likeBtn);
      tiebaToggleLike(p.id, me);
      const n = tiebaLikes(p.id, me);
      countUp(likeBtn.querySelector('.tph-tb-act-n'), liked ? (p.likes || []).length : (p.likes || []).length + 1, n);
      likeBtn.classList.toggle('on', n > (liked ? (p.likes || []).length : 0));
      setTimeout(() => { try { renderScreen(); } catch (_e) { /* 忽略 */ } }, 340);
    });
    foot.appendChild(likeBtn);

    const share = h('button', { class: 'tph-tb-act', type: 'button', title: '复制标题' });
    share.appendChild(iconSvg('redirect', 13));
    share.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      try { HW.navigator.clipboard.writeText(p.title); notify('标题已复制'); } catch (_err) { notify('复制失败', 'warning'); }
    });
    foot.appendChild(share);

    if (p.source === 'manual' || p.author === me) {
      const del = h('button', { class: 'tph-tb-act', type: 'button', title: '删除' });
      del.appendChild(iconSvg('trash', 13));
      del.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        session.tbMenu = session.tbMenu === p.id ? null : p.id;
        renderScreen();
      });
      foot.appendChild(del);
    }
    if (session.tbMenu === p.id) {
      const menu = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-menu' });
      menu.appendChild(h('button', {
        class: 'tph-btn xs danger', type: 'button',
        onclick: (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (HW.confirm('删除这条帖子？')) { tiebaDelete(p.id); session.tbMenu = null; renderScreen(); }
        },
      }, ['删除帖子']));
      foot.appendChild(menu);
    }
    return foot;
  }

  function tbNum(n) {
    const v = Number(n) || 0;
    return v >= 10000 ? (v / 10000).toFixed(1) + 'w' : String(v);
  }

  function tiebaLikes(id, me) {
    const p = (session.tiebaPosts || []).find((x) => x.id === id);
    if (!p) return 0;
    return ((p.likes || []).indexOf(me) >= 0) ? (p.likes || []).length : (p.likes || []).length + 1;
  }

  /** 列表里的富文本交互：点 #话题 直接把它当搜索词，点 @某人 去微信开聊 */
  function tbRichOpts() {
    return {
      onTag: (t) => { session.tbQuery = t; session.tbPage = 1; renderScreen(); },
      onMention: (n) => openChatWith(n),
    };
  }

  // ========================= 进吧 / 消息 / 我的 =========================

  function renderTbBars(el) {
    const shell = uiShell(Object.assign(tbTabOpts(el, 'bars'), { title: '进吧' }));
    const bars = tbBars();
    if (!bars.length) {
      shell.body.appendChild(uiBlank({ icon: 'group', title: '还没有贴吧', text: '有人发帖之后，贴吧会出现在这里。' }));
    } else {
      if (!session.tbFollows) session.tbFollows = {};
      bars.forEach((b) => {
        const row = h('div', { class: 'tph-rowline tap' });
        // 圆形吧头像（伪封面按吧名稳定取色）
        const ava = fakeCover(b.name, b.name, 40);
        ava.className = 'tph-cover tph-tb-barava';
        row.appendChild(ava);
        const mid = h('div', { class: 'tph-rowline-mid' });
        mid.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-rowline-t', text: tbBarLabel(b.name) }));
        mid.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-rowline-s', text: b.count + ' 帖 · 最后回复 ' + timeAgo(b.last) }));
        row.appendChild(mid);
        // 关注按钮：装饰性会话态，点了在 + 关注 / 已关注 之间切换
        const follow = h('button', { class: 'tph-tb-follow', type: 'button' });
        const syncFollow = () => {
          const on = !!session.tbFollows[b.name];
          follow.setAttribute('data-on', on ? '1' : '0');
          follow.textContent = on ? '已关注' : '+ 关注';
        };
        syncFollow();
        follow.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          session.tbFollows[b.name] = !session.tbFollows[b.name];
          saveTbFollows();
          syncFollow();
        });
        row.appendChild(follow);
        row.addEventListener('click', () => {
          session.tbBar = b.name; session.tbTab = 'home'; session.tbPage = 1; renderScreen();
        });
        shell.body.appendChild(row);
      });
    }
    el.appendChild(shell.root);
  }

  /** 贴吧名 → { name, count, last } */
  function tbBars() {
    const map = {};
    (session.tiebaPosts || []).forEach((p) => {
      const k = p.barName || '综合';
      if (!map[k]) map[k] = { name: k, count: 0, last: 0 };
      map[k].count++;
      map[k].last = Math.max(map[k].last, p.ts || 0);
    });
    return Object.keys(map).map((k) => map[k]).sort((a, b) => b.last - a.last);
  }

  /** 别人在我帖子下的回复（我发的帖才算「我的消息」） */
  function tbInbox() {
    const me = userNameNow() || '我';
    const out = [];
    (session.tiebaPosts || []).forEach((p) => {
      const mine = p.source === 'manual' || p.author === me;
      if (!mine) return;
      (p.replies || []).forEach((r) => { if (r.from && r.from !== me) out.push({ post: p, reply: r }); });
    });
    return out.sort((a, b) => (b.reply.ts || 0) - (a.reply.ts || 0));
  }

  function renderTbMsg(el) {
    const shell = uiShell(Object.assign(tbTabOpts(el, 'msg'), { title: '消息' }));
    const inbox = tbInbox();
    if (!inbox.length) {
      shell.body.appendChild(uiBlank({ icon: 'comment', title: '还没有新回复', text: '别人回复你的帖子后会出现在这里。' }));
    } else {
      inbox.forEach((it) => {
        const row = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-msg' });
        row.appendChild(avaNode(it.reply.from, 32));
        const mid = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-msg-mid' });
        const top = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-msg-top' });
        top.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-msg-from', text: it.reply.from }));
        top.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-msg-time', text: timeAgo(it.reply.ts) }));
        mid.appendChild(top);
        mid.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-msg-text', text: it.reply.text }));
        mid.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-msg-quote', text: '回复我的帖子：' + it.post.title }));
        row.appendChild(mid);
        row.addEventListener('click', () => { session.tbDetailView = it.post; renderScreen(); });
        row.classList.add('tap');
        shell.body.appendChild(row);
      });
    }
    el.appendChild(shell.root);
  }

  function renderTbMe(el) {
    const shell = uiShell(Object.assign(tbTabOpts(el, 'me'), { title: '我的' }));
    const me = userNameNow() || '我';
    const mine = tiebaSorted().filter((p) => p.source === 'manual' || p.author === me);
    const replies = mine.reduce((n, p) => n + (p.replies || []).length, 0);
    const likes = mine.reduce((n, p) => n + (p.likes || []).length, 0);

    const card = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-me' });
    card.appendChild(avaNode(me, 48));
    card.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-me-nm', text: me }));
    const stats = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-me-stats' });
    [[mine.length, '帖子'], [replies, '收到回复'], [likes, '收到赞']].forEach((s) => {
      const cell = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-me-stat' });
      cell.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-me-n', text: String(s[0]) }));
      cell.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-me-l', text: s[1] }));
      stats.appendChild(cell);
    });
    card.appendChild(stats);
    shell.body.appendChild(card);

    shell.body.appendChild(uiGroup('我的帖子', mine.length + ' 条'));
    if (!mine.length) {
      shell.body.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-empty', text: '还没发过帖子' }));
    } else {
      mine.forEach((p) => shell.body.appendChild(tbBuildRow(p)));
    }
    el.appendChild(shell.root);
  }

  // ========================= 帖子详情 =========================

  function tbBuildDetail(p) {
    const wrap = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-detail' });

    const head = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-main' });
    head.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-title-lg', text: p.title }));
    const who = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-main-who' });
    who.appendChild(avaNode(p.author, 30));
    const wi = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-main-wi' });
    wi.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-author', text: p.author }));
    wi.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-meta', text: timeAgo(p.ts) + (p.source === 'ai' ? ' · AI' : '') }));
    who.appendChild(wi);
    head.appendChild(who);
    wrap.appendChild(head);

    if (p.content) wrap.appendChild(richBody(p.content, Object.assign({ class: 'tph-tb-content' }, tbRichOpts())));
    if (p.images && p.images.length) {
      const imgs = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-imgs' });
      p.images.forEach((d) => imgs.appendChild(smartCover(d, d, 128)));
      wrap.appendChild(imgs);
    }

    // 操作栏
    const acts = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-dacts' });
    const me = userNameNow() || '我';
    const liked = (p.likes || []).indexOf(me) >= 0;
    const likeBtn = h('button', { class: 'tph-tb-act lg' + (liked ? ' on' : ''), type: 'button' });
    likeBtn.appendChild(iconSvg('heart', 15));
    likeBtn.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-act-t', text: (liked ? '已赞 ' : '赞 ') + (p.likes || []).length }));
    likeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      uiPop(likeBtn);
      tiebaToggleLike(p.id, me);
      setTimeout(() => { try { renderScreen(); } catch (_e) { /* 忽略 */ } }, 320);
    });
    acts.appendChild(likeBtn);
    acts.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-act-t dim', text: (p.replies || []).length + ' 条回复' }));

    // 楼主可以在详情页直接删帖 —— 真贴吧也是这个位置
    if (p.source === 'manual' || p.author === me) {
      const del = h('button', { class: 'tph-tb-act', type: 'button', title: '删除' });
      del.appendChild(iconSvg('trash', 14));
      del.addEventListener('click', () => {
        session.tbMenu = session.tbMenu === p.id ? null : p.id;
        renderScreen();
      });
      acts.appendChild(del);
      if (session.tbMenu === p.id) {
        const menu = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-menu' });
        menu.appendChild(h('button', {
          class: 'tph-btn xs danger', type: 'button',
          onclick: () => {
            if (!HW.confirm('删除这条帖子？')) return;
            tiebaDelete(p.id);
            session.tbMenu = null;
            session.tbDetailView = null;
            renderScreen();
          },
        }, ['删除帖子']));
        acts.appendChild(menu);
      }
    }
    wrap.appendChild(acts);

    // 楼中楼
    wrap.appendChild(uiGroup('全部回复', (p.replies || []).length + ' 楼'));
    if (!(p.replies || []).length) {
      wrap.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-empty', text: '还没有回复，来抢沙发' }));
    } else {
      p.replies.forEach((r, i) => wrap.appendChild(tbBuildReply(p, r, i)));
    }
    return wrap;
  }

  function tbBuildReply(p, r, i) {
    const row = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-reply' });
    const ava = avaNode(r.from, 26);
    row.appendChild(ava);
    const body = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-reply-body' });
    const top = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-reply-top' });
    top.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-reply-from', text: r.from }));
    // 楼主回复跟一条蓝色「楼主」小徽标（对齐真贴吧）
    if (r.from === p.author) top.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-op', text: '楼主' }));
    top.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-floor', text: (i + 1) + '楼' }));
    top.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-reply-time', text: timeAgo(r.ts) }));
    body.appendChild(top);
    const txt = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-reply-text' });
    txt.appendChild(richText(r.text, tbRichOpts()));
    body.appendChild(txt);
    row.appendChild(body);
    return row;
  }

  /** 详情页：顶栏 + 内容 + 底部回复栏 */
  function renderTbDetail(el, p) {
    const shell = uiShell({
      app: 'tieba',
      tab: 'home',
      tabs: null,
      back: { text: '贴吧', onClick: () => { session.tbDetailView = null; renderScreen(); } },
      title: tbBarLabel(p.barName),
      nav: {
        actions: [{
          icon: 'star', title: p.saved ? '已收藏' : '收藏',
          onClick: () => { p.saved = !p.saved; saveTieba(); notify(p.saved ? '已收藏' : '已取消收藏'); renderScreen(); },
        }],
      },
    });
    const tbStarBtn = shell.head.querySelector('.tph-ui-act');
    if (tbStarBtn) tbStarBtn.setAttribute('data-on', p.saved ? '1' : '0');
    shell.body.appendChild(tbBuildDetail(p));

    const bar = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-inputbar' });
    const inp = h('input', { class: 'tph-tb-inputbar-in', type: 'text', placeholder: '写回复…' });
    const send = h('button', { class: 'tph-tb-send', type: 'button' }, ['回复']);
    const doSend = () => {
      const v = String(inp.value || '').trim();
      if (!v) { notify('回复不能为空', 'warning'); return; }
      tiebaAddReply(p.id, userNameNow() || '我', v);
      inp.value = '';
      notify('已回复');
      renderScreen();
    };
    send.addEventListener('click', doSend);
    inp.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') doSend(); });
    bar.appendChild(inp);
    bar.appendChild(send);
    shell.root.appendChild(bar);

    el.appendChild(shell.root);
  }

  // ========================= 发帖面板 =========================

  function tbBuildCompose() {
    const box = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-compose' });
    box.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-compose-t', text: '发新帖' }));

    const whoRow = h('div', { class: 'tph-row' });
    whoRow.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-label inline', text: '发帖人' }));
    const whoInput = h('input', { class: 'tph-input', type: 'text', placeholder: '角色名（留空=我）', value: session.tbWho || '' });
    whoInput.addEventListener('input', () => { session.tbWho = whoInput.value; });
    whoRow.appendChild(whoInput);
    box.appendChild(whoRow);

    const barRow = h('div', { class: 'tph-row' });
    barRow.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-label inline', text: '贴吧' }));
    const barInput = h('input', { class: 'tph-input', type: 'text', placeholder: (config.tieba && config.tieba.defaultBar) || '综合讨论吧', value: session.tbBarName || session.tbBar || '' });
    barInput.addEventListener('input', () => { session.tbBarName = barInput.value; });
    barRow.appendChild(barInput);
    box.appendChild(barRow);

    const titleInput = h('input', { class: 'tph-input', type: 'text', placeholder: '帖子标题' });
    box.appendChild(titleInput);

    const ta = h('textarea', { class: 'tph-textarea', placeholder: '帖子正文……' });
    ta.style.minHeight = '72px';
    box.appendChild(ta);

    const imgInput = h('input', { class: 'tph-input', type: 'text', placeholder: '配图描述，逗号分隔（可留空）' });
    box.appendChild(imgInput);

    const acts = h('div', { class: 'tph-actions' });
    acts.appendChild(h('button', {
      class: 'tph-btn sm primary', type: 'button',
      onclick: () => {
        const title = String(titleInput.value || '').trim();
        const content = String(ta.value || '').trim();
        if (!title) { notify('标题不能为空', 'warning'); return; }
        const who = session.tbWho || userNameNow() || '我';
        const bar = session.tbBarName || session.tbBar || (config.tieba && config.tieba.defaultBar) || '综合';
        const imgs = tbSplitImgs(imgInput.value);
        tiebaAdd(who, bar, title, content, [], 'manual', imgs);
        notify('帖子已发布');
        session.tbCompose = false;
        session.tbDraft = '';
        session.tbPage = 1;
        renderScreen();
      },
    }, ['发布']));
    acts.appendChild(h('button', {
      class: 'tph-btn ghost sm', type: 'button',
      onclick: async () => {
        const who = session.tbWho || wxCandidates()[0] || userNameNow() || '角色';
        const bar = session.tbBarName || session.tbBar || (config.tieba && config.tieba.defaultBar) || '综合';
        setBusy('tbAI', true);
        const ctx = await storyContext((config.extract && config.extract.floorRange) || 20);
        const p = promptText('tiebaPost');
        const prompt = fillPrompt(p, { who: who, barName: bar, context: ctx, extra: '' });
        const r = await llm(prompt, '贴吧发帖');
        setBusy('tbAI', false);
        if (!r) { notify('AI 生成失败：' + (session.lastLlmErr || '未知错误'), 'warning'); return; }
        const obj = safeJson(r);
        if (obj && obj.title) {
          tiebaAdd(who, bar, obj.title, obj.content || '', obj.replies || [], 'ai', obj.images || []);
          notify('AI 已代发帖子');
          session.tbCompose = false;
          session.tbPage = 1;
          renderScreen();
        } else { notify('AI 返回格式异常', 'warning'); }
      },
    }, ['AI 代发']));
    box.appendChild(acts);
    return box;
  }

  function tbSplitImgs(v) {
    return String(v || '').split(/[,，;；\n]/).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 9);
  }

  /** AI 代发贴吧帖子（脱离 UI 的可复用入口，供更新中心调用）。返回 true/false */
  async function tbAiGen(silent) {
    const who = (session.tbWho || wxCandidates()[0] || userNameNow() || '角色');
    const bar = session.tbBarName || session.tbBar || (config.tieba && config.tieba.defaultBar) || '综合';
    setBusy('tbAI', true);
    if (!silent) renderScreen();
    const ctx = await storyContext((config.extract && config.extract.floorRange) || 20);
    const prof = profileByName(who);
    const profileCtx = prof ? buildProfileContext(prof) : '';
    const fullCtx = ctx + (profileCtx ? '\n\n' + profileCtx : '');
    const p = promptText('tiebaPost');
    const prompt = fillPrompt(p, { who: who, barName: bar, context: fullCtx, extra: '' });
    const r = await llm(prompt, '贴吧发帖');
    setBusy('tbAI', false);
    if (!r) { if (!silent) notify('贴吧 AI 生成失败：' + (session.lastLlmErr || '未知'), 'warning'); return false; }
    const obj = safeJson(r);
    if (obj && obj.title) {
      tiebaAdd(who, bar, obj.title, obj.content || '', obj.replies || [], 'ai', obj.images || []);
      if (!silent) { notify('AI 已代发帖子', 'success'); renderScreen(); }
      return true;
    }
    if (!silent) notify('贴吧 AI 返回格式异常', 'warning');
    return false;
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // 16. 小红书（两列瀑布流 / 笔记详情 / 点赞收藏 / 评论 / AI 发笔记）
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 定位：角色分享周边内容 —— 日常生活、种草好物、旅行见闻、心情记录。
  // 形态对齐真实小红书：红顶栏 + 搜索 + 关注/发现/收藏标签 + 两列错落瀑布流
  //                    + 底部导航（首页 / 好物 / 消息 / 我）+ 笔记详情页。
  // ===========================================================================

  /** 首页的分类标签（对齐真小红书：关注 / 发现 / 附近；id 不动，fav 段改为「附近」逻辑） */
  const RN_SORTS = [
    { id: 'follow', name: '关注' },
    { id: 'find', name: '发现' },
    { id: 'fav', name: '附近' },
  ];

  function ensureRnState() {
    if (!session.rnTab) session.rnTab = 'home';
    if (!session.rnSort) session.rnSort = 'find';
    if (session.rnQuery == null) session.rnQuery = '';
    if (!session.rnPage) session.rnPage = 1;
  }

  function renderRedNote(el) {
    ensureRnState();
    if (session.rnDetailView) {
      const fresh = (session.redNotes || []).find((x) => x.id === session.rnDetailView.id);
      if (!fresh) { session.rnDetailView = null; session.rnTab = 'home'; }
      else { session.rnDetailView = fresh; renderRnDetail(el, fresh); return; }
    }
    if (session.rnTab === 'goods') renderRnGoods(el);
    else if (session.rnTab === 'msg') renderRnMsg(el);
    else if (session.rnTab === 'me') renderRnMe(el);
    else renderRnHome(el);
  }

  /** 未读消息数：进入消息页后红点消失（时间戳水位） */
  function rnUnreadCount() {
    const read = Number(session.rnInboxReadTs) || 0;
    return rnInbox().filter((it) => (Number(it.cmt && it.cmt.ts) || 0) > read).length;
  }

  function rnTabOpts(tab) {
    return {
      app: 'rednote',
      tab: tab,
      onTab: (id) => {
        session.rnTab = id; session.rnPage = 1; session.rnDetailView = null;
        // 进消息页即已读
        if (id === 'msg') { session.rnInboxReadTs = Date.now(); saveReadTs(); }
        renderScreen();
      },
      onHome: () => gotoApp('home'),
      badges: { msg: rnUnreadCount() },
    };
  }

  // ========================= 首页（瀑布流） =========================

  function renderRnHome(el) {
    const shell = uiShell(Object.assign(rnTabOpts('home'), {
      nav: {
        search: '搜索笔记 / 用户',
        query: session.rnQuery,
        onSearch: (v) => { session.rnQuery = v; session.rnPage = 1; renderScreen(); },
        actions: [{
          icon: session.rnCompose ? 'close' : 'plus',
          title: session.rnCompose ? '收起' : '发笔记',
          onClick: () => {
            session.rnCompose = !session.rnCompose;
            if (!session.rnCompose) { session.rnDraft = ''; session.rnWho = ''; }
            renderScreen();
          },
        }],
      },
      subTabs: {
        items: RN_SORTS, active: session.rnSort,
        onPick: (id) => { session.rnSort = id; session.rnPage = 1; renderScreen(); },
      },
    }));

    if (session.rnCompose) shell.body.appendChild(rnBuildCompose());

    const all = rnFiltered();
    if (!all.length) {
      shell.body.appendChild(uiBlank({
        icon: 'image',
        title: session.rnQuery ? '没有搜到笔记' : (session.rnSort === 'fav' ? '附近还没有笔记' : '还没有笔记'),
        text: session.rnQuery ? '换个关键词试试。' : '还没有笔记，发一篇试试。',
        actions: session.rnSort === 'find' ? [{ text: '发笔记', primary: true, onClick: () => { session.rnCompose = true; renderScreen(); } }] : null,
      }));
    } else {
      shell.body.appendChild(rnGrid(uiSlice(all, session.rnPage)));
      shell.body.appendChild(uiMoreBar(
        uiMore(all, session.rnPage),
        () => { uiMorePage('rnPage', all.length); renderScreen(); },
        session.rnMore
      ));
    }

    uiFeel(shell, {
      onRefresh: () => { session.rnPage = 1; renderScreen(); },
      onMore: () => { if (uiMorePage('rnPage', all.length)) renderScreen(); },
      hasMore: () => uiMore(all, session.rnPage),
    });
    el.appendChild(shell.root);
  }

  /** 两列瀑布流：交替追加 + 封面高度按种子错落 */
  function rnGrid(notes) {
    const grid = h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-grid' });
    const cols = [h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-col' }), h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-col' })];
    notes.forEach((n, i) => cols[i % 2].appendChild(rnBuildCard(n)));
    cols.forEach((c) => grid.appendChild(c));
    return grid;
  }

  function rnFiltered() {
    const me = userNameNow() || '我';
    let list = redNoteSorted();
    if (session.rnSort === 'follow') list = list.filter((n) => n.author !== me);
    else if (session.rnSort === 'fav') {
      // 「附近」：没有真定位，用按笔记 id 的稳定散列当伪距离排序（不再按收藏过滤）
      list = list.slice().sort((a, b) => (uiHash('near' + a.id) % 97) - (uiHash('near' + b.id) % 97));
    }
    if (session.rnQuery) list = list.filter((n) => uiHit(session.rnQuery, n.title, n.content, n.author));
    return list;
  }

  /** 封面高度：同一个 id 永远同一高度，换页也不会跳动 */
  function rnCoverH(n) {
    const steps = [86, 112, 76, 128, 98, 68];
    return steps[uiHash(n.id + (n.title || '')) % steps.length];
  }

  // ========================= 笔记卡片 =========================

  function rnBuildCard(n) {
    const card = h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-card' });
    card.addEventListener('click', () => { session.rnDetailView = n; renderScreen(); });

    const firstImg = (n.images && n.images.length) ? n.images[0] : n.title;
    const cover = smartCover(firstImg, n.id + n.title, rnCoverH(n),
      (n.images && n.images.length > 1) ? String(n.images.length) : '');
    card.appendChild(cover);

    card.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-title', text: n.title }));

    const foot = h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-card-foot' });
    foot.appendChild(avaNode(n.author, 20));
    const nm = h('span', { class: 'tph-rn-author' });
    nm.appendChild(tnode(n.author));
    foot.appendChild(nm);

    const me = userNameNow() || '我';
    const liked = (n.likes || []).indexOf(me) >= 0;
    const likeBtn = h('button', { class: 'tph-rn-like' + (liked ? ' on' : ''), type: 'button' });
    likeBtn.appendChild(iconSvg('heart', 12));
    likeBtn.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-rn-like-n', text: n.likes.length ? String(n.likes.length) : '' }));
    likeBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      uiPop(likeBtn);
      redNoteToggleLike(n.id, me);
      likeBtn.classList.toggle('on', !liked);
      likeBtn.querySelector('.tph-rn-like-n').textContent = String(n.likes.length + (liked ? -1 : 1));
    });
    foot.appendChild(likeBtn);
    card.appendChild(foot);
    return card;
  }

  // ========================= 好物 / 消息 / 我 =========================

  /** 「好物」= 带商品信息或配图的笔记，商品优先展示 */
  function renderRnGoods(el) {
    const shell = uiShell(Object.assign(rnTabOpts('goods'), { title: '好物', nav: {
      actions: [{
        icon: 'plus', title: 'AI 种草',
        onClick: async () => {
          if (session.rnBusy) return;
          session.rnBusy = true;
          renderScreen();
          try { await rnAiGoods(); }
          catch (e) { notify('好物生成失败：' + errText(e), 'warning'); }
          finally { session.rnBusy = false; renderScreen(); }
        },
      }],
    } }));
    // 商品笔记优先，其次带图笔记
    const all = redNoteSorted();
    const goods = all.filter((n) => n.product);
    const withImg = all.filter((n) => !n.product && (n.images || []).length);
    const list = goods.concat(withImg);
    if (!list.length) {
      shell.body.appendChild(uiBlank({ icon: 'star', title: '还没有好物', text: '点右上角「AI 种草」让角色推荐好物，或者发带配图的笔记也会出现在这里。' }));
    } else {
      list.forEach((n) => shell.body.appendChild(rnBuildGoodsRow(n)));
    }
    el.appendChild(shell.root);
  }

  /** 好物清单行：商品图 + 商品名/价格/评分 + 作者 + 赞数 */
  function rnBuildGoodsRow(n) {
    const row = h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-goods' });
    const firstImg = (n.images && n.images.length) ? n.images[0] : (n.id + n.title);
    row.appendChild(smartCover(firstImg, n.id + n.title, 58));
    const mid = h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-goods-mid' });
    mid.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-rn-goods-t', text: n.title }));
    if (n.product) {
      mid.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-rn-goods-price', text: n.product.price }));
      if (n.product.rating > 0) {
        mid.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-rn-goods-rate', text: '★' + n.product.rating + ' · ' + n.product.name }));
      }
      if (n.product.reason) {
        mid.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-rn-goods-reason', text: n.product.reason }));
      }
    } else {
      // 无商品的带图笔记：显示作者+时间
      mid.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-rn-goods-s', text: n.author + ' · ' + timeAgo(n.ts) }));
    }
    row.appendChild(mid);
    const right = h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-goods-r' });
    right.appendChild(iconSvg('heart', 12));
    right.appendChild(h('span', { text: String((n.likes || []).length) }));
    row.appendChild(right);
    row.addEventListener('click', () => { session.rnDetailView = n; renderScreen(); });
    return row;
  }

  /** 别人在我笔记下的评论 */
  function rnInbox() {
    const me = userNameNow() || '我';
    const out = [];
    (session.redNotes || []).forEach((n) => {
      if (n.author !== me) return;
      (n.comments || []).forEach((c) => { if (c.from && c.from !== me) out.push({ note: n, cmt: c }); });
    });
    return out.sort((a, b) => (b.cmt.ts || 0) - (a.cmt.ts || 0));
  }

  function renderRnMsg(el) {
    const shell = uiShell(Object.assign(rnTabOpts('msg'), { title: '消息' }));
    const inbox = rnInbox();
    if (!inbox.length) {
      shell.body.appendChild(uiBlank({ icon: 'comment', title: '还没有新评论', text: '别人评论你的笔记后会出现在这里。' }));
    } else {
      inbox.forEach((it) => {
        const row = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-msg tap' });
        row.appendChild(avaNode(it.cmt.from, 32));
        const mid = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-msg-mid' });
        mid.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-msg-top' }, [
          h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-msg-from', text: it.cmt.from }),
          h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-msg-time', text: timeAgo(it.cmt.ts) }),
        ]));
        mid.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-msg-text', text: it.cmt.text }));
        mid.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-msg-quote', text: '评论了我的笔记：' + it.note.title }));
        row.appendChild(mid);
        row.addEventListener('click', () => { session.rnDetailView = it.note; renderScreen(); });
        shell.body.appendChild(row);
      });
    }
    el.appendChild(shell.root);
  }

  function renderRnMe(el) {
    const shell = uiShell(Object.assign(rnTabOpts('me'), { title: '我' }));
    const me = userNameNow() || '我';
    const mine = redNoteSorted().filter((n) => n.author === me);
    const likes = mine.reduce((n, x) => n + (x.likes || []).length, 0);
    const cmts = mine.reduce((n, x) => n + (x.comments || []).length, 0);

    const card = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-me' });
    card.appendChild(avaNode(me, 48));
    card.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-me-nm', text: me }));
    const stats = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-me-stats' });
    [[mine.length, '笔记'], [likes, '获赞'], [cmts, '评论']].forEach((s) => {
      const cell = h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-me-stat' });
      cell.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-me-n', text: String(s[0]) }));
      cell.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-tb-me-l', text: s[1] }));
      stats.appendChild(cell);
    });
    card.appendChild(stats);
    shell.body.appendChild(card);

    shell.body.appendChild(uiGroup('我的笔记', mine.length + ' 篇'));
    if (!mine.length) shell.body.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-empty', text: '还没发过笔记' }));
    else mine.forEach((n) => shell.body.appendChild(rnBuildCard(n)));

    const favs = redNoteStarred();
    shell.body.appendChild(uiGroup('我的收藏', favs.length + ' 篇'));
    if (!favs.length) shell.body.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-empty', text: '还没有收藏的笔记' }));
    else favs.forEach((n) => shell.body.appendChild(rnBuildCard(n)));
    el.appendChild(shell.root);
  }

  // ========================= 笔记详情 =========================

  function rnBuildDetail(n) {
    const wrap = h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-detail' });

    // 封面区：包一层定位容器，双击 = 点赞 + 爱心爆裂（对齐真小红书手感）
    const coverBox = h('div');
    coverBox.style.position = 'relative';
    if (n.images && n.images.length) {
      const strip = h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-strip' });
      n.images.forEach((imgData) => {
        const one = h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-strip-item' });
        one.appendChild(smartCover(imgData, String(imgData) + n.id, 200));
        strip.appendChild(one);
      });
      coverBox.appendChild(strip);

      // 页码小圆点（跟随横滑高亮）
      if (n.images.length > 1) {
        const pips = h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-pips' });
        const pipEls = n.images.map((_d, i) => {
          const p = h('i');
          if (i === 0) p.setAttribute('data-on', '1');
          pips.appendChild(p);
          return p;
        });
        coverBox.appendChild(pips);
        strip.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
          const per = (strip.scrollWidth - strip.clientWidth) / (n.images.length - 1);
          const idx = per > 0 ? Math.min(n.images.length - 1, Math.max(0, Math.round(strip.scrollLeft / per))) : 0;
          pipEls.forEach((p, i) => {
            if (i === idx) p.setAttribute('data-on', '1');
            else p.removeAttribute('data-on');
          });
        }, { passive: true });
      }

      // 鼠标滚轮 → 横向滑动（普通滚轮只产生纵向 delta，横条需要转换）
      strip.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
        if (Math.abs(e.deltaY) > Math.abs(e.deltaX)) {
          e.preventDefault();
          strip.scrollLeft += e.deltaY;
        }
      }, { passive: false });
    } else {
      coverBox.appendChild(smartCover(n.title, n.id + n.title, 172));
    }
    wrap.appendChild(coverBox);
    // 封面本身没有单击行为，dblclick 不会和单击逻辑打架；
    // 双击只赞不取消，爆裂动画放完（800ms）再重渲染同步底栏红心
    coverBox.addEventListener('dblclick', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const me = userNameNow() || '我';
      if ((n.likes || []).indexOf(me) < 0) redNoteToggleLike(n.id, me);
      const host = h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-burst-host' });
      const burst = h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-burst' });
      burst.appendChild(iconSvg('heart', 56));
      host.appendChild(burst);
      coverBox.appendChild(host);
      setTimeout(() => { if (host.parentNode) host.parentNode.removeChild(host); }, 800);
      setTimeout(() => { try { renderScreen(); } catch (_e) { /* 忽略 */ } }, 840);
    });

    const body = h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-body' });
    const head = h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-head' });
    head.appendChild(avaNode(n.author, 34));
    const hi = h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-head-i' });
    hi.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-rn-author-lg', text: n.author }));
    hi.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-rn-head-s', text: timeAgo(n.ts) + (n.source === 'ai' ? ' · AI' : '') }));
    head.appendChild(hi);
    body.appendChild(head);
    body.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-title-lg', text: n.title }));
    if (n.content) body.appendChild(richBody(n.content, { class: 'tph-rn-content', onTag: rnTagSearch, onMention: openChatWith }));
    // 商品信息卡（种草好物）
    if (n.product) {
      const pc = h('div', { class: 'tph-card', style: 'margin-top:10px' });
      pc.appendChild(h('div', { style: 'font-size:14px;font-weight:600', text: n.product.name }));
      const pr = h('div', { style: 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:4px' });
      pr.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-rn-goods-price', text: n.product.price }));
      if (n.product.rating > 0) pr.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-rn-goods-rate', text: '★' + n.product.rating }));
      pc.appendChild(pr);
      if (n.product.reason) pc.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-goods-reason', text: n.product.reason }));
      body.appendChild(pc);
    }
    if (n.images && n.images.length) {
      const tags = h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-tags' });
      n.images.forEach((d) => {
        const desc = (typeof d === 'object' && d.desc) ? d.desc : (typeof d === 'string' ? d : '');
        if (desc) tags.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-rn-tagc', text: '# ' + desc.slice(0, 10) }));
      });
      body.appendChild(tags);
    }
    wrap.appendChild(body);
    return wrap;
  }

  function rnTagSearch(t) {
    session.rnQuery = t;
    session.rnDetailView = null;
    session.rnTab = 'home';
    session.rnPage = 1;
    renderScreen();
  }

  function renderRnDetail(el, n) {
    const shell = uiShell({
      app: 'rednote',
      tabs: null,
      back: { text: '小红书', onClick: () => { session.rnDetailView = null; renderScreen(); } },
      title: '笔记',
      nav: {
        actions: [{
          icon: 'redirect', title: '分享',
          onClick: () => { try { HW.navigator.clipboard.writeText(n.title); notify('标题已复制'); } catch (_e) { notify('复制失败', 'warning'); } },
        }],
      },
    });
    shell.body.appendChild(rnBuildDetail(n));

    // 评论
    shell.body.appendChild(uiGroup('共 ' + (n.comments || []).length + ' 条评论'));
    if (!(n.comments || []).length) {
      shell.body.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-empty', text: '还没有评论' }));
    } else {
      n.comments.forEach((c) => {
        const row = h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-comment' });
        row.appendChild(avaNode(c.from, 28));
        const mid = h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-cmt-mid' });

        mid.appendChild(ct);
        mid.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-rn-cmt-time', text: timeAgo(c.ts) }));
        row.appendChild(mid);
        shell.body.appendChild(row);
      });
    }

    // 底部：输入 + 点赞 + 收藏
    const me = userNameNow() || '我';
    const bar = h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-actbar' });
    const inp = h('input', { class: 'tph-rn-actbar-in', type: 'text', placeholder: '说点什么…' });
    const send = h('button', { class: 'tph-rn-send', type: 'button' }, ['发送']);
    const doSend = () => {
      const v = String(inp.value || '').trim();
      if (!v) return;
      redNoteAddComment(n.id, me, v);
      inp.value = '';
      renderScreen();
    };
    send.addEventListener('click', doSend);
    inp.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') doSend(); });
    bar.appendChild(inp);

    const liked = (n.likes || []).indexOf(me) >= 0;
    const likeBtn = h('button', { class: 'tph-rn-actbar-btn' + (liked ? ' on' : ''), type: 'button', title: '点赞' });
    likeBtn.appendChild(iconSvg('heart', 17));
    likeBtn.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-rn-actbar-n', text: String((n.likes || []).length) }));
    likeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      uiPop(likeBtn);
      redNoteToggleLike(n.id, me);
      setTimeout(() => { try { renderScreen(); } catch (_e) { /* 忽略 */ } }, 320);
    });
    bar.appendChild(likeBtn);

    const starred = !!n.starred;
    const starBtn = h('button', { class: 'tph-rn-actbar-btn' + (starred ? ' on' : ''), type: 'button', title: '收藏', 'data-on': starred ? '1' : '0' });
    starBtn.appendChild(iconSvg('star', 17));
    const starLabel = h('span', { class: 'tph-rn-actbar-n', text: starred ? '已收藏' : '收藏' });
    starBtn.appendChild(starLabel);
    starBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      uiPop(starBtn);
      redNoteToggleStar(n.id, me);
      const on = !!n.starred;
      starBtn.setAttribute('data-on', on ? '1' : '0');
      starBtn.classList.toggle('on', on);
      starLabel.textContent = on ? '已收藏' : '收藏';
    });
    bar.appendChild(starBtn);
    bar.appendChild(send);
    shell.root.appendChild(bar);

    el.appendChild(shell.root);
  }

  // ========================= 发笔记面板 =========================

  function rnBuildCompose() {
    const box = h('div', { class: 'tph-rn-compose' });
    box.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-tb-compose-t', text: '写笔记' }));

    const whoRow = h('div', { class: 'tph-row' });
    whoRow.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-label inline', text: '发布者' }));
    const whoInput = h('input', { class: 'tph-input', type: 'text', placeholder: '角色名（留空=我）', value: session.rnWho || '' });
    whoInput.addEventListener('input', () => { session.rnWho = whoInput.value; });
    whoRow.appendChild(whoInput);
    box.appendChild(whoRow);

    const titleInput = h('input', { class: 'tph-input', type: 'text', placeholder: '标题' });
    box.appendChild(titleInput);

    const ta = h('textarea', { class: 'tph-textarea', placeholder: '分享生活…（#话题 和 @某人 会自动变可点）' });
    ta.style.minHeight = '72px';
    box.appendChild(ta);

    const imgInput = h('input', { class: 'tph-input', type: 'text', placeholder: '配图描述，逗号分隔（可留空）' });
    box.appendChild(imgInput);

    const acts = h('div', { class: 'tph-actions' });
    acts.appendChild(h('button', {
      class: 'tph-btn sm primary', type: 'button',
      onclick: () => {
        const title = String(titleInput.value || '').trim();
        const content = String(ta.value || '').trim();
        if (!title) { notify('标题不能为空', 'warning'); return; }
        const who = session.rnWho || userNameNow() || '我';
        redNoteAdd(who, title, content, rnSplitImgs(imgInput.value), 'manual');
        notify('笔记已发布');
        session.rnCompose = false;
        session.rnPage = 1;
        renderScreen();
      },
    }, ['发布']));
    acts.appendChild(h('button', {
      class: 'tph-btn ghost sm', type: 'button',
      onclick: async () => {
        const who = session.rnWho || wxCandidates()[0] || userNameNow() || '角色';
        setBusy('rnAI', true);
        const ctx = await storyContext((config.extract && config.extract.floorRange) || 20);
        const p = promptText('rednoteNote');
        const prompt = fillPrompt(p, { who: who, context: ctx, extra: '', imgCount: (config.rednote && config.rednote.imgCount != null ? config.rednote.imgCount : 3) });
        const r = await llm(prompt, '小红书笔记');
        setBusy('rnAI', false);
        if (!r) { notify('AI 生成失败', 'warning'); return; }
        const obj = safeJson(r);
        if (obj && obj.title) {
          const note = redNoteAdd(who, obj.title, obj.content || '', obj.images || [], 'ai');
          if (note && obj.comments) {
            obj.comments.forEach((c) => { if (c.from && c.text) redNoteAddComment(note.id, c.from, c.text); });
          }
          notify('AI 已代发笔记');
          session.rnCompose = false;
          session.rnPage = 1;
          renderScreen();
        } else { notify('AI 返回格式异常', 'warning'); }
      },
    }, ['AI 代写']));
    box.appendChild(acts);
    return box;
  }

  function rnSplitImgs(v) {
    return String(v || '').split(/[,，;；\n]/).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 9);
  }

  /** AI 代写小红书笔记（脱离 UI 的可复用入口，供更新中心调用）。返回 true/false */
  async function rnAiGen(silent) {
    const who = (session.rnWho || wxCandidates()[0] || userNameNow() || '角色');
    setBusy('rnAI', true);
    if (!silent) renderScreen();
    const ctx = await storyContext((config.extract && config.extract.floorRange) || 20);
    const prof = profileByName(who);
    const profileCtx = prof ? buildProfileContext(prof) : '';
    const fullCtx = ctx + (profileCtx ? '\n\n' + profileCtx : '');
    const p = promptText('rednoteNote');
    const prompt = fillPrompt(p, { who: who, context: fullCtx, extra: '', imgCount: (config.rednote && config.rednote.imgCount != null ? config.rednote.imgCount : 3) });
    const r = await llm(prompt, '小红书笔记');
    setBusy('rnAI', false);
    if (!r) { if (!silent) notify('小红书 AI 生成失败', 'warning'); return false; }
    const obj = safeJson(r);
    if (obj && obj.title) {
      const note = redNoteAdd(who, obj.title, obj.content || '', obj.images || [], 'ai');
      if (note && obj.comments) {
        obj.comments.forEach((c) => { if (c.from && c.text) redNoteAddComment(note.id, c.from, c.text); });
      }
      if (!silent) { notify('AI 已代写笔记', 'success'); renderScreen(); }
      return true;
    }
    if (!silent) notify('小红书 AI 返回格式异常', 'warning');
    return false;
  }

  /** AI 种草好物：生成带商品信息的种草笔记 */
  async function rnAiGoods(silent) {
    const who = (session.rnWho || wxCandidates()[0] || userNameNow() || '角色');
    setBusy('rnAI', true);
    if (!silent) renderScreen();
    const ctx = await storyContext((config.extract && config.extract.floorRange) || 20);
    const prof = profileByName(who);
    const profileCtx = prof ? buildProfileContext(prof) : '';
    const fullCtx = ctx + (profileCtx ? '\n\n' + profileCtx : '');
    const p = promptText('rednoteGoods');
    const prompt = fillPrompt(p, { who: who, context: fullCtx, extra: '', imgCount: (config.rednote && config.rednote.imgCount != null ? config.rednote.imgCount : 3) });
    const r = await llm(prompt, '小红书种草好物');
    setBusy('rnAI', false);
    if (!r) { if (!silent) notify('好物生成失败', 'warning'); return false; }
    const obj = safeJson(r);
    if (obj && obj.title) {
      const note = redNoteAdd(who, obj.title, obj.content || '', obj.images || [], 'ai', obj.product || null);
      if (note && obj.comments) {
        obj.comments.forEach((c) => { if (c.from && c.text) redNoteAddComment(note.id, c.from, c.text); });
      }
      if (!silent) { notify('AI 已种草好物', 'success'); session.rnTab = 'goods'; renderScreen(); }
      return true;
    }
    if (!silent) notify('好物生成格式异常', 'warning');
    return false;
  }

  /** 保留旧名：散列色仍被别处用来给描述生成稳定色块 */
  function hashColor(str) {
    const hue = uiHash(str) % 360;
    return 'hsl(' + hue + ',55%,70%)';
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // 17. X / Twitter（时间线 / 发推 / 点赞转推 / 通知 / 私信）
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 定位：和现实 X 相似 —— 短文、即时、公开。
  // 形态对齐真实 X：顶栏 + 为你推荐/关注标签 + 发推栏 + 推文（回复/转推/点赞/查看）
  //                + 底部导航（主页 / 搜索 / 通知 / 私信）。
  // ===========================================================================

  const X_SORTS = [
    { id: 'for', name: '为你推荐' },
    { id: 'following', name: '关注' },
  ];

  function ensureXState() {
    if (!session.xTab) session.xTab = 'home';
    if (!session.xSort) session.xSort = 'for';
    if (session.xQuery == null) session.xQuery = '';
    if (!session.xPage) session.xPage = 1;
  }

  function renderX(el) {
    ensureXState();
    // 推文详情页优先：点推文卡进入，返回时清掉 xDetailId 退回列表
    if (session.xDetailId) {
      const tw = (session.xTweets || []).find((t) => t.id === session.xDetailId);
      if (tw) { renderXDetail(el, tw); return; }
      session.xDetailId = null;
    }
    if (session.xTab === 'search') renderXSearch(el);
    else if (session.xTab === 'noti') renderXNoti(el);
    else if (session.xTab === 'dm') renderXDm(el);
    else renderXHome(el);
    // 真 X 的底栏是纯图标 —— 骨架默认渲染的文字标签在这里统一藏掉
    el.querySelectorAll('.tph-ui-tab-nm').forEach((nm) => { nm.style.display = 'none'; });
  }

  /** 未读通知数：进入通知页后红点消失（时间戳水位） */
  function xUnreadCount() {
    const read = Number(session.xNotiReadTs) || 0;
    return xNoti().filter((it) => (Number(it.at) || 0) > read).length;
  }

  function xTabOpts(tab) {
    return {
      app: 'x',
      tab: tab,
      // 用自己的副本数组，不直接共用 APP_TABS.x（渲染后的图标化在 renderX 里统一处理）
      tabs: APP_TABS.x.map((t) => ({ id: t.id, name: t.name, icon: t.icon })),
      onTab: (id) => {
        session.xTab = id; session.xPage = 1;
        // 进通知页即已读
        if (id === 'noti') { session.xNotiReadTs = Date.now(); saveReadTs(); }
        renderScreen();
      },
      onHome: () => gotoApp('home'),
      badges: { noti: xUnreadCount() },
    };
  }

  // ========================= 时间线 =========================

  function renderXHome(el) {
    const shell = uiShell(Object.assign(xTabOpts('home'), {
      nav: {
        actions: [{ icon: session.xCompose ? 'close' : 'edit', title: session.xCompose ? '收起' : '发推', onClick: toggleXCompose }],
      },
      title: 'X',
      subTabs: {
        items: X_SORTS, active: session.xSort,
        onPick: (id) => { session.xSort = id; session.xPage = 1; renderScreen(); },
      },
    }));

    // 顶栏不用文字标题，换成 X logo（对齐真 X）
    const titleEl = shell.head.querySelector('.tph-ui-title');
    if (titleEl) {
      clearChildren(titleEl);
      const logo = h('span', { class: 'tph-x-logo' });
      logo.appendChild(iconSvg('app-x', 18));
      titleEl.appendChild(logo);
    }

    if (session.xCompose) shell.body.appendChild(xBuildCompose());
    else shell.body.appendChild(xBuildBar());

    const all = xFiltered();
    if (!all.length) {
      shell.body.appendChild(uiBlank({
        icon: 'comment',
        title: session.xSort === 'following' ? '关注的人还没发推' : '时间线是空的',
        text: '还没有推文，发一条试试。',
      }));
    } else {
      uiSlice(all, session.xPage).forEach((t) => shell.body.appendChild(xBuildTweet(t)));
      shell.body.appendChild(uiMoreBar(
        uiMore(all, session.xPage),
        () => { uiMorePage('xPage', all.length); renderScreen(); },
        session.xMore
      ));
    }

    // 发推浮动钮（真 X 右下角的 compose FAB，复用发推面板入口）
    const fabHost = h('div', { class: 'tph-x-fab-host' });
    const fab = h('button', {
      class: 'tph-x-fab', type: 'button', title: '发推',
      onclick: () => { session.xCompose = true; renderScreen(); },
    });
    fab.appendChild(iconSvg('edit', 22));
    fabHost.appendChild(fab);
    shell.body.appendChild(fabHost);

    uiFeel(shell, {
      onRefresh: () => { session.xPage = 1; renderScreen(); },
      onMore: () => { if (uiMorePage('xPage', all.length)) renderScreen(); },
      hasMore: () => uiMore(all, session.xPage),
    });
    el.appendChild(shell.root);
  }

  function toggleXCompose() {
    session.xCompose = !session.xCompose;
    if (!session.xCompose) { session.xDraft = ''; session.xWho = ''; }
    renderScreen();
  }

  /** 首页顶部的「有什么新鲜事」条：点了展开完整发推面板 */
  function xBuildBar() {
    const me = userNameNow() || '我';
    const bar = h('div', { class: 'tph-x-bar' });
    bar.appendChild(avaNode(me, 32));
    bar.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-x-bar-t', text: '有什么新鲜事？' }));
    bar.appendChild(h('button', { class: 'tph-x-bar-btn', type: 'button', text: '发帖', onclick: toggleXCompose }));
    bar.addEventListener('click', () => toggleXCompose());
    return bar;
  }

  function xFiltered() {
    const me = userNameNow() || '我';
    let list = xSorted();
    if (session.xSort === 'following') list = list.filter((t) => t.author !== me);
    return list;
  }

  // ========================= 推文 =========================

  function xBuildTweet(t) {
    const card = h('div', { class: 'tph-x-card tap' });
    // 点推文卡进入详情页（内部按钮都 stopPropagation，不会误触）
    card.addEventListener('click', () => {
      session.xDetailId = t.id;
      renderScreen();
    });

    const head = h('div', { class: 'tph-x-head' });
    head.appendChild(avaNode(t.author, 36));
    const info = h('div', { class: 'tph-x-info' });
    const top = h('div', { class: 'tph-x-info-top' });
    top.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-x-name', text: t.author }));
    if (t.source === 'ai') top.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-x-ai', text: 'AI' }));
    info.appendChild(top);
    info.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-x-handle', text: '@' + t.handle + ' · ' + timeAgo(t.ts) }));
    head.appendChild(info);
    head.appendChild(h('button', { class: 'tph-x-more', type: 'button', onclick: (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); xMenu(t); } }, [iconSvg('dots', 14)]));
    card.appendChild(head);

    const txt = h('div', { class: 'tph-x-text' });
    txt.appendChild(richText(t.text, {
      onTag: (v) => { session.xTab = 'search'; session.xQuery = v; session.xPage = 1; renderScreen(); },
      onMention: openChatWith,
    }));
    card.appendChild(txt);

    card.appendChild(xActs(t));

    if (t.replies.length) {
      const box = h('div', { class: 'tph-x-replies' });
      t.replies.forEach((r) => {
        const row = h('div', { class: 'tph-x-reply' });
        row.appendChild(avaNode(r.from, 24));
        const ri = h('div', { class: 'tph-x-reply-body' });
        const rt = h('div', { class: 'tph-x-reply-top' });
        rt.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-x-reply-name', text: r.from }));
        rt.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-x-handle', text: timeAgo(r.ts) }));
        ri.appendChild(rt);
        const rtx = h('div', { class: 'tph-x-reply-text' });
        rtx.appendChild(richText(r.text, { onMention: openChatWith }));
        ri.appendChild(rtx);
        row.appendChild(ri);
        box.appendChild(row);
      });
      card.appendChild(box);
    }
    return card;
  }

  /** 动作栏：回复 / 转推 / 点赞 / 查看 */
  function xActs(t) {
    const me = userNameNow() || '我';
    const acts = h('div', { class: 'tph-x-acts' });

    const rBtn = h('button', { class: 'tph-x-act', type: 'button', title: '回复' });
    rBtn.appendChild(iconSvg('comment', 15));
    rBtn.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-x-act-n', text: t.replies.length ? String(t.replies.length) : '' }));
    rBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); session.xReply = session.xReply === t.id ? null : t.id; renderScreen(); });
    acts.appendChild(rBtn);

    const rted = (t.retweets || []).indexOf(me) >= 0;
    const rtBtn = h('button', { class: 'tph-x-act rt' + (rted ? ' on' : ''), type: 'button', title: '转推' });
    rtBtn.appendChild(iconSvg('retweet', 15));
    rtBtn.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-x-act-n', text: t.retweets.length ? String(t.retweets.length) : '' }));
    rtBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      uiPop(rtBtn);
      xToggleRetweet(t.id, me);
      rtBtn.classList.toggle('on', !rted);
      rtBtn.querySelector('.tph-x-act-n').textContent = String(t.retweets.length + (rted ? -1 : 1));
    });
    acts.appendChild(rtBtn);

    const liked = (t.likes || []).indexOf(me) >= 0;
    const lBtn = h('button', { class: 'tph-x-act lk' + (liked ? ' on' : ''), type: 'button', title: '点赞' });
    lBtn.appendChild(iconSvg('heart', 15));
    lBtn.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-x-act-n', text: t.likes.length ? String(t.likes.length) : '' }));
    lBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      uiPop(lBtn);
      xToggleLike(t.id, me);
      lBtn.classList.toggle('on', !liked);
      lBtn.querySelector('.tph-x-act-n').textContent = String(t.likes.length + (liked ? -1 : 1));
    });
    acts.appendChild(lBtn);

    const vBtn = h('button', { class: 'tph-x-act', type: 'button', title: '查看' });
    vBtn.appendChild(iconSvg('chart', 15));
    vBtn.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-x-act-n', text: xNum(xViews(t)) }));
    acts.appendChild(vBtn);
    return acts;
  }

  /** 查看数：没有真实埋点，用稳定散列造一个「像那么回事」的数 */
  function xViews(t) {
    return 180 + (uiHash('v' + t.id) % 4800) + (t.likes || []).length * 37 + (t.retweets || []).length * 61;
  }

  function xNum(n) {
    const v = Number(n) || 0;
    if (v >= 10000) return (v / 10000).toFixed(1) + 'w';
    if (v >= 1000) return (v / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'k';
    return String(v);
  }

  function xMenu(t) {
    const me = userNameNow() || '我';
    const acts = h('div', { class: 'tph-x-menu' });
    acts.appendChild(h('button', {
      class: 'tph-btn xs ghost', type: 'button',
      onclick: () => { try { HW.navigator.clipboard.writeText(t.text); notify('已复制'); } catch (_e) { notify('复制失败', 'warning'); } },
    }, ['复制']));
    if (t.source === 'manual' || t.author === me) {
      acts.appendChild(h('button', {
        class: 'tph-btn xs danger', type: 'button',
        onclick: () => { if (HW.confirm('删除这条推文？')) { xDelete(t.id); renderScreen(); } },
      }, ['删除']));
    }
    if (HW.prompt) {
      acts.appendChild(h('button', {
        class: 'tph-btn xs ghost', type: 'button',
        onclick: () => {
          const v = HW.prompt('回复 ' + t.author + '：', '');
          if (v === null || !String(v).trim()) return;
          t.replies.push({ id: uid(), from: me, handle: xMakeHandle(me), text: String(v).trim().slice(0, 280), ts: Date.now() });
          saveXTweets();
          renderScreen();
        },
      }, ['回复']));
    }
    session.xMenu = session.xMenu === t.id ? null : t.id;
    renderScreen();
    session.xMenu = acts;

  }

  // ========================= 搜索 =========================

  function renderXSearch(el) {
    const shell = uiShell(Object.assign(xTabOpts('search'), {
      nav: {
        search: '搜索',
        query: session.xQuery,
        onSearch: (v) => { session.xQuery = v; renderScreen(); },
      },
    }));

    if (!session.xQuery) {
      shell.body.appendChild(uiGroup('现在流行'));
      const trends = xTrends();
      if (!trends.length) shell.body.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-empty', text: '还没有话题' }));
      else trends.forEach((tr, i) => {
        shell.body.appendChild(uiRow(null, '#' + tr.tag, xNum(tr.n) + ' 条推文', () => {
          session.xQuery = tr.tag; renderScreen();
        }, String(i + 1)));
      });
    } else {
      const hits = xSorted().filter((t) => uiHit(session.xQuery, t.text, t.author, '@' + t.handle));
      shell.body.appendChild(uiGroup('搜索结果', hits.length + ' 条'));
      if (!hits.length) shell.body.appendChild(uiBlank({ icon: 'search', title: '没有搜到相关推文', text: '换个关键词试试。' }));
      else hits.forEach((t) => shell.body.appendChild(xBuildTweet(t)));
    }
    el.appendChild(shell.root);
  }

  /** 趋势：从所有推文里抽 #话题，按出现次数排 */
  function xTrends() {
    const map = {};
    (session.xTweets || []).forEach((t) => {
      const ms = String(t.text || '').match(/#[^\s#@，。！？、；：]{1,20}/g) || [];
      ms.forEach((m) => { const k = m.slice(1); map[k] = (map[k] || 0) + 1; });
    });
    return Object.keys(map).map((k) => ({ tag: k, n: map[k] * 37 + 12 }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.n - a.n).slice(0, 8);
  }

  // ========================= 通知 / 私信 =========================

  /** 通知 = 别人对我推文的回复 + 提到我的推文 */
  function xNoti() {
    const me = userNameNow() || '我';
    const out = [];
    (session.xTweets || []).forEach((t) => {
      const mine = t.source === 'manual' || t.author === me;
      (t.replies || []).forEach((r) => {
        if (r.from && r.from !== me && mine) out.push({ kind: 'reply', tw: t, r: r, at: r.ts || 0 });
      });
      if (!mine && String(t.text || '').indexOf('@' + me) >= 0) out.push({ kind: 'mention', tw: t, r: null, at: t.ts || 0 });
    });
    return out.sort((a, b) => b.at - a.at);
  }

  function renderXNoti(el) {
    const shell = uiShell(Object.assign(xTabOpts('noti'), { title: '通知' }));
    const list = xNoti();
    if (!list.length) {

          h('span', { class: 'tph-x-noti-from', text: it.kind === 'reply' ? it.r.from + ' 回复了你' : it.tw.author + ' 提到了你' }),
          h('span', { class: 'tph-x-handle', text: timeAgo(it.at) }),

        mid.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-x-noti-text', text: it.r ? it.r.text : it.tw.text }));

  // ========================= 发推面板 =========================

  function xBuildCompose() {
    const box = h('div', { class: 'tph-x-compose' });
    const whoRow = h('div', { class: 'tph-row' });
    whoRow.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-label inline', text: '发布者' }));
    const whoInput = h('input', { class: 'tph-input', type: 'text', placeholder: '角色名（留空=我）', value: session.xWho || '' });
    whoInput.addEventListener('input', () => { session.xWho = whoInput.value; });
    whoRow.appendChild(whoInput);
    box.appendChild(whoRow);

    const ta = h('textarea', { class: 'tph-textarea', placeholder: '有什么新鲜事？' });
    ta.style.minHeight = '56px';
    box.appendChild(ta);

    const acts = h('div', { class: 'tph-actions' });
    acts.appendChild(h('button', {
      class: 'tph-btn sm primary', type: 'button',
      onclick: () => {
        const text = String(ta.value || '').trim();
        if (!text) { notify('内容不能为空', 'warning'); return; }
        const who = session.xWho || userNameNow() || '我';
        xAdd(who, xMakeHandle(who), text, [], 'manual');
        notify('推文已发布');
        session.xCompose = false;
        session.xPage = 1;
        renderScreen();
      },
    }, ['发推']));
    acts.appendChild(h('button', {
      class: 'tph-btn ghost sm', type: 'button',
      onclick: async () => {
        const who = session.xWho || wxCandidates()[0] || userNameNow() || '角色';
        const handle = xMakeHandle(who);
        setBusy('xAI', true);
        const ctx = await storyContext((config.extract && config.extract.floorRange) || 20);
        const p = promptText('xTweet');
        const tag = config.x && config.x.defaultTag ? '默认话题标签：#' + config.x.defaultTag : '';
        const prompt = fillPrompt(p, { who: who, context: ctx, extra: tag });
        const r = await llm(prompt, 'X推文');
        setBusy('xAI', false);
        if (!r) { notify('AI 生成失败', 'warning'); return; }
        const obj = safeJson(r);
        if (obj && obj.text) {
          const tw = xAdd(who, handle, obj.text, obj.replies || [], 'ai');
          notify('AI 已代发推文');
          session.xCompose = false;
          session.xPage = 1;
          renderScreen();
          if (config.x && config.x.autoReact && tw) { try { await xReact(tw, true); } catch (_e) { /* 互动失败不影响发布 */ } }
        } else { notify('AI 返回格式异常', 'warning'); }
      },
    }, ['AI 代发']));
    box.appendChild(acts);
    return box;
  }

  /** 从角色名生成一个 handle */
  function xMakeHandle(name) {
    const s = String(name || 'user').trim();
    const hh = s.replace(/[^\w\u4e00-\u9fff]/g, '').toLowerCase().slice(0, 15);
    return hh || 'user';
  }

  /** AI 代发推文（脱离 UI 的可复用入口，供更新中心调用）。返回 true/false */
  async function xAiGen(silent) {
    const who = (session.xWho || wxCandidates()[0] || userNameNow() || '角色');
    const handle = xMakeHandle(who);
    setBusy('xAI', true);
    if (!silent) renderScreen();
    const ctx = await storyContext((config.extract && config.extract.floorRange) || 20);
    const prof = profileByName(who);
    const profileCtx = prof ? buildProfileContext(prof) : '';
    const fullCtx = ctx + (profileCtx ? '\n\n' + profileCtx : '');
    const p = promptText('xTweet');
    const tag = config.x && config.x.defaultTag ? '默认话题标签：#' + config.x.defaultTag : '';
    const prompt = fillPrompt(p, { who: who, context: fullCtx, extra: tag });
    const r = await llm(prompt, 'X推文');
    setBusy('xAI', false);
    if (!r) { if (!silent) notify('X AI 生成失败', 'warning'); return false; }
    const obj = safeJson(r);
    if (obj && obj.text) {
      const tw = xAdd(who, handle, obj.text, obj.replies || [], 'ai');
      if (!silent) { notify('AI 已代发推文', 'success'); renderScreen(); }
      if (config.x && config.x.autoReact && tw) { try { await xReact(tw, !silent ? false : true); } catch (_e) { /* 互动失败不影响发布 */ } }
      return true;
    }
    if (!silent) notify('X AI 返回格式异常', 'warning');
    return false;
  }

  /** 自动互动：让其他角色对一条推文点赞/回复（对齐朋友圈 moReact） */
  async function xReact(tw, silent) {
    if (!tw) return;
    const cands = wxCandidates().filter((n) => n !== tw.author);
    if (!cands.length) {
      if (!silent) notify('还没有其他角色可以互动。先在微信建个会话，或在设置 → 立绘映射里加上角色名。', 'warning');
      return;
    }
    session.xReacting = tw.id;
    if (!silent) renderScreen();
    try {
      const prompt = fillVars(promptText('xReact'), {
        author: tw.author,
        text: tw.text,
        candidates: cands.slice(0, 12).join('、'),
      });
      const resp = await llm(prompt, 'X点赞回复');
      if (!resp) {
        if (!silent) notify('AI 没有返回内容', 'warning');
        return;
      }
      const j = safeJson(resp) || {};
      if (!Array.isArray(tw.likes)) tw.likes = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(tw.replies)) tw.replies = [];
      if (Array.isArray(j.likes)) {
        j.likes.forEach((n) => {
          const nm = wxMatchMember(n, cands);
          if (nm && tw.likes.indexOf(nm) < 0) tw.likes.push(nm);
        });
      }
      if (Array.isArray(j.replies)) {
        j.replies.forEach((c) => {
          const from = wxMatchMember(c && c.from, cands);
          const text = String((c && c.text) || '').trim();
          if (!from || !text) return;
          tw.replies.push({ id: uid(), from: from, handle: xMakeHandle(from), text: text.slice(0, 280), ts: Date.now() });
        });
      }
      if (tw.replies.length > 60) tw.replies.splice(0, tw.replies.length - 60);
      saveXTweets();
    } catch (e) {
      softFail('X互动', e);
      setDiag('X 互动失败：' + errText(e));
    } finally {
      session.xReacting = null;
      if (!silent) rerender();
    }
  }

  // ========================= 推文详情 =========================

  /**
   * 推文详情页：点推文卡进入。
   * 顶栏带「← X」返回按钮；正文铺满；下方是回复列表 + 底部回复输入栏；

    head.appendChild(info);

    const txt = h('div', { class: 'tph-x-text' });
    txt.appendChild(richText(tw.text, {
      onTag: (v) => { session.xDetailId = null; session.xTab = 'search'; session.xQuery = v; session.xPage = 1; renderScreen(); },

    // —— 回复列表 ——

    }

    el.appendChild(shell.root);

    // —— 底部回复输入栏（sticky，复用微信输入样式）——
    const bar = h('div', { class: 'tph-wx-input' });

    ta.value = session.xDetailDraft || '';
    ta.addEventListener('input', () => { session.xDetailDraft = ta.value; });
    ta.addEventListener('keydown', (ev) => {
      if (ev.key === 'Enter' && !ev.shiftKey) { ev.preventDefault(); xDetailSend(tw, ta); }
    });
    bar.appendChild(ta);
    const send = h('button', {
      class: 'tph-wx-send', type: 'button',
      onclick: () => xDetailSend(tw, ta),
    }, ['回复']);
    bar.appendChild(send);
    shell.root.appendChild(bar);
  }

  /** 回复行（详情页与推文卡内嵌回复共用同款样式） */
  function xBuildReply(r) {
    const row = h('div', { class: 'tph-x-reply' });
    row.appendChild(avaNode(r.from, 28));
    const ri = h('div', { class: 'tph-x-reply-body' });
    const rt = h('div', { class: 'tph-x-reply-top' });
    rt.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-x-reply-name', text: r.from }));
    rt.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-x-handle', text: '@' + (r.handle || '') + ' · ' + timeAgo(r.ts) }));
    ri.appendChild(rt);
    const rtx = h('div', { class: 'tph-x-reply-text' });
    rtx.appendChild(richText(r.text, { onMention: openChatWith }));
    ri.appendChild(rtx);
    row.appendChild(ri);
    return row;
  }

  /** 详情页发送回复：push 进 tw.replies + 持久化 + 局部刷新（不丢输入焦点） */
  function xDetailSend(tw, ta) {
    const me = userNameNow() || '我';
    const text = String((ta && ta.value) || '').trim();
    if (!text) { notify('回复内容不能为空', 'warning'); return; }
    if (!Array.isArray(tw.replies)) tw.replies = [];
    tw.replies.push({
      id: uid(),
      from: me,
      handle: xMakeHandle(me),
      text: text.slice(0, 280),
      ts: Date.now(),
    });
    if (tw.replies.length > 60) tw.replies.splice(0, tw.replies.length - 60);
    saveXTweets();
    session.xDetailDraft = '';
    if (ta) ta.value = '';
    // 重渲染详情页（保持滚动与底栏位置）
    const el = session.screenEl;
    if (el) { clearChildren(el); renderXDetail(el, tw); }
    else renderScreen();
  }

  // ===========================================================================
  // 18. 日历（月视图 / 事件管理 / AI 日程提取入口）
  // ===========================================================================

  /** 把 年/月/日 拼成 'YYYY-MM-DD'（月日补零） */
  function calDateKey(y, m, d) {
    const p = (n) => (n < 10 ? '0' + n : String(n));
    return y + '-' + p(m) + '-' + p(d);
  }

  /** 今天的 'YYYY-MM-DD' */
  function calTodayKey() {
    const d = new Date();
    return calDateKey(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth() + 1, d.getDate());
  }

  /** 翻月：delta=-1 上一月，+1 下一月，跨年自动进位 */
  function calShift(delta) {
    let m = session.calMonth, y = session.calYear;
    m += delta;
    if (m < 1) { m = 12; y--; }
    if (m > 12) { m = 1; y++; }
    session.calMonth = m;
    session.calYear = y;
    renderScreen();
  }

  function renderCalendar(el) {
    // 首次打开：定位到当前年月，默认选中今天
    if (!session.calYear || !session.calMonth) {
      const d = new Date();
      session.calYear = d.getFullYear();
      session.calMonth = d.getMonth() + 1;
    }
    if (!session.calSelected) session.calSelected = calTodayKey();

    const shell = uiShell({
      app: 'calendar',
      onHome: () => gotoApp('home'),
      title: '日历',
      nav: { actions: [{ icon: 'plus', title: '添加日程', onClick: addManual }] },
    });

    calBuildBody(shell.body);
    el.appendChild(shell.root);
  }

  /** 月视图 + 当天事件列表 + 全空提示，塞进骨架的 body */
  function calBuildBody(body) {
    const wrap = h('div', { class: 'tph-cal-wrap' });

    // —— 月份导航 ——
    const head = h('div', { class: 'tph-cal-head' });
    head.appendChild(h('button', {
      class: 'tph-cal-nav', type: 'button', title: '上一月',
      onclick: () => calShift(-1),
    }, [iconSvg('back', 14)]));
    head.appendChild(h('span', {
      class: 'tph-cal-title',
      text: session.calYear + '年' + session.calMonth + '月',
    }));
    head.appendChild(h('button', {
      class: 'tph-cal-nav', type: 'button', title: '下一月',
      onclick: () => calShift(1),
    }, [iconSvg('chevron', 14)]));
    wrap.appendChild(head);

    // —— 月视图网格 ——
    // 先建一张「日期 → 有无事件」的表，给对应日期格打 data-has="1"（CSS 自动出红点）
    const hasEvt = {};
    (session.calendar || []).forEach((e) => { if (e && e.date) hasEvt[e.date] = 1; });

    const grid = h('div', { class: 'tph-cal-grid' });
    ['日', '一', '二', '三', '四', '五', '六'].forEach((d) => {
      grid.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-cal-dow', text: d }));
    });

    const startDow = new Date(session.calYear, session.calMonth - 1, 1).getDay();
    const daysInMonth = new Date(session.calYear, session.calMonth, 0).getDate();
    const todayKey = calTodayKey();

    // 月首对齐星期：1 号是周几，前面就补几个空格
    for (let i = 0; i < startDow; i++) {
      grid.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-cal-day empty' }));
    }
    for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {
      const key = calDateKey(session.calYear, session.calMonth, d);
      const cls = 'tph-cal-day' + (key === todayKey ? ' today' : '');
      grid.appendChild(h('div', {
        class: cls,
        'data-has': hasEvt[key] ? '1' : null,
        onclick: () => { session.calSelected = key; renderScreen(); },
      }, [String(d)]));
    }
    // 补齐末行空格，让 7 列网格整齐收尾
    const trailing = (7 - ((startDow + daysInMonth) % 7)) % 7;
    for (let i = 0; i < trailing; i++) {
      grid.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-cal-day empty' }));
    }
    wrap.appendChild(grid);

    // —— 当天事件列表 ——
    const listWrap = h('div', { class: 'tph-cal-list' });
    const sel = session.calSelected;
    if (sel) {
      const dayEvents = (session.calendar || [])
        .filter((e) => e && e.date === sel)
        .slice()
        .sort((a, b) => (a.ts || 0) - (b.ts || 0));
      if (!dayEvents.length) {
        listWrap.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-hint', text: '这一天没有日程' }));
      } else {
        dayEvents.forEach((e) => listWrap.appendChild(calBuildEvent(e)));
      }
    }
    wrap.appendChild(listWrap);

    // —— 全空状态：整个日历一条事件都没有 ——

  /** 单条事件卡：勾选框 + 标题 + 详情 + 来源标记 + 编辑/删除按钮 */
  function calBuildEvent(e) {
    const card = h('div', { class: 'tph-cal-event' + (e.done ? ' done' : '') });
    card.appendChild(h('span', {
      class: 'tph-cal-event-check',
      'data-on': e.done ? '1' : '',
      onclick: () => { calendarUpdate(e.id, { done: !e.done }); renderScreen(); },
    }));
    const mid = h('div', { class: 'tph-cal-event-mid' });
    mid.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-cal-event-t', text: e.title }));
    if (e.content) mid.appendChild(h('div', { class: 'tph-cal-event-c', text: e.content }));
    if (e.source === 'ai') mid.appendChild(h('span', { class: 'tph-cal-event-src', text: 'AI' }));
    card.appendChild(mid);
    card.appendChild(h('button', {
      class: 'tph-cal-event-edit', type: 'button', title: '编辑',
      onclick: () => {
        const title = askText('标题', e.title);
        if (title === null) return;
        const date = askText('日期', e.date);
        if (date === null) return;
        calendarUpdate(e.id, { title: String(title), date: String(date) });
        renderScreen();
      },
    }, [iconSvg('edit', 12)]));
    card.appendChild(h('button', {
      class: 'tph-cal-event-del', type: 'button', title: '删除',
      onclick: () => { calendarRemove(e.id); notify('已删除', 'info'); renderScreen(); },
    }, [iconSvg('trash', 14)]));
    return card;
  }

  /** 手动添加日程：弹问日期与标题，粗校后落库并跳到那一天 */
  function addManual() {
    const dateRaw = askText('日期（YYYY-MM-DD）', '');
    if (dateRaw === null) return; // 用户取消
    const date = String(dateRaw || '').trim();
    // 粗校：长度 10 且含两个 '-'
    if (date.length !== 10 || (date.split('-').length - 1) !== 2) {
      notify('日期格式不对，应为 YYYY-MM-DD', 'warning');
      return;
    }
    const titleRaw = askText('事件标题', '');
    if (titleRaw === null) return;
    const title = String(titleRaw || '').trim();
    if (!title) { notify('标题不能为空', 'warning'); return; }

    calendarAdd(date, title, '', 'manual');
    notify('已添加', 'success');
    // 跳到新事件所在月份并选中当天，免得用户找不到
    const y = Number(date.slice(0, 4));
    const m = Number(date.slice(5, 7));
    if (y > 0 && m > 0 && m <= 12) {
      session.calYear = y;
      session.calMonth = m;
    }
    session.calSelected = date;
    renderScreen();
  }
